title_en: How To Build Courses / Membership Sites
source_md:
Memberships • Courses • Client Portal

How To Build Courses / Membership Sites

HighLevel Courses let you create, organize, publish, and sell online learning experiences from your sub-account. You can build course content, package courses into offers, choose free or paid access, and deliver the learning experience to customers through HighLevel. The updated Course Editor provides a focused workspace for managing modules, lessons, quizzes, assignments, and other course content. This guide covers the core process for creating and launching a course and points you to additional resources for advanced configuration.

What You'll Learn

Learn how to create a course, organize content with the current Course Editor, publish an offer, deliver course access through the Client Portal, automate enrollment, and find additional course training in HighLevel University.

Important

Course upload limits vary by file type. Supported Course video formats currently allow files up to **5GB**, while other file types can have lower limits. Review the Media Storage file-limit reference before uploading large course files.

# What Are Courses and Membership Sites in HighLevel?

HighLevel Courses provide the tools to build and deliver structured online learning content. Course creators can organize content into modules and lessons, add videos and other learning materials, create offers, and provide free or paid access to learners.

Course creation and management are available under **Memberships → Courses** in the sub-account.

Learners can access membership courses through HighLevel's customer-facing experience, including the **Client Portal**.

Courses can also be made available through the **Learning** experience in HighLevel Communities when applicable.

## Key Benefits of HighLevel Courses

HighLevel combines course creation, monetization, and customer access so businesses can manage learning experiences without separating course content from the rest of their customer journey.

- **Flexible Course Creation:** Build structured courses with modules, lessons, videos, quizzes, assignments, and downloadable learning materials.
- **Focused Course Editing:** Use the Course Editor's course map and editing workspace to navigate and organize course content efficiently.
- **Flexible Monetization:** Create free, one-time, or recurring course offers based on how you want customers to access your content.
- **Automated Access:** Connect purchases to course offers or use workflows to grant course access automatically.
- **Centralized Learner Experience:** Customers can access courses alongside other supported resources through the Client Portal.
- **Community Learning Options:** Courses can also be made available through the Learning area in HighLevel Communities.

## Prerequisites and Limitations

Preparing your course content, access model, and payment configuration before building helps reduce setup changes later in the launch process.

Before creating a course, make sure:

- You have access to **Memberships → Courses** in the appropriate sub-account.
- Your course content is prepared, including videos, lessons, PDFs, quizzes, assignments, or other resources you plan to use.
- You have a course thumbnail available if you want to add one.
- A supported payment provider is connected if you plan to sell paid course access.
- You know whether learners will receive free, one-time, or recurring access.

Current considerations include:

- UI labels and button names can vary by account rollout.
- Supported Course video formats have a maximum file size of **5GB**.
- Other Course file limits vary by file type.
- Advanced access methods, Client Portal configuration, Communities, and workflow-based enrollment have separate configuration options and may require additional setup.

## How To Set Up and Launch a Course

Creating the course establishes the learning product that contains your modules, lessons, and educational content. Build the course structure before publishing an offer so learners receive the intended experience.

### Step 1: Open Courses

Start from the Courses product area so the new course is created inside the correct sub-account.

1. From the **Sub-Account View**, click **Memberships**.
2. Select **Courses**.
3. Open **Products**.

![Memberships Courses menu showing the Products page](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155081370533/original/rRh-0cjgU_P11TQR9hyojFCqd_y89D3QXg.png?1789845887)

### Step 2: Start a New Course

Starting from scratch gives you a new course structure that you can configure with your own title, description, pricing, thumbnail, and learning content.

1. Click **Create New**.
2. Select **Start from scratch**.

![Courses Products page showing Create New and Start from scratch](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155081370550/original/D-d89JldPFJsSQjWh64rQoTiYquMqjLtSQ.png?1789845977)

### Step 3: Enter the Course Details

Course details identify the learning experience and establish the initial configuration learners will see when accessing the course.

1. Enter the **Course Title**.
2. Enter the **Course Description**.
3. Upload a course thumbnail if desired.
4. Complete the available pricing and course settings.
5. Click **Create Course**.

![Course creation workflow showing course details and Create Course](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155067627958/original/ney-1Jg2J9jHWNLg4TvbRYC4p9mSNgh7qg.gif?1774365612=)

## Build and Organize Your Course Content

A clear course structure helps learners move through your material in a logical order. The current Course Editor keeps the course map and selected content visible in one workspace, reducing the need to move between separate screens.

### Open the Course Editor

Opening the editor gives you access to the course structure and individual content items from the same focused workspace.

1. Go to **Memberships → Courses → Products**.
2. Select the course you want to edit.
3. Open the course editor.

![New Course Editor showing the Course Map on the left and editing workspace on the right](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155068700364/original/gtZxGX6eIWccICy2hdUZHFg2Uq9rk_ImpA.png?1775652846=)

### Use the Course Map

The Course Map acts like a table of contents for the course and helps you move between content, reorganize items, and review supported status information.

- Use the **Course Map** on the left to review the course structure.
- Select lessons, quizzes, assignments, or other supported content to edit them.
- Use drag-and-drop controls to reorganize supported content.
- Expand or collapse modules to focus on a specific portion of the course.
- Review supported content status information and quick actions.

![Course outline showing modules, lessons, content status, drip settings, and locked content](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155068700774/original/tyEz_cpTDUZB8dJ_xKhi7SGhEZiC2dxeew.png?1775653108=)

**Course media:** Supported Course video formats currently allow files up to 5GB. Other Course file types can have different upload limits.

## Create and Publish a Course Offer

An offer determines how learners receive access to your course. After the course content is ready, create an offer to package one or more courses for free or paid distribution.

### Step 1: Open Offers

Offers package your course content into the access option that learners will receive.

1. Go to **Memberships → Courses**.
2. Open **Offers**.
3. Click **+ Create Offer**.

![Memberships Courses Offers page showing the Create Offer button](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155081370578/original/X0p-j6ddk8n-mGqcPR53W_N6bh-1c4ORtg.png?1789846118)

### Step 2: Configure the Offer

Offer configuration determines which course products are included and how learners are charged for access.

1. Enter the offer details.
2. Select the course product or products you want to include.
3. Configure the available pricing for the offer.
4. Click **Create** or **Save**, depending on the current interface.

![Create Offer window showing title, products, and offer type](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155067628657/original/T-DMPbjLV2AYbk5t1MpW5Jw_Lu7REW2A-w.png?1774365873=)

### Step 3: Publish the Offer

Publishing makes the configured offer available for supported sales and access workflows.

1. Open the offer after creating it.
2. Review the attached course products and pricing.
3. Change the offer from **Draft** to **Published**.
4. Save the offer.

![Course Offer editor showing Draft and Published status options](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155081370567/original/0WzJ4Cr9pxJ7LsVZeDU-FI5wUxdCucStfQ.png?1789846059)

After publishing the offer, review and test the learner experience before distributing it. A separate Payments product can also be linked to a published Membership Offer when your sales flow requires it. Only published membership offers appear when selecting an offer for that configuration.

## Course Access and the Client Portal

The Client Portal gives customers a centralized place to access supported resources associated with your business, including membership courses. Using the Client Portal can provide a consistent customer-facing location for course access alongside other supported client experiences.

### Configure Client Portal Settings

Client Portal settings control supported customer-facing branding, domain, authentication, language, and portal behavior.

Go to: **Sub-Account View → Memberships → Client Portal → Settings**

From Client Portal settings, businesses can manage supported options such as branding, domain configuration, language settings, authentication options, and other portal settings.

### Automate Course Access

Workflows can grant course access automatically when a contact meets the trigger and conditions you configure.

Use the **Course Grant Offer** workflow action to grant access to an existing course offer when the appropriate automation conditions are met.

**Legacy Memberships:** Businesses migrating from Legacy Memberships should review the dedicated Client Portal migration guidance before changing their existing course-access experience.

## Access Course Training from HighLevel University

HighLevel University provides additional guided training for users who want a video-based walkthrough of creating courses and building offers. The Course Creator's Playbook is available from the University area of an Agency account.

1. From **Agency View**, click **University**.
2. Click **Go to HighLevel University**.
3. HighLevel University opens in a new browser tab.
4. In the top navigation menu, click **Learning**.
5. Locate **The Course Creator's Playbook**.
6. Click **Open** to begin the course.

![Agency View navigation to HighLevel University and The Course Creator's Playbook](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155081370683/original/yvra0CeC8EgtWY8-HQibCjqxVhTXwGxl5A.png?1789846805)

## Frequently Asked Questions

Q: Can I include multiple courses in one offer?

Yes. Course offers can package one or more membership courses so learners can receive access through the configured offer.

Q: Can I give someone access to a course without requiring a purchase?

Yes. HighLevel workflows support the **Course Grant Offer** action, which can grant contacts access to an existing course offer based on the workflow's trigger and conditions.

Q: Can I add captions or subtitles to course videos?

Yes. HighLevel supports **.srt** subtitle files for course videos. Multiple subtitle languages can be added, and supported subtitle content can be edited inside HighLevel.

Q: Can courses be offered through HighLevel Communities?

Yes. HighLevel Communities includes a **Learning** experience where supported courses can be offered to community members, including supported paid-course configurations.

Q: Can learners access courses without entering a password every time?

HighLevel supports customer-specific Magic Links for supported course and Client Portal access. Magic Links authenticate the intended customer but do not grant course access by themselves; the customer must already have permission to the content.

Q: Where should I check the latest upload limits for course files?

Review the **Media Storage File Types, Limits & Advanced Features** article. Upload limits differ by file type and HighLevel product.

---

**TABLE OF CONTENTS**

- [What is Post Sync in Social Planner?](#What-is-Post-Sync-in-Social-Planner?)

  - [LinkedIn](#LinkedIn)

# **What is Post Sync in Social Planner?**

Post Sync is a feature that automatically imports your existing posts into HighLevel’s Social Planner. It enables you to view, manage, and analyze both past and future content from a single platform. By syncing recent posts and updating engagement data regularly, it ensures your reporting remains accurate while reducing the need for manual content recreation.

---

## **Instagram Post Sync Settings and Behavior**

Automatically syncing your Instagram content ensures your recent posts are available inside Social Planner without any manual intervention. This keeps your content library complete and up to date.

- Syncs posts from the **last 30 days** automatically.
- Supports **images**, **videos**, **carousels**, and **reels**.
- Imports content directly into your Social Planner calendar.
- Insights are **not real-time** and refresh **every** **24** **hours**.
- Due to **Instagram API limitations**:

  - Location tags, collaborator details, and mentions may not be available.
  - Deleted posts on Instagram will still appear in Social Planner (sync is one-way).
  - Supports Instagram Professional accounts connected via **Facebook Login or Instagram Login.**

---

## **How To Enable Instagram Post Sync**

Proper setup ensures your Instagram posts sync correctly and your analytics remain accurate. Following these steps helps establish a seamless connection and syncing process.

### **Method 1:** Enable Post Sync While Connecting a Social Account

You can enable Post Sync directly while connecting your Instagram account.

1. Go to **Marketing**>**Social Planner.**
2. Click **+ Socials.**  
     
   **![](https://jumpshare.com/share/aS1QNSBzd7cJbEF07JA2+/Screen+Shot+2026-04-21+at+18.43.03.png)**
3. In the **Connect Socials popup**, enable the toggle: **Sync Posts Automatically.**
4. Click **Connect** Instagram and finish linking your account.
5. Once enabled, Social Planner will begin syncing your Facebook posts automatically.  
     
   ![](https://jumpshare.com/share/OrQGr3OKxnFNOP1pRF0A+/Screen+Shot+2026-04-22+at+16.04.49.png)

### **Method 2:** Enable Post Sync from Social Planner Settings

If your Instagram account is already connected, you can enable Post Sync later.

1. Navigate to **Marketing > Social Planner.**
2. Click on **Settings.**  
     
   **![](https://jumpshare.com/share/Ce1hHjIktHaej7yOtI4t+/Screen+Shot+2026-04-21+at+19.18.59.png)**
3. Go to **Social Accounts > Instagram**.
4. Enable the **Sync Posts**toggle for the page you want**.**
5. The system will start syncing posts in the background.

   ![](https://jumpshare.com/share/deKrlcYP0v4KTR21bQhH+/Screen+Shot+2026-04-22+at+18.34.25.png)
6. Once sync is enabled, open **Planner** to review synced posts.  
     
   ![](https://jumpshare.com/share/frS9XrFztRUXR2pbvW0n+/Screen+Shot+2026-04-22+at+18.38.23.png)
7. Open **Statistics** to review synced performance data.  
     
   ![](https://jumpshare.com/share/ADvh8ugE5GzM13SwGbvc+/Screen+Shot+2026-04-22+at+18.39.58.png)
8. If you see a **disconnect** or **expired**-**access****message**, follow the reconnect prompt to resume syncing.  
     
   ![](https://jumpshare.com/share/7RovBukoERL3SYmCgwAn+/Screen+Shot+2026-04-22+at+18.41.29.png)

---

## **How To Enable LinkedIn and TikTok Post Sync**

Enable Post Sync for a connected LinkedIn Organization Page or TikTok account to bring published content into Social Planner. This lets you review synced historical content alongside posts created and scheduled in Social Planner.

### **Enable Post Sync for a LinkedIn Organization Page**

LinkedIn Post Sync is available for Organization Pages only. LinkedIn personal profiles do not support Post Sync.

1. From the **Sub-Account View**, go to **Marketing → Social Planner → Settings**.
2. Under **Social Accounts**, select **LinkedIn**.
3. Locate the connected LinkedIn Organization Page you want to sync.
4. Turn on the **Sync posts** toggle for that Page.  
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155082303113/original/C6FgbKtIkPqdtEgZTWnB4t5n-kyE1J9Sjg.png?1790861281)
5. Allow the initial sync to complete.
6. Go to **Marketing → Social Planner → Planner** to view the synced LinkedIn posts.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155082303236/original/suxopsJZ5woa8AuZadWyPQnzGkjvg0Gr1A.png?1790861375)

### **Enable Post Sync for a TikTok Account**

TikTok Post Sync supports both Personal and Business accounts.

1. From the **Sub-Account View**, go to **Marketing → Social Planner → Settings**.
2. Under **Social Accounts**, select **TikTok**.
3. Locate the connected TikTok account you want to sync.
4. Turn on the **Sync posts**toggle for that account.  
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155082303366/original/PofgP39BvF4H0yqRLaiJIGhDyW65ZemdrQ.png?1790861462)
5. Allow the initial sync to complete.
6. Go to **Marketing → Social Planner → Planner** to view the synced TikTok videos.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155082303510/original/E_51aomw5i9stNdhvorPRM8OMTc0Bd65KA.png?1790861521)

---

# **Platform-Specific Support**

### **LinkedIn**

LinkedIn Post Sync **supports LinkedIn Organization Pages**.

Once enabled, Social Planner automatically imports your published LinkedIn posts, allowing you to manage historical content and engagement from a single dashboard.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155077143954/original/RrDqrdB3O0OBJO6RRJefYhyZPlag_Re8GQ.png?1785331338)

#### **Supported**

- Published LinkedIn posts
- Historical post sync
- Reactions
- Comments
- Shares

#### **Limitations**

- Supports **LinkedIn Organization Pages only**
- Personal LinkedIn profiles are not supported
- Insights refresh every **24 hours**
- PDF, Event, Poll, and Article posts sync successfully but do **not** display in-app previews
- Mentions, hashtag highlighting, and tagged-user details are unavailable because of LinkedIn API limitations
- Deleted LinkedIn posts remain visible inside Social Planner
- Sync is **one-way** (LinkedIn → Social Planner)

### **TikTok**

TikTok Post Sync **supports** both **Personal** and **Business** **accounts**.

After Post Sync is enabled for a connected TikTok account, Social Planner automatically imports published TikTok videos so they appear alongside your other social content.

#### **Supported**

- Published TikTok videos
- Historical post sync
- Likes
- Comments
- Shares
- Views

#### **Limitations**

- Supports TikTok Personal and Business accounts
- Insights refresh every **24 hours**
- Videos are displayed using TikTok's hosted player
- Raw video files cannot be downloaded because of TikTok API restrictions
- Synced TikTok videos cannot be cloned into new posts
- Location tags, tagged users, and music details are unavailable because of TikTok API limitations
- Deleted TikTok posts remain visible inside Social Planner
- Sync is **one-way** (TikTok → Social Planner)

### **Google Business Profile (GBP)**

Google Business Profile Post Sync lets you automatically import your published GBP posts into Social Planner, so you can manage historical and new content from a single dashboard.

Once enabled through **Labs**, Social Planner syncs your supported Google Business Profile posts and refreshes them automatically every 24 hours.

#### Supported

- Standard Posts
- Event Posts
- Offer Posts
- Call-to-Action Posts
- Historical post sync
- Summary text
- Images and media
- Call-to-action buttons
- Event details
- Offer details
- Automatic daily sync
- Sync status and reconnect notifications

#### **Limitations**

- Available only for Google Business Profile accounts
- Feature must be enabled through Labs for each location
- By default, posts from the last 30 days are synced. If there aren't enough recent posts, older posts (up to 365 days) are imported automatically
- Insights refresh every 24 hours
- Real-time sync is not supported
- Cloning is supported only for text-only and single-image posts
- Multi-image and video posts cannot be cloned due to composer limitations
- Engagement metrics are limited to data provided by the Google Business Profile API
- Deleted posts on Google Business Profile continue to appear in Social Planner
- Sync is one-way (Google Business Profile → Social Planner)

### **Threads**

Threads Post Sync lets you automatically import your existing Threads posts into Social Planner, so you can manage historical content, monitor engagement, and repurpose posts from a single dashboard.

Once enabled through **Labs**, Social Planner syncs your supported Threads posts and refreshes them automatically every 24 hours.

#### **Supported**

- Text posts
- Image posts
- Video posts
- Carousel posts
- GIF posts
- Poll posts
- Historical post sync
- Caption text
- Media and thumbnail previews
- Location tags
- Views
- Likes
- Replies
- Reposts
- Quotes
- Shares
- Clone supported Threads posts
- Automatic daily sync
- Sync progress and status notifications
- Reconnect notifications

#### **Limitations**

- Available only for Threads accounts
- Feature must be enabled through **Labs** for each location
- Posts from the last 30 days are synced by default. If there aren't enough recent posts, older posts (up to 365 days) may be imported automatically
- Sync runs every 24 hours
- Real-time sync is not supported
- Cloning is supported for text, image, video, carousel, and GIF posts
- Polls can be viewed but cannot be cloned because poll creation is not currently supported in the Threads composer
- Polls may display a **“Poll content is not supported in preview”** message
- Text file attachments are not supported for sync or preview
- Engagement metrics are limited to data available through the Threads API
- Deleted Threads posts continue to appear in Social Planner
- Sync is one-way (**Threads → Social Planner**)

---

## **Analytics Refresh**

To comply with platform API limits:

| Platform | Insight Refresh |
| --- | --- |
| Instagram | Existing behavior |
| LinkedIn | Every 24 hours |
| TikTok | Every 24 hours |

---

## **Frequently Asked Questions**

**Q: How far back does Instagram Post Sync import posts?**

The system automatically syncs posts from the last 30 days.

**Q: Are engagement metrics updated in real time?**

No, metrics such as likes and comments refresh every 24 hours.

**Q: Why are some details like tags or collaborators missing?**  
Due to Instagram API limitations, certain data such as location tags, mentions, and collaborator details may not be available.

**Q: What happens if I delete a post on Instagram?**  
Deleted posts will still remain visible in Social Planner because syncing is one-way.

**Q: Do I need a specific type of Instagram account?**  
Yes, only Instagram Professional accounts (Business or Creator) are supported.

**Q: Where can I see the synced posts?**  
Synced posts appear in your Social Planner calendar alongside scheduled content.

**Q: What should I do if my posts are not syncing?**  
Check your account connection and reconnect Instagram if prompted.

---

### **Related Articles**

- [Connect Instagram: Facebook-Linked vs. Direct Instagram Integration](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/48001213003)
- [Social Planner Content Guidelines - Image, Video, and Text](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/48001210585)
- [How to Use the Instagram Story Post Composer in Social Planner](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/48001240398)
- [Instagram Reels Publishing Guide for the Social Planner](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000000441)

title_en: How to Create and Manage a Contact Form in HighLevel
source_md:
A contact form helps you capture leads, inquiries, and customer information directly through your website, funnel, or shared form link. HighLevel lets you build customizable forms, collect standard and custom contact information, configure notifications, automate follow-up, and review submissions from one place. A properly configured contact form makes it easier to collect accurate information and move new leads into your follow-up process.

---

**TABLE OF CONTENTS**

- [What is a Contact Form in HighLevel?](#What-is-a-Contact-Form-in-HighLevel?)
- [Key Benefits of Contact Forms in HighLevel](#Key-Benefits-of-Contact-Forms-in-HighLevel)
- [Form Fields and Custom Fields](#Form-Fields-and-Custom-Fields)
- [Form Styling and Themes](#Form-Styling-and-Themes)
- [Form Notifications and Auto Responder](#Form-Notifications-and-Auto-Responder)
- [Form Submissions: Where to Access Them and How They Appear](#Form-Submissions%3A-Where-to-Access-Them-and-How-They-Appear)
- [How To Create a Contact Form](#How-To-Create-a-Contact-Form)
- [Frequently Asked Questions](#Frequently-Asked-Questions)
- [Related Articles](#Related-Articles)

---

# **What is a Contact Form in HighLevel?**

A contact form in HighLevel is a customizable form used to collect information from leads and customers. Forms can include standard contact details such as name, email, and phone number as well as custom fields that capture information specific to your business. When a new lead submits a HighLevel form, a contact record is automatically created so the information can be managed inside the CRM.

---

## **Key Benefits of Contact Forms in HighLevel**

- **Centralized lead capture:** Collect contact details and inquiry information directly inside HighLevel instead of transferring submissions manually between tools.
- **Customizable data collection:** Add standard fields or contact custom fields to collect information that matches your business process.
- **Flexible design options:** Use Styles, Themes, and Advanced settings to control the appearance and layout of your form.
- **Submission notifications:** Notify team members when a form is submitted and optionally send an automatic response to the person who completed it.
- **Workflow automation:** Use the **Form Submitted** workflow trigger to begin follow-up actions after a specified form is completed.
- **Flexible publishing:** Share a direct form link or embed the form into a HighLevel or compatible external website.

---

## **Form Fields and Custom Fields**

Choosing the right fields keeps your contact form focused while ensuring your team receives enough information to respond effectively. Standard fields are useful for common contact information, while custom fields allow you to collect business-specific details such as inquiry type, preferred service, budget range, or preferred contact method.

Common contact-form fields include:

- First Name
- Last Name
- Email
- Phone
- Message
- Drop-downs
- Checkboxes
- Radio buttons
- Contact custom fields

HighLevel also supports creating and editing several custom field types directly from the Form and Survey Builder. Depending on the field type, you can add options such as drop downs, checkboxes, radio selections, date pickers, numbers, monetary fields, file uploads, and text fields.

**![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155080324053/original/vgBe_VTwbk1LWjjrLgtBXc2okbLgd5XclQ.png?1788844241)**

---

## **Form Styling and Themes**

A consistent form design helps the form feel like a natural part of your website or funnel. HighLevel's **Styles & Options**controls let you adjust layout, spacing, colors, input appearance, buttons, and other design settings, while Themes provide prebuilt visual presets that can help you start with a polished design.

Inside the Form Builder, click **Styles & Options** to access:

- **Styles:** Adjust layout, colors, backgrounds, spacing, inputs, buttons, borders, and other visual settings.
- **Themes:** Apply a ready-made visual preset and then refine it using Styles.
- **Advanced:** Access additional configuration options for specialized needs.

For additional design options, see [Right Sidebar in Form and Survey Builder](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000004090?utm_source=chatgpt.com) and [Themes in Forms/Surveys](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000001315-themes-in-forms-surveys?utm_source=chatgpt.com).

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155080324122/original/anTcjZDS8gScsY2MtcWac5gEo26MNOCVFQ.png?1788844315)

---

## **Form Notifications and Auto Responder**

Form notifications help your team respond quickly without repeatedly checking the submissions page. HighLevel can send an internal Email Notification when someone submits the form, while Auto Responder can automatically acknowledge the person who completed it.

From the **Notifications** area of the Form Builder, you can configure:

- **Email Notification:** Sends submission alerts to designated team members or email addresses.
- **Auto Responder:** Sends an automatic email to the person who submitted the form.

Email Notification settings can include details such as the subject, recipient email address, reply-to email, and sender name.

For detailed notification settings, see [Email Notifications in Forms and Surveys](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000001640?utm_source=chatgpt.com).  
  
![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155080328725/original/9W_m9HO78lD6LtWmkhcaVbgW8Cc6tG0xBg.png?1788848966)

---

## **Form Submissions: Where to Access Them and How They Appear**

Form submissions give you a centralized view of the information people enter into your form, making it easier to verify responses, review lead details, and confirm that the form is working as expected. HighLevel lets you access submissions from the main Forms area or directly from inside the Form Builder.

When viewing submissions from inside the Form Builder, the **Submissions** tab displays the entries associated with that specific form. This makes it easier to review responses without leaving the form you are currently editing.

To review a form's submissions directly from the Form Builder

1. Go to **Sites → Forms**.
2. Open the form you want to review.
3. Click the **Submissions** tab at the top of the Form Builder.
4. Use the date filters or search field to locate a specific response.
5. Review the submission details shown in the table.
6. Adjust the visible columns if you want to display additional captured form fields.

This view is especially useful when troubleshooting or testing a form because you can edit the form, submit a test response, and immediately verify the captured data from the same form workspace.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155080327055/original/Z9IPVGSYgEhjBxIlH3FWigxy0kcAzqaZ7A.png?1788847628)

---

## **How To Create a Contact Form**

A complete contact form setup includes adding the right fields, configuring the design and behavior, testing the form, and confirming that submissions are captured correctly before sharing it with leads.

### **Step 1:**Create the Form

1. Go to **Sites → Forms**.
2. Click **+ Create New Form**.
3. Start with a blank form or select an available template from the Template Library  
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155080327514/original/MMBt_0c7Pb6TCADNmVu9V07UuXT7h23i-Q.png?1788848076)

### **Step 2:**Add and Arrange Form Fields

Add the information you want to collect, such as **Name, Email, Phone, Message**, and any required custom fields. Drag and rearrange the fields into the preferred order and mark important fields as required where appropriate.  
  
![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155080327842/original/QN_BbNnss37waInest8gTxLEbYJK5x2lnA.png?1788848285)

### **Step 3:**Customize the Form

Use the Form Builder settings to configure:

- **Styles & Options:** Adjust layout, colors, spacing, buttons, and themes.
- **Notifications:** Configure internal Email Notifications and an Auto Responder if needed.
- **Post-submission behavior:** Display a confirmation message or redirect visitors after submission.  
    
  ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155080327927/original/_WK4fibaDVt9c23CpB0SQyA3USmirw5Qwg.png?1788848329)

### **Step 4:**Save, Test, and Monitor the Form

Save and preview the form, then complete a test submission to confirm that everything works as expected.

1. Submit the form using test information.
2. Confirm the expected thank-you message or redirect.  
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155080328085/original/yI9ctuiCuRWrqcFPKS5mB8CbMLQjWU20sQ.png?1788848430)
3. Review the response from the **Submissions** tab.  
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155080328191/original/l4VeEsq_1uuscPcDe2JWwKXQgpaZhzlgng.png?1788848488)
4. After the form is published, use the **Analytics** tab to monitor views, responses, average completion time, and completion rate.  
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155080328453/original/wJx2SXNWcgWjU8CnoEnfYqX6pK7fUlTEHw.png?1788848728)

### **Step 5:**Integrate or Share the Form

Click **Integrate** and choose how you want to publish the form. Copy the embed code to add it to a website or use the direct form link to share it independently.  
  
![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155080328507/original/AOrZ35_rqT3tKy7eKa91s4mDDw6jw4ob6w.png?1788848783)

---

## **Frequently Asked Questions**

**Q: Can I create a contact form without leaving the Funnel or Website Builder?**  
Yes. HighLevel allows forms and surveys to be created or reused directly inside supported Funnel and Website Builders. Forms created there also appear in the centralized Forms list.

**Q: Can I use the same form in more than one place?**  
Yes. Existing forms can be reused through the Form Picker in supported HighLevel builders. Keeping a consistent naming structure makes reusable forms easier to locate and manage.

**Q: What happens if the person submitting the form is a brand-new lead?**  
When a new lead completes a HighLevel Form or Survey, HighLevel automatically creates a contact record.

**Q: Can I show different fields or outcomes based on someone's answers?**  
Yes. HighLevel's Conditional Logic can perform actions such as showing or hiding fields, displaying messages, redirecting visitors, or disqualifying leads based on their responses.

**Q: Can I use a HighLevel contact form on a website hosted somewhere else?**  
Yes. HighLevel provides embed code that can be added to compatible external website platforms.

**Q: How can I reduce unwanted or spam form submissions?**  
HighLevel provides options such as CAPTCHA and email or phone validation that can help reduce automated or invalid submissions. This is particularly important when form submissions trigger automated email or SMS follow-up.

**Q: Can repeated submissions result in duplicate contact records?**  
Duplicate behavior depends on the account's contact deduplication configuration. If avoiding duplicate contacts is important, review the account's **Contact Deduplication Preferences** so matching form submissions are handled according to your desired rules.

---

### **Related Articles**

- [Where Do Form Responses Show Up?](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/48000979916-where-do-form-responses-show-up-?utm_source=chatgpt.com)
- [Email Notifications in Forms and Surveys](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000001640?utm_source=chatgpt.com)
- [Workflow Trigger - Form Submitted](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000002550-workflow-trigger-form-submitted?utm_source=chatgpt.com)
- [How to Use Custom Fields](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/48001161579-how-to-use-custom-fields?utm_source=chatgpt.com)
- [Right Sidebar in Form and Survey Builder](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000004090?utm_source=chatgpt.com)
- [How to Use Embedding Options for Forms](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000004538?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

title_en: Bulk Import Companies Using a CSV File
source_md:
CRM Management

# Import Companies (Custom Objects) Using a CSV File

Import Company records in bulk using a CSV file to quickly migrate data, update existing Companies, or synchronize Company information in HighLevel.

What You'll Learn

This article explains how to import Company records in bulk using CSV files. The bulk import tool provides a guided workflow for uploading, mapping, verifying, and processing Company records while helping reduce errors through field validation and duplicate detection.

Whether you're moving data from another CRM or updating existing records, this feature streamlines Company management at scale.

## What is Company Bulk Import?

Company Bulk Import allows you to create new Company records, update existing ones, or perform both actions simultaneously by uploading a CSV file. The guided import wizard walks you through preparing your file, mapping columns to Company fields, reviewing the import, and monitoring progress through Bulk Actions.

Using the correct import mode and properly mapped fields helps maintain accurate Company data while reducing manual work and improving data consistency across your CRM.

## Key Benefits of Company Bulk Import

Company Bulk Import simplifies large-scale data management while giving you control over how records are created and updated.

**Save Time** — Import hundreds or thousands of Company records instead of creating them individually.

**Flexible Import Modes** — Create new Companies, update existing ones, or perform both operations in a single import.

**Smart Field Mapping** — Match CSV columns to HighLevel Company fields before importing.

**Duplicate Protection** — Prevent unwanted duplicate Companies using Record IDs and unique fields.

**Review Before Importing** — Verify mappings and import settings before processing records.

**Import Monitoring** — Track import progress, warnings, and errors through Bulk Actions.

**Detailed Reporting** — Download reports to review successful imports and troubleshoot failed records.

## Prerequisites

Preparing your CSV correctly before importing significantly reduces validation errors and ensures your Company data imports successfully.

Important

Before starting, verify you have permission to access the Companies module, Company Management is enabled for your account, and your CSV file meets all formatting requirements.

Before starting, verify the following:

- You have permission to access the Companies module.
- Company Management is enabled for your account.
- Your CSV file is saved in .csv format.
- The first row contains column headers.
- Required Company fields are included.
- Data is clean and consistently formatted.
- Custom Company fields already exist if you intend to import values into them.

Best Practice

Before importing thousands of Companies, perform a test import using a small CSV containing 5–10 records to confirm mappings and formatting.

## Common CSV Preparation Mistakes

Many import errors occur because of formatting issues within the CSV file. Reviewing your data beforehand helps prevent failed imports and unnecessary cleanup.

Warning

Avoid the following common mistakes that cause import failures and data quality issues.

Avoid the following:

- Missing required fields
- Blank header rows
- Duplicate column names
- Invalid date formats
- Extra spaces within important values
- Incorrect email or phone number formatting (if applicable)
- Unsupported special characters
- Empty columns that are not needed

## Import Modes Explained

Choosing the correct import mode ensures HighLevel handles each record exactly as intended.

Note

Select the import mode carefully based on whether you're adding new Companies, updating existing ones, or performing both operations.

Mode 1

Create

Use Create when importing Companies that do not already exist in HighLevel. This mode only creates new Company records.

**Example:** You are migrating Companies from another CRM into HighLevel for the first time.

Mode 2

Update

Use Update when modifying existing Company records. This mode requires a reliable identifier, such as the Company Record ID, to locate the correct Company before updating it.

**Example:** You need to update Company phone numbers or addresses without creating new Companies.

Mode 3

Create & Update

Use Create & Update when your CSV contains a combination of existing and new Companies. Existing Companies are updated while Companies that do not exist are created automatically.

**Example:** You receive a monthly Company export from another system containing both new customers and updates to existing ones.

## How to Import Companies

Following the guided import wizard helps validate your data before processing and minimizes import errors.

Step 1

Start the Import

- Navigate to Contacts.
- Select Companies.
- Click Import.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155077795160/original/imh1skE8vj94nacg0XT2EI1ejEjO4ColZA.png?1786018925)

Choose the appropriate import mode (Create, Update, or Create & Update) and click Next.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155077795278/original/aspnbS99kFscr1-ND9QPjkJwELsx1udrCg.png?1786018988)

Step 2

Upload Your CSV File

Upload the CSV containing your Company records. HighLevel validates the uploaded file before moving to the mapping stage.

Ensure:

- Headers are included.
- Required fields exist.
- File formatting is correct.

Click Next.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155077795355/original/w7zC9A9QrUUrXuruCSfqQJxTlImGd0nOYQ.png?1786019046)

Step 3

Map Company Fields

Field mapping determines where each CSV column will be imported inside HighLevel. Review every mapped field carefully.

For each column:

- Verify the detected Company field.
- Adjust mappings if necessary.
- Ignore unnecessary columns.
- Confirm custom fields map correctly.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155077795486/original/L19SLaoA2tBXnRLlIU7ummwYS3EXN5QZFQ.png?1786019101)

HighLevel attempts to map columns automatically whenever possible. Click Next.

Note

Review field mappings carefully before proceeding. Incorrect mappings can result in data appearing in wrong fields or import failures.

Step 4

Verify Import Settings

Before processing begins, review the import summary.

Confirm:

- Import mode
- Number of records
- Field mappings
- Duplicate handling settings
- Update Empty Values option

If everything looks correct, click Start Bulk Import.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155077795612/original/6ta8Ggb4RfsC94fj_5H1xFV_U5L6360XcQ.png?1786019143)

## Understanding Record IDs

Record IDs uniquely identify each Company within HighLevel. Using Record IDs during update imports ensures the correct Company is modified, even if multiple Companies share similar names.

Important

If Record IDs are unavailable, configure an appropriate unique Company field for duplicate matching whenever possible.

Example:

| Company | Record ID |
| --- | --- |
| ABC Manufacturing | 672918 |
| XYZ Logistics | 918234 |

Updating by Record ID eliminates ambiguity during bulk updates.

## Duplicate Detection and Unique Fields

Duplicate detection helps prevent accidental creation of multiple Company records representing the same business.

Depending on your import mode, HighLevel compares incoming records using Company Record ID, configured unique Company fields, or existing Company records.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155077795728/original/5GjKt3b9B1MxF3G5S8UFNOIAEhFcsjpDCQ.png?1786019214)

Note

If duplicate conflicts occur, review the import report after processing to identify affected records.

Possible outcomes include:

- New Company created
- Existing Company updated
- Duplicate detected
- Validation error generated

## Update Empty Values

The Update Empty Values option determines how blank cells in your CSV affect existing Company information.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155077795817/original/_wHauQ0KR3MqZ4nWgcryc6OyNvkTA8YmYA.png?1786019260)

Warning

When Update Empty Values is enabled, blank CSV cells will overwrite existing Company data. Use this option carefully to avoid accidental data loss.

When Enabled

Blank values overwrite existing Company data

**Example:**

Current Phone Number: (555) 123-4567

CSV Phone Number: (blank)

**Result:** The Phone Number is cleared.

When Disabled

Blank cells are ignored

Existing Company values remain unchanged. This is the recommended option when performing routine updates and your CSV does not intentionally clear information.

## Monitor Import Status

Bulk Actions allows administrators to monitor every Company import from start to finish.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155077795888/original/cjh0PUjm4gU6kAl6EWeaueavxRmYudk1MQ.png?1786019298)

Pro Tip

Download error reports immediately if validation issues occur. This makes it easier to correct failed records and re-import only the affected Companies.

Each import displays:

- Status
- Records processed
- Successful imports
- Warnings
- Failed records
- Completion time

Available actions may include:

- View Details
- Pause
- Resume
- Cancel (when available)
- Download Error Report
- Download Success Report

## Best Practices

Following recommended import practices helps improve accuracy and reduces cleanup after importing.

**Export existing Company data before performing large update imports** — This provides a backup that can be used if you need to review or restore information after an import.

**Test imports with a small sample first** — Perform a test import using 5–10 records to confirm mappings and formatting before processing thousands of Companies.

**Verify custom fields before uploading** — Create custom Company fields before importing your CSV. HighLevel will not automatically create missing custom fields.

**Review mappings carefully** — Double-check that CSV columns map to the correct CRM fields before proceeding. Incorrect mappings can result in data appearing in wrong fields or import failures.

**Avoid unnecessary blank values** — Clean your data before importing and consider disabling Update Empty Values to prevent accidental data loss.

**Monitor Bulk Actions after every import** — Track import progress and review completion status to identify any errors or warnings that require attention.

**Download error reports immediately** — If validation issues occur, download the error report to correct affected records and re-import only those Companies.

**Confirm imported Companies by reviewing several records** — After completion, verify a sample of imported Companies to ensure data imported correctly.

## Frequently Asked Questions

Q: Can I import new and existing Companies at the same time?

Yes. Use the Create & Update import mode.

Q: Can I stop an import after it starts?

Depending on the import status, Bulk Actions may allow you to pause or cancel an active import.

Q: What happens if duplicate Companies are found?

HighLevel evaluates duplicate records using Record IDs and configured unique fields. The affected records are updated, skipped, or flagged depending on your import settings.

Q: Can I import custom Company fields?

Yes. Existing custom Company fields can be mapped during the Field Mapping step.

Q: Will HighLevel automatically create missing custom fields?

No. Create custom Company fields before importing your CSV.

Q: Can I edit field mappings before starting the import?

Yes. Review and adjust mappings during the Field Mapping step before confirming the import.

Q: What should I do if some records fail?

Download the error report from Bulk Actions, correct the affected records in your CSV, and import only those records again.

Q: Should I export my Companies before updating them?

Yes. Exporting your existing Company data provides a backup that can be used if you need to review or restore information after an import.

Q: Does importing Companies automatically create associations with Contacts or Opportunities?

No. Company imports only create or update Company records. Associations must be managed separately where supported.

Q: **Can I undo an import?**

No. Imports cannot be reversed. Always validate your CSV before starting.

title_en: Ask AI Session Examples & Usage Costs
source_md:
Ask AI can complete everything from simple content generation to complex, multi-step workflows involving approvals, asset creation, and platform actions. Because Ask AI operates on a usage-based pricing model, session costs vary depending on the complexity of the request, the number of AI operations performed, and any generated artifacts or actions.

This article explains how Ask AI sessions are structured, how usage costs are calculated, and what influences overall session pricing through real-world examples.

**![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155074661991/original/HcT8jBg0gQqrDhrmn-EBcgmfR1AcjzLODg.png?1782592121)**  
Examples of Ask AI session outputs including approval cards, structured artifacts, and generated content.

---

**TABLE OF CONTENTS**

- [Understanding Ask AI Session Costs](#Understanding-Ask-AI-Session-Costs)
- [Ask AI Pricing Overview](#Ask-AI-Pricing-Overview%E2%80%8B)
- [Product Import & Currency Update](#Product-Import-&-Currency-Update%E2%80%8B)
- [Overview](#Overview%E2%80%8B)
- [Fitness Funnel & Email Template Creation](#Fitness-Funnel-&-Email-Template-Creation%E2%80%8B)
- [Multi-Channel Event Campaign](#Multi-Channel-Event-Campaign)
- [What Affects Ask AI Session Costs?](#What-Affects-Ask-AI-Session-Costs?%E2%80%8B)
- [Frequently Asked Questions](#Frequently-Asked-Questions)
- [Related Articles](#Related-Articles)

---

# **Understanding Ask AI Session Costs**

Ask AI sessions consist of one or more conversational turns where the AI plans, reasons, generates content, performs supported platform actions, and requests approvals when necessary. Every session is measured based on the work performed rather than simply the number of prompts submitted.

A typical session may include:

- Understanding your request
- Gathering additional information through Guided Questions
- Retrieving platform or external data
- Planning multiple steps
- Creating content or assets
- Rendering structured artifacts such as tables or approval cards
- Executing supported platform actions
- Requesting approval before making changes

More complex workflows generally require additional processing and therefore result in higher usage costs.

---

## **Ask AI Pricing Overview**

Ask AI is included at no additional cost for agency users on all HighLevel agency plans ($97, $297, and $497), subject to fair use. Sub-account users can access Ask AI through an AI Employee subscription or pay-per-use billing.

### **AI Employee Plans**

AI Employee Starter ($20/month), Growth ($50/month), and Unlimited ($97/month) include Ask AI usage, with higher-tier plans providing increased allowances. Usage is measured in rolling five-hour windows and is subject to applicable usage limits.

### **Pay-Per-Use**

Sub-account users without an AI Employee subscription can use Ask AI through pay-per-use billing. Charges depend on the AI models, resources, and actions used during each session.

Session costs depend on factors such as:

- Number of reasoning steps
- Workflow complexity
- Content generation
- Images or other generated media
- Charts, Mermaid diagrams, and structured artifacts
- External data retrieval
- Platform actions
- Approval workflows

Simple drafting sessions typically cost less than complex workflows involving multiple steps, asset generation, and platform updates

For details on which AI features are included for agency users versus sub-account users, AI Employee plan allowances, and pay-per-use pricing, see [AI Products Pricing](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000006652).

---

## **Product Import & Currency Update**

Product imports often involve multiple coordinated actions across inventory, pricing, and location settings. This example demonstrates how Ask AI retrieves external product data, prepares approvals, and completes supported actions.

## **Overview**

Ask AI imported products from an external Shopify store, created the product inside the location, matched the product pricing, and updated the location currency.

**User Request**

Pull a list of all the products from https://federflex.com/collections/all and add them as products in the location. Also set the location and product currency to match.

**![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155074662109/original/6rzlSCJjKP_HACajmeWT8kB-RqgBDyeBuQ.png?1782592853)**  
Approval cards for product creation, pricing, and location currency updates.

### **How Ask AI Processed the Task**

Ask AI:

- Retrieved the Shopify product catalog
- Identified one primary product with multiple variants
- Reviewed color and size options
- Verified pricing
- Checked the current location currency
- Prepared approval requests
- Created the product after approval
- Applied INR pricing
- Updated the location currency from AED to INR

### **Actions Performed**

- Retrieved product information
- Identified product variants
- Compared source pricing
- Reviewed location currency
- Generated approval requests
- Created the product
- Applied INR pricing
- Updated location currency

### **Session Details**

| **Item** | **Value** |
| --- | --- |
| Total Turns | 15 |
| User Messages | 2 |
| Rendering | Approval Cards |
| Final Result | Product imported and configured |
| Total Session Cost | **$1.1757** |

---

## **Fitness Funnel & Email Template Creation**

Ask AI can combine planning, business discovery, and supported platform actions into a guided workflow. When certain platform capabilities are unavailable through the API, Ask AI provides implementation guidance instead.

### **Overview**

Ask AI helped design a complete coaching funnel and created production-ready email templates.

### **User Request**

Create a complete funnel for my fitness coaching business including landing page, form, email follow-ups, and booking calendar.

**![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155074662131/original/w5xl4ZHO9Ltc_gMAwOEaNUzdJ41Lt6VJLA.png?1782593067)**  
Guided Questions used to collect business information.

**![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155074662011/original/FObND8VX8_0FcYzdxadvwpr-L4jUpJdxAw.png?1782592281)**  
Landing page blueprint, lead capture form, and email sequence generated by Ask AI.

### **How Ask AI Processed the Task**

Ask AI collected:

- Business name
- Coaching specialty
- Target audience
- Primary offer
- Discovery preferences

It determined that funnel creation, form creation, and calendar setup were not available through supported API actions, then completed the supported task of creating email templates while providing detailed implementation guidance for the remaining steps.

### **Actions Performed**

- Collected business information
- Planned landing page structure
- Suggested lead capture fields
- Designed email nurture sequence
- Requested approval
- Created three email templates
- Generated implementation instructions

### **Email Templates Created**

| **Template** | **Subject** |
| --- | --- |
| HLF – Welcome Email | Welcome to HighLevel Fitness — Here’s What Happens Next |
| HLF – The Busy Professional Edge | The #1 Reason Busy Pros Never Build Muscle (And How to Fix It) |
| HLF – Your Spot Is Waiting | Your 10-Week Transformation Spot Won’t Be Open Forever |

### **Session Details**

| **Item** | **Value** |
| --- | --- |
| User Messages | 3 |
| Platform Actions | 3 Email Templates |
| Manual Guidance | Landing Page, Form, Workflow & Calendar |
| Total Session Cost | **$0.6992** |

---

## **Multi-Channel Event Campaign**

Complex marketing requests often combine content generation, brand assets, scheduling, approvals, and channel-specific campaign preparation.

### **Overview**

Ask AI prepared a complete marketing campaign for the Google I/O 2026 Watch Party & AI Recap Session.

**![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155074662175/original/WiSnOCV9pY5eYkxaaCTESx3t1gASmJVstw.png?1782593579)**  
Guided Questions used before campaign generation.

**![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155074662168/original/MxebqcOjGMCazkJDt3LTxnITlZRWj_T9vA.png?1782593503)**  
AI-generated event banner.

**![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155074662162/original/oGj-6MY7dHz64-bIs25qgT_rutVLggrFuQ.png?1782593398)**

Multi-channel campaign assets and email drafts.

### **Event Details**

- **Event:** Google I/O 2026 Watch Party & AI Recap Session
- **Audience:** Developers, SaaS founders, marketers, agencies, AI enthusiasts
- **Channels:** Email, SMS, WhatsApp, LinkedIn, Facebook, Instagram

### **How Ask AI Processed the Task**

Ask AI:

- Reviewed event information
- Retrieved the Brand Board
- Generated an event banner
- Created campaign messaging
- Drafted channel-specific assets
- Prepared campaign scheduling
- Evaluated platform readiness
- Generated approval checkpoints

During validation, Ask AI detected that:

- SMS functionality was available
- Social media accounts were not connected
- WhatsApp subscription was not fully activated

Instead of failing, Ask AI completed every supported task and identified the remaining requirements before publishing.

### **Assets Prepared**

- Event banner
- Three email campaigns
- Three SMS messages
- WhatsApp templates
- LinkedIn posts
- Facebook posts
- Instagram feed posts
- Instagram Stories
- WhatsApp broadcast copy
- Campaign schedule
- Approval workflow

### **Session Details**

| **Item** | **Value** |
| --- | --- |
| User Messages | 6 |
| Rendering | AI-generated image, approval cards, structured artifacts |
| Platform Actions | Email templates created |
| Pending Actions | Social accounts & WhatsApp activation required |
| Total Session Cost | **$2.9271** |

---

## **What Affects Ask AI Session Costs?**

Ask AI usage is based on the work performed during a session rather than the number of prompts alone. Sessions become more resource-intensive as additional reasoning, content generation, or platform actions are required.

Several factors can increase overall session cost, including:

- Multi-step reasoning and planning
- Guided Questions and follow-up interactions
- Platform integrations
- Product imports
- Email or marketing campaign creation
- Approval workflows
- Charts, tables, and Mermaid diagrams
- AI-generated images and media
- Large document creation
- External data retrieval
- Multi-channel campaign preparation

In general:

- **Simple drafting tasks** typically have the lowest usage cost.
- **Content generation with structured artifacts** requires additional processing.
- **Multi-step workflows with approvals and platform actions** generally consume more AI resources.
- **Image generation and other rendered media** usually increase total session cost.

---

## 

## **Frequently Asked Questions**

**Q: How is Ask AI pricing calculated?**

Pricing is based on the AI resources consumed during a session, including reasoning, content generation, artifact rendering, external data retrieval, and supported platform actions.

**Q: Does every prompt cost the same?**

No. Costs vary depending on the complexity of the request and the amount of processing required.

**Q: Do approval requests increase session cost?**

Approval workflows involve additional reasoning and structured rendering, which may contribute to overall session usage.

**Q; Does image generation cost more than text generation?**

Generally, yes. Rendering images or other visual assets typically requires more AI resources than generating text alone.

**Q: Can Ask AI complete actions automatically?**

Some supported actions can be completed directly after approval. Others may require connected integrations, platform permissions, or manual setup.

**Q: Why couldn’t Ask AI complete every task in Example 3?**

Some publishing actions required connected social media accounts or an active WhatsApp subscription. Ask AI completed all supported work and identified the remaining prerequisites.

---

- [Ask AI Artifacts & Mermaid Diagrams](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000007812)
- [AI Prompting 101](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000002254)
