title_en: How to Use Custom Values in Dashboards and Reports
source_md:
Custom values let you reuse the same dashboard or report across different subaccounts without manually changing location or user information each time. Instead of typing details such as a location name, address, phone number, or saved custom value, you can insert a placeholder that HighLevel replaces automatically when the dashboard is viewed. This makes dashboards easier to manage and helps agencies avoid creating separate versions for every client.

---

**TABLE OF CONTENTS**

- [What are Custom Values in Dashboards and Reports?](#What-are-Custom-Values-in-Dashboards-and-Reports?)
- [Key Benefits of Custom Values](#Key-Benefits-of-Custom-Values)
- [Types of Values You Can Use](#Types-of-Values-You-Can-Use)
- [How the Custom Value Picker Works](#How-the-Custom-Value-Picker-Works)
- [Using Custom Values in Widget Conditions](#Using-Custom-Values-in-Widget-Conditions)
- [Using Custom Values in Dashboard Elements](#Using-Custom-Values-in-Dashboard-Elements)
- [One Dashboard for Multiple Subaccounts](#One-Dashboard-for-Multiple-Subaccounts)
- [How To Set Up Custom Values in Dashboards and Reports](#How-To-Set-Up-Custom-Values-in-Dashboards-and-Reports)
- [Troubleshooting Custom Values](#Troubleshooting-Custom-Values)
- [Frequently Asked Questions](#Frequently-Asked-Questions)
- [Related Articles](#Related-Articles)

---

# **What are Custom Values in Dashboards and Reports?**

Custom values are placeholders that HighLevel replaces with real information when a dashboard or report is viewed. They help you create one dashboard that can automatically show the correct information for each subaccount or logged-in user.

For example, instead of typing a location address directly into a widget condition, you can insert:

`{{ location.address }}`

When the dashboard is viewed, HighLevel replaces that placeholder with the actual address of the current subaccount.

Custom values can be used in supported dashboard and reporting fields such as:

- Widget conditions
- Embed URLs
- Title elements
- Text box elements

You can also choose values from three groups:

- **Location:** Information from the current subaccount
- **User:** Information from the logged-in user
- **Custom values:** Values created under **Settings > Custom Values**

---

## **Key Benefits of Custom Values**

Custom values help reduce repeated dashboard setup by allowing the same dashboard to adjust automatically for different locations and users. This is especially useful for agencies that manage many subaccounts.

- **Reuse one dashboard:** Create one dashboard and use it across multiple subaccounts.
- **Show the correct location information:** Location details update automatically based on the subaccount viewing the dashboard.
- **Show user-specific information:** User values can display information for the person currently logged in.
- **Use saved custom values:** Values created under **Settings > Custom Values** can be added directly to supported dashboard fields.
- **Reduce manual updates:** Update the source value once instead of editing every dashboard separately.
- **Find values quickly:** Use the `{}` button to search or browse available values.

---

## **Types of Values You Can Use**

HighLevel groups available values into Location, User, and Custom values. Understanding the difference between these groups helps you choose the correct information for your dashboard or report.

### 

### Location Values

Location values come from the subaccount that is viewing the dashboard.

Available fields include:

- Location ID
- Location Name
- Email
- Phone
- Website
- Address
- City
- State
- Country
- Postal Code
- Timezone

For example, `{{ location.address }}` displays the address of the current subaccount.

### 

### User Values

User values come from the user who is currently logged in.

Available fields include:

- User ID
- Email
- Phone
- Role
- Type
- First Name
- Last Name
- Name
- Full Name

These values are useful when a dashboard should show information that changes depending on who is viewing it.

### 

### Custom Values

Custom values are reusable values created under **Settings > Custom Values**.

Examples may include:

- Weekly coaching topic
- Support phone number
- Office hours
- Internal links
- Business-specific text

Custom values appear in the picker and are organized by folder.

---

## **How the Custom Value Picker Works**

The custom value picker gives you a simple way to insert location, user, or saved custom values without typing the placeholder manually. Wherever the `{}` button appears beside a supported field, you can open the picker and choose the value you need.

To use the picker:

1. Click the `{}` button beside a supported field.
2. Search for a value or browse by category.
3. Choose **Location**, **User**, or **Custom values**.
4. Select the field you want.
5. HighLevel inserts the placeholder automatically.

For example:

`{{ location.address }}`

The placeholder stays visible while editing. When the dashboard is viewed, HighLevel replaces it with the actual value.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155079820040/original/yVXs-22txncmBxUMSnqQJ9w_7SbRUHcRYQ.png?1788273277)

---

## **Using Custom Values in Widget Conditions**

Custom values can be added to supported text fields inside widget conditions. This helps a widget automatically use the correct location, user, or saved value instead of relying on information entered manually.

For example, instead of typing a specific business address into a widget filter, you can insert:

`{{ location.address }}`

The widget then uses the address of whichever subaccount is viewing the dashboard.

This is useful when the same dashboard is shared across several subaccounts because you do not need to create a separate version for each location.

****![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155079820380/original/q9qSpnA6pxUJfg_AdDY2IVpH42pveCdeXQ.png?1788273463)****

---

## **Using Custom Values in Dashboard Elements**

Supported dashboard elements can also use dynamic values so titles, text, and links can change automatically. This helps you personalize dashboards without creating separate copies.

Custom values are supported in:

- **Embed URLs**
- **Title elements**
- **Text box elements**

For example, a Text box can include a saved value such as:

`{{ custom_values.ai_coaching_calls__weekly_topic }}`

When the dashboard is viewed, HighLevel replaces the placeholder with the value saved for that subaccount.

****![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155079820294/original/0Vjg-E8B-K59-fxj5e9hGmJCQHMD0gcARA.jpeg?1788273432)****

---

## **One Dashboard for Multiple Subaccounts**

Using dynamic values allows agencies to maintain one dashboard instead of creating a separate copy for every client. HighLevel fills in the correct information automatically when each subaccount views the dashboard.

For example, one dashboard could contain:

- `{{ location.name }}`
- `{{ location.address }}`
- `{{ location.phone }}`

If Location A opens the dashboard, it sees Location A's information.

If Location B opens the same dashboard, it sees Location B's information.

The dashboard itself does not need to be copied or edited for each subaccount.

---

## **How To Set Up Custom Values in Dashboards and Reports**

Adding a dynamic value only takes a few steps. The setup is slightly different depending on whether you are adding it to a widget condition or to a dashboard element.

### 

### Add a Custom Value to a Widget Condition

1. Open the dashboard in **Edit mode**.
2. Select the widget you want to update.
3. Open the **Conditions** tab.
4. Add or edit a condition that contains a supported text field.
5. Click the `{}` button beside the field.
6. Choose **Location**, **User**, or **Custom values**.
7. Search for or select the value you want.
8. Confirm that the placeholder appears in the field.
9. Click **Save**.
10. Save the dashboard changes.

******![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155079822791/original/0L3HOW3fMp4LhCVw4UgTggiHRMWpvv7pnA.jpeg?1788274372)******

### Add a Custom Value to a Dashboard Element

1. Open the dashboard in **Edit mode**.
2. Add or edit a supported element.
3. Choose an **Embed**, **Title**, or **Text box** element.
4. Click the `{}` button where available.
5. Select **Location**, **User**, or **Custom values**.
6. Choose the value you want.
7. Confirm that the placeholder appears in the element.
8. Click **Save**.
9. Save the dashboard changes.

******![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155079822972/original/uGajcU6Pya7qnmsqUGfPXN2gys27fiO_sQ.jpeg?1788274413)******

### 

### **Create a Custom Value First**

If the value you need does not already exist, create it before adding it to the dashboard.

1. Go to **Settings > Custom Values**.
2. Create the custom value.
3. Add it to a folder if needed.
4. Save the value.
5. Return to the dashboard.
6. Open the `{}` picker.
7. Find the new value under **Custom values**.

---

## **Troubleshooting Custom Values**

Most problems happen when the field does not support dynamic values, the saved custom value is empty, or the wrong value type is selected. Checking the source value first can help you quickly find the issue.

**The `{}` button does not appear**

The field may not support dynamic values. Custom values only work in supported dashboard and report fields.

**The custom value is missing**

Check **Settings > Custom Values** and make sure the value exists and is saved.

**The dashboard shows a blank value**

The saved value may be empty for that subaccount. Check the source information or custom value.

**The wrong location information appears**

Location values use information from the subaccount viewing the dashboard. Confirm that the correct subaccount is open.

**The wrong user information appears**

User values are based on the user who is currently logged in.

---

## **Frequently Asked Questions**

**Q: Can I use Location, User, and Custom values in the same dashboard?**  
A: Yes. You can use different value types throughout the same dashboard wherever dynamic values are supported.

**Q: Do Location values change automatically for each subaccount?**  
A: Yes. Location values use the information from the subaccount viewing the dashboard.

**Q: Which user is used for User values?**  
A: User values use the information from the person who is currently logged in.

**Q: Can I use custom values in every dashboard field?**  
A: No. Dynamic values work only in supported fields. Look for the `{}` button to confirm that a field supports them.

**Q: Can I use more than one custom value in a Text box?**  
A: Yes, if the element supports the values you want to insert.

**Q: What happens if a custom value is empty?**  
A: The dashboard may display a blank result where that value is used.

**Q: Do custom values also work in Custom Reports?**  
A: Yes. Dynamic values are supported in applicable areas of Dashboards and Custom Reports.

**Q: Do I need a separate dashboard for every subaccount?**  
A: Not when the differences can be handled with dynamic values. One dashboard can automatically show the correct location-specific information for different subaccounts.

---

### **Related Articles**

- [Using Custom Values in Dashboards and Custom Reports](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000008433)
- [Custom Values Settings](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000004705)
- [How to Create & Add Dashboard Widgets](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000001531)
- [Customizing Dashboard Widgets](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000001207)
- [How to Customize Dashboards by Adding Titles, Images, and Text Boxes](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000003045)
- [How To Create A Custom Dashboard](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000001531)

title_en: Create Funnels and Websites with Funnel AI in Ask AI
source_md:
Funnel AI in Ask AI lets you create a funnel, website, or landing page by describing what you need in a conversational prompt. Instead of starting with a blank page or manually configuring every section, you can tell Ask AI about your business and goal, review the proposed approach when clarification is needed, and watch the page take shape directly inside the conversation.

---

**TABLE OF CONTENTS**

- [What is Funnel AI in Ask AI?](#What-is-Funnel-AI-in-Ask-AI?)
- [Key Benefits of Funnel AI in Ask AI](#Key-Benefits-of-Funnel-AI-in-Ask-AI)
- [Eligibility and Access Requirements](#Eligibility-and-Access-Requirements)
- [How Funnel AI Handles Your Request](#How-Funnel-AI-Handles-Your-Request)
- [Plan Review and Approval](#Plan-Review-and-Approval)
- [Live Generation Preview and Progress Checklist](#Live-Generation-Preview-and-Progress-Checklist)
- [Editing the Generated Funnel or Website](#Editing-the-Generated-Funnel-or-Website)
- [Publishing, Domains, Tracking, and Workflows](#Publishing,-Domains,-Tracking,-and-Workflows)
- [Current Limitations](#Current-Limitations)
- [How to Create a Funnel, Website, or Landing Page with Funnel AI in Ask AI](#How-to-Create-a-Funnel,-Website,-or-Landing-Page-with-Funnel-AI-in-Ask-AI)
- [Frequently Asked Questions](#Frequently-Asked-Questions)
- [Related Articles](#Related-Articles)

---

# **What is Funnel AI in Ask AI?**

Funnel AI combines conversational guidance with HighLevel's page-generation tools so you can move from an idea to an editable asset faster. After generation is complete, you can open the result in the Funnel or Website Builder to make additional changes, connect domains, publish, configure tracking, and use workflows as you normally would.

For example, you might ask:

> Build a lead-generation funnel for my dental practice.

If your request does not include enough information, Ask AI can request details such as your business type or goal before generation begins.

---

## **Key Benefits of Funnel AI in Ask AI**

Funnel AI reduces the work required to turn an idea into a usable funnel or website. By starting with a natural-language request, you can focus on the business outcome you want instead of manually building the initial page structure.

- **Create from a single prompt:** Describe the funnel, website, or landing page you need directly in Ask AI.
- **Get guided clarification:** Ask AI can request missing information when your original request is too broad.
- **Review the approach before generation:** When clarification is required, Ask AI presents a short plan so you can understand what it intends to create.
- **Monitor generation in real time:** A live preview panel shows the page being generated.
- **Track progress clearly:** An in-chat checklist shows the generation stages as they are completed.
- **Continue editing in the builder:** Use **Edit in Builder** to open the generated asset and make additional changes.
- **Use standard HighLevel functionality:** Generated assets behave like regular HighLevel funnels and websites, allowing you to use normal publishing, domain, tracking, and workflow functionality.

---

## **Eligibility and Access Requirements**

Access controls help ensure Funnel AI is available only to users who have the appropriate permissions and are working in a sub-account where the feature is enabled. Understanding these requirements can help you distinguish an access issue from a generation issue.

To use Funnel AI through Ask AI:

- The user must have the **Funnel & website AI** permission.
- Funnel AI must be enabled for the applicable sub-account.

If a user does not have access, Ask AI displays a message explaining that the feature is unavailable instead of attempting an unsuccessful generation.

For more information about user access, see [Sub-account: User Roles, Permissions and Assigned Data](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000002544).

---

## **How Funnel AI Handles Your Request**

Funnel AI uses the information in your Ask AI message to determine what should be created. Providing a clear business type and objective can reduce follow-up questions and help the generated result better match your intended use case.

You can request assets such as:

- A lead-generation funnel
- A business website
- A campaign landing page
- A service-specific page
- A promotional or conversion-focused funnel

A more detailed prompt can include:

- Business type
- Target audience
- Primary goal
- Offer or service
- Desired conversion action

For example:

> Create a landing page for a residential roofing company that wants homeowners to request free roof inspections.

If your request is too vague, Ask AI can ask for additional details such as the type of business and the goal of the page.

---

## **Plan Review and Approval**

Reviewing the proposed plan helps ensure Funnel AI understands what you want before it starts generating the asset. This is especially useful when your original request requires additional clarification.

When Ask AI needs more information:

1. Ask AI requests the missing business or goal details.
2. You provide the requested information.
3. Ask AI presents a short creation plan.
4. Review the plan before proceeding with generation.

A clear plan can help confirm that Funnel AI has correctly interpreted the page type, business context, and intended conversion goal.

---

## **Live Generation Preview and Progress Checklist**

The live generation experience gives you visibility into what Funnel AI is doing while the asset is being created. Instead of submitting a request and waiting without feedback, you can follow the build process from the Ask AI conversation.

During generation:

- A live preview panel displays the page as it is created.
- A checklist in the conversation tracks each generation stage.
- Completed stages are reflected as the process progresses.
- The finished result appears when generation is complete.

Generation usually takes approximately **2–4 minutes**, although completion time may vary depending on the request.

---

## **Editing the Generated Funnel or Website**

Funnel AI in Ask AI is designed to create the initial asset, while the standard Funnel or Website Builder gives you control over post-generation editing. This separation lets Ask AI handle the initial build while preserving the full editing capabilities available in HighLevel.

After generation is complete, select **Edit in Builder** to open the generated asset.

From the builder, you can make changes such as:

- Updating text and images
- Adjusting page sections
- Modifying layout and styling
- Configuring forms or calls to action
- Updating page settings
- Preparing the asset for publishing

Funnel AI inside Ask AI is currently **create-only**. To modify the generated asset after creation, open it in the builder.

For additional information about HighLevel's AI-powered page-building tools, see [Funnel & Website AI](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000006713-funnel-website-ai).

---

## **Publishing, Domains, Tracking, and Workflows**

A Funnel AI-generated asset becomes a standard HighLevel funnel or website, which means you can continue configuring it with the same tools available to manually created assets. Generation creates the initial experience, while publishing and other operational settings remain part of the normal HighLevel workflow.

Depending on your setup, you can:

- Connect or assign an appropriate domain
- Publish the funnel or website
- Configure tracking
- Connect forms and conversion actions
- Use workflows and automations associated with the generated asset

Creating a page through Ask AI does not mean the page is automatically published to a connected domain. Review your publishing and domain settings before making the asset publicly available.

For more information, see:

- [Save, Draft and Publish Funnels and Websites](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000001913-save-draft-and-publish-funnels-and-websites)
- [Set Up a Root Domain or Subdomain for HighLevel Sites](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/48001153720)

---

## **Current Limitations**

Knowing the current limitations helps you choose the correct workflow and avoid situations where the generated result may not behave as expected.

Funnel AI in Ask AI currently has the following limitations:

- **Creation only:** Ask AI can create the initial funnel, website, or landing page, but additional edits must be made in the Funnel or Website Builder.
- **WhatsApp known issue:** Funnels created through Ask AI over WhatsApp may currently generate as blank. A fix is in progress.
- **Web Ask AI is unaffected:** Use Ask AI on the web for funnel generation while the WhatsApp issue is being resolved.

---

## **How to Create a Funnel, Website, or Landing Page with Funnel AI in Ask AI**

A clear request and a quick review of the generated plan can help Funnel AI build an asset that matches your business goal. After creation, use the builder to refine the page and complete publishing-related configuration.

1. Open **Ask AI** in HighLevel.
2. Enter a message describing what you want to create.

   Example:

   > Build a lead-generation funnel for my dental practice.
3. If Ask AI requests additional information, provide the requested details, such as your business type or goal.
4. Review the proposed plan when Ask AI presents one.
5. Approve the plan to begin generation.
6. Follow the progress checklist while Funnel AI creates the asset.
7. Use the live preview panel to monitor the generated page.
8. Review the finished result when generation is complete.
9. Select **Edit in Builder** to open the funnel or website in the appropriate builder.  
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155082621945/original/FqFpoRwjC9k9mFmgntkCk3Qg_h3ARpvAAQ.png?1791284057)
10. Make any additional edits and configure publishing, domains, tracking, forms, or workflows as needed.

---

## **Frequently Asked Questions**

**Can I ask Funnel AI to update an existing funnel from the Ask AI conversation?**

Not currently. The Ask AI Funnel AI experience is create-only. Open the generated or existing asset in the Funnel or Website Builder to make changes.

**Why don't I see Funnel AI in Ask AI?**

Confirm that you have the **Funnel & website AI** permission and that Funnel AI is enabled for the sub-account you are using.

**What happens if my prompt does not include enough information?**

Ask AI can request additional information, such as your business type or the goal of the page, before presenting a creation plan.

**Do I need to publish the generated page manually?**

Yes. The generated asset behaves like a normal HighLevel funnel or website. Review its domain and publishing configuration before making it publicly available.

**Can I connect workflows to an AI-generated funnel?**

Yes. Because the result is a standard HighLevel asset, you can use supported tracking, forms, workflows, and other standard functionality after generation.

**Why is my funnel blank when I create it through WhatsApp?**

There is currently a known issue affecting funnel creation through Ask AI over WhatsApp. Use Ask AI on the web until the issue is resolved.

---

## **Related Articles**

- [Ask AI Assistant](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000005327)
- [Funnel Creation Agent in Ask AI](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000005521-funnel-creation-agent-in-ask-ai)
- [Funnel & Website AI](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000006713-funnel-website-ai)
- [Sub-account: User Roles, Permissions and Assigned Data](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000002544)
- [Save, Draft and Publish Funnels and Websites](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000001913-save-draft-and-publish-funnels-and-websites)
- [Set Up a Root Domain or Subdomain for HighLevel Sites](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/48001153720)

title_en: How Email Notifications Work for Invoices, Estimates & Contracts in the Client Portal
source_md:
This article introduces email notification capabilities for Invoices, Estimates, and Contracts in the Client Portal. With this feature, both owners and users can customize how they receive document updates and manage all shared documents seamlessly within the Client Portal.

---

**TABLE OF CONTENTS**

- [What is Invoice, Estimate & Contract Notifications in Client Portal?](#What-is-Invoice,-Estimate-&-Contract-Notifications-in-Client-Portal?)
- [Key Benefits of Client Portal - Invoice, Estimate & Contract Notifications](#Key-Benefits-of-Client-Portal---Invoice,-Estimate-&-Contract-Notifications)
- [How To Enable and Use Notifications (For Owners)](#How-To-Enable-and-Use-Notifications-(For-Owners))
- [How To Manage Notifications (For Users)](#How-To-Manage-Notifications-(For-Users))
- [Frequently Asked Questions](#Frequently-Asked-Questions)
- [Related Articles](#Related-Articles)

---

# **What is Invoice, Estimate & Contract Notifications in Client Portal?**

The Client Portal’s notification feature enhances communication and document management by automatically sending email notifications when Invoices, Estimates, or Contracts are shared.

This ensures clients and teams stay informed and can easily find and manage important documents — all from one centralized place in the Client Portal.

---

## **Key Benefits of Client Portal - Invoice, Estimate & Contract Notifications**

- **Timely Updates:** Ensure clients receive notifications as soon as invoices, estimates, or contracts are shared.
- **Personalized Communication:** Customize email content and notification preferences for a more tailored experience.
- **Centralized Document Management:** Manage all invoices, estimates, and contracts in the Client Portal to reduce confusion and streamline workflows.
- **User-Controlled Preferences:** Empower clients to manage their own notification settings for better engagement.
- **Fewer Missed Communications:** Reduce missed updates and improve overall document-related interactions.

---

## **How To Enable and Use Notifications (For Owners)**

Client Portal owners can easily enable and configure notifications for each document type.

1. Go to **Sites** > **Client Portal** > **Settings**.  
     
   ![](https://jumpshare.com/share/Pp2DK36DSR7ZLwyLcFnX+/Screenshot+2025-12-08+at+6.56.13%E2%80%AFPM.png)
2. or **Memberships**> **Client****Portal** > **Settings**.  
     
   ![](https://jumpshare.com/share/yKi1TkFmH0LSMkI4WCwX+/Screenshot+2025-12-08+at+6.56.42%E2%80%AFPM.png)
3. Click on **Email Settings** > **Client Portal**.
4. Turn email notifications **on or off** as needed for Invoices, Estimates, and Contracts.
5. Click on the **Eye Icon**to preview the selected Email Template
6. Click on the **Default Template** button to select a new template or edit the default template. Checkout our article on - [Client Portal - Edit Default Email Templates.](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000007151)  
     
   [![](https://jumpshare.com/share/80NM0FLzLcCLmc2RqZnA+/GIF+Recording+2025-12-08+at+7.31.52+PM.gif)](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000007151)

---

## **How To Manage Notifications (For Users)**

Manage the types of email notifications you receive from your client portal, communities, and learning activities. Use these settings to control how and when you’re notified about updates that matter to you.

## **Step 1: Open the Email Notification Settings**

To begin managing your notification preferences, navigate through the Client Portal area to access the Email Settings page.

- Go to **Sites** from the left-hand menu.
- Hover over the **Client Portal** tab in the top navigation bar.
- Click **Settings** from the dropdown menu.
- In the Client Portal Settings screen, select **Email Settings** to open the notification options.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155060907759/original/veEJaiS2QIf4TdbqrVWkhmjRwqt7GooZEA.png?1766055632)

## **Step 2: Customize Your Community Notification Preferences**

In the **Communities** tab, you can manage all email notifications related to your group memberships, interactions, and learning activities. This area lets you choose whether you want to receive emails about group invitations, membership approvals, comments, tags, likes, event updates, and course progress inside your community groups. Each option has a checkbox to turn the notification on or off, along with a preview of the email template.

## **Group Invitation Email**

This setting controls whether a user receives an email when they are added to a community group. If enabled, the system sends a simple invitation message informing the user that they have been added and can now access the group. This helps new members quickly identify when they have been included in a group without needing to check manually.

## 

## **Group Membership Status Email**

These notifications keep both users and admins updated about changes in group membership. You can enable or disable emails for actions such as:

- **Joined the group (User):** Sent to users when they successfully join a group.
- **Approved (User):** Sent when a user’s request to join the group is accepted.
- **Declined (User):** Notifies users if their group join request is denied.
- **New Member Request (Admin):** Alerts admins when someone requests access to the group.
- **Declined/Removed by Admin (Admin):** Sent to admins when they take action on a member’s status.
- **Added to Private Channel (User):** Notifies users when they gain access to a private channel within the group.

These options help you stay informed about membership movements, making it easier to manage group participation and stay aware of access changes.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155060911095/original/6yaakH0Y5WYYtTxl_52nZ5sbuckLDAPE6g.png?1766057141)

## **General Group Emails**

These settings control the notifications you receive for everyday interactions inside your community groups. You can choose to receive alerts when someone comments on your posts, replies to your comments, or engages with your content through likes and tags. This helps you stay updated on conversations and activity that involve you directly.

The available preferences include:

- **New Comment on Post:** Alerts you when someone comments on a post you created.
- **New Post From Followed User:** Notifies you when a user you follow publishes a new post.
- **New Comment Reply:** Sent when someone replies to your comment.
- **Like on Post / Like on Comment:** Lets you know when your posts or comments receive likes.
- **Tagged in Post or Comment:** Notifies you when someone tags you directly or uses the @Everyone tag in a post or comment.
- **Content Reported:** Alerts you when content is flagged within the group.

These notifications help you keep track of discussions and engagement without needing to constantly check the group manually.

## 

## **Group Events Emails**

This section manages notifications related to events happening within your groups. You can choose whether to be notified when new events are created or when reminders are sent out.

- **Event Reminder (User):** Sends a reminder before an upcoming event.
- **New Calendar Event Created:** Notifies you whenever a new group event is added to the calendar.

These alerts ensure you never miss important sessions, meetings, or scheduled activities within your community.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155060911465/original/F8atpZFeHWGgwOHFeQh85zCcBrZYluTUMA.png?1766057341)

## **Learning (Courses) Emails**

These notification settings keep you informed about new learning content and course progress inside your community groups. You can choose to receive updates when new courses are added or when specific lessons or levels become available to you. This ensures you never miss important learning opportunities or unlocked content.

The available preferences include:

- **New Courses Added:** Notifies you when a new course is added to the group.
- **Join Group Learning Alert:** Alerts you when you can start participating in learning activities.
- **Course Unlocked (Time-Based Unlock):** Sent when a lesson becomes available based on a scheduled unlock time.
- **Course Unlocked (Level-Based Unlock):** Sent when you unlock new content after completing required levels.
- **Course Unlocked (Private Channel):** Notifies you when you gain access to course content inside a private learning channel.

These emails help you stay on top of your learning journey without having to check for updates manually.

## 

## **Subscription/Payment Status Email**

This section manages notifications related to group or course subscriptions and payments. These emails keep both users and admins informed about successful payments, subscription activations, and cancellations. It’s especially helpful for tracking billing activity within paid communities or learning programs.

You can enable notifications for:

- **Group Payment Successful (User/Admin):** Confirms when a group membership payment is completed.
- **Group Subscription Cancelled (User/Admin):** Alerts when a group subscription has been cancelled.
- **Course Payment Successful (User/Admin):** Sent when a course-related payment succeeds.
- **Course Subscription Cancelled (User/Admin):** Notifies you when a course subscription ends.

These updates help users track their purchases and ensure admins stay aware of membership or course-related billing events.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155060911647/original/cZoLNTOIyjkMrEVcM1APfd0pyj7iDhbkzQ.png?1766057414)

## **Role Changes**

These preferences notify you when your role or responsibilities within a group are updated. Role-related emails ensure you are aware of any new permissions or ownership changes that affect how you interact with the group. This is especially useful in communities where members can be promoted to moderators, admins, or given additional control within specific channels.

You can enable notifications for:

- **Member Role Upgraded in Channel:** Sent when your role is elevated within a channel—for example, becoming a moderator or gaining additional management permissions.
- **Group Ownership Changed (New Group Owner):** Notifies you if you become the new owner of a group, giving you full control over its settings and members.

These alerts help you stay informed about shifts in access and responsibility, ensuring you’re aware of any new capabilities assigned to you inside the community.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155060911706/original/vqVwO7Uphe5nKgC0g0wmwbAWqAjVgBRY7A.png?1766057453)

---

## **Frequently Asked Questions**

**Q: Can I use custom email templates for each document type?** Yes! Owners can create and use a custom email template for Invoices, Estimates, and Contracts individually.

**Q: Do users have to receive notifications?** No. Users can choose to disable notifications in their personal settings if they prefer.

**Q: Where do users find shared documents?** All shared documents can be accessed and managed directly within the Client Portal, in the organized documents section.

**Q: Can notifications be enabled or disabled globally?** Yes. Owners can enable or disable email notifications for all document types from the Email Settings panel.

---

## **Related Articles**

- [Client Portal - Edit Default Email Templates](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000007151)
- [Notification Preferences for Courses in the Client Portal](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000004655)
- [Notifications inside Client Portal](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000001719)
- [How to set up the Client Portal?](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000000193)

title_en: Project Management Workflow Triggers and Actions
source_md:
HighLevel allows you to automate Project Management tasks using workflow triggers and actions. You can start workflows when tasks are added or completed, schedule reminders, and automatically create tasks with the right details. This article explains how these features work and how to configure them in Workflow Builder.

```
Note: Project Management is now available to agencies on the $497 plan. To enable it, navigate to Agency or Sub-account settings → Labs and toggle on Project Management to access the new experience.
```

---

**TABLE OF CONTENTS**

- [What are Project Management Workflow Triggers and Actions?](#What-are-Project-Management-Workflow-Triggers-and-Actions?)
- [Key Benefits of Project Management Workflow Automation](#Key-Benefits-of-Project-Management-Workflow-Automation)
- [Task Added and Task Completed Triggers](#Task-Added-and-Task-Completed-Triggers)
- [Task Reminder Trigger](#Task-Reminder-Trigger)
- [Workflow Trigger Filters](#Workflow-Trigger-Filters)
- [Add Task Workflow Action](#Add-Task-Workflow-Action)
- [Using Dynamic Values and Custom Fields](#Using-Dynamic-Values-and-Custom-Fields)
- [Setting Task Dates and Skipping Weekends](#Setting-Task-Dates-and-Skipping-Weekends)
- [How to Set Up Project Management Workflow Automation](#How-to-Set-Up-Project-Management-Workflow-Automation)
- [Frequently Asked Questions](#Frequently-Asked-Questions)
- [Related Articles](#Related-Articles)

---

# **What are Project Management Workflow Triggers and Actions?**

Project Management workflow triggers and actions help you automate task-related activities.

A **trigger** starts a workflow when a specific event occurs. An **action** performs a task after the workflow starts.

For example, when a design task is completed, a workflow can automatically create a development task, assign it to a team member, and set its due date.

HighLevel supports the following Project Management workflow features:

| Type | Feature | Purpose |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Trigger | Task Added | Starts when a task is created |
| Trigger | Task Completed | Starts when a task is completed |
| Trigger | Task Reminder | Starts before or after a task-related date |
| Action | Add Task | Creates a task automatically |

**Availability:** Project Management is currently in Private Beta. The workflow features must be available in your sub-account.

---

## **Key Benefits of Project Management Workflow Automation**

These features reduce manual task management and help teams follow consistent processes.

- **Automated Task Creation:** Create follow-up tasks when specific events occur.
- **Targeted Automation:** Use filters to run workflows only for matching tasks.
- **Timely Reminders:** Schedule workflows around important task dates.
- **Flexible Assignments:** Assign tasks to specific users or use dynamic values.
- **Consistent Task Details:** Set priorities, statuses, dates, descriptions, and custom fields automatically.
- **Organized Workflows:** Create tasks in the appropriate Space, Folder, and List.

---

## **Task Added and Task Completed Triggers**

These triggers start workflows when tasks are created or completed. Filters determine which tasks qualify.

**Task Added**

Starts a workflow when a new task matches the selected conditions.

Example: Start a workflow when a high-priority task is added to the Website Design List.

**Task Completed**

Starts a workflow when a task is completed and matches the selected conditions.

Example: Create a development task when a design task is completed.

You can use status filters to target specific completion statuses.

## **Task Reminder Trigger**

The Task Reminder trigger runs a workflow before or after a selected task date. It helps automate reminders and follow-up activities.

You can schedule a reminder using:

- **Due Date:** When the task should be completed.
- **Start Date:** When work is scheduled to begin.
- **Custom Date Field:** A date stored in a task custom field.

Choose how many days before or after the selected date the workflow should run.

You can also filter tasks by status, assignee, priority, or name.

For example, you can trigger a reminder one day before a high-priority task is due, excluding tasks that are already completed.

## **Workflow Trigger Filters**

Filters control which Project Management tasks can start a workflow. They help ensure automations run only when the required conditions are met.

| Filter | Available conditions |
| --- | --- |
| Location | Select a Space, Folder, or List |
| Assignee | Match or exclude users, or check whether an assignee is set |
| Priority | Match or exclude priorities, or check whether one is set |
| Status | Include or exclude selected statuses |
| Task Name | Use contains, does not contain, equals, does not equal, or regex |
| Task Custom Fields | Match supported custom field values |

```
Note: Folder and List options depend on the selected location. Available filters may vary by trigger.
```

---

## **Add Task Workflow Action**

The Add Task action creates a new Project Management task when the workflow reaches that step. You can choose where the task is created and configure its details.

| Setting | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| Task Name | Sets the task title |
| Space, Folder, and List | Determines where the task is created |
| Status | Selects a status available in the chosen List |
| Assignee | Assigns a specific user or supported dynamic value |
| Priority | Sets Urgent, High, Medium, or Low priority |
| Start Date and Due Date | Sets dates relative to workflow execution |
| Description | Adds task details using a rich text editor |
| Custom Fields | Stores additional task information |

For example, the action can create a task named **Begin Website Development**, assign it to a developer, and set its due date to two days after the workflow runs.

---

## **Using Dynamic Values and Custom Fields**

Dynamic values allow you to insert information from available workflow data instead of entering fixed text. Custom fields allow you to store additional information on the task being created.

**Dynamic Values**

The Task Name, Description, and supported assignment fields can use dynamic values.

Available task-related values include:

- Task ID
- Title
- Description
- Due Date
- Assigned User

**![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155083615731/original/c4WAXcnylYqiJV_X9PRHVlLcirSyKJOX1Q.png?1792393049)**

**![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155083615797/original/FN2ho4FnNqsM4R9fkKClf8xfqzLcDUCCkQ.png?1792393094)**

**Task Custom Fields**

To populate a task custom field:

1. Open the **Add Task** action.
2. Click **Add custom field**.
3. Select the field you want to populate.
4. Enter a fixed value or select a supported dynamic value.
5. Repeat for additional fields if needed.

**![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155083615912/original/7qxGfjHbc_S0_pX3WGyyQwktbmIBGoynYg.png?1792393158)**

For more information, see [Use Custom Fields on Tasks](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000008453-use-custom-fields-on-tasks).

---

## **Setting Task Dates and Skipping Weekends**

The Add Task action lets you set start and due dates based on when the workflow runs. This allows tasks to be scheduled automatically.

To configure a date:

1. Enter a number in **Value**.
2. Select a **Unit**: days, weeks, months, or years.
3. Choose the time.
4. Enable **Skip weekends** if needed.

If the calculated date falls on a weekend and Skip weekends is enabled, it moves to the next weekday.

For example, you can set a task to be due two days after the workflow runs.

---

## **How to Set Up Project Management Workflow Automation**

You can combine a Project Management trigger with the Add Task action to automate follow-up work.

The example below creates a task in the Website Development List when a task is completed in the Website Design List.

### **Step 1: Create or Open a Workflow**

1. Go to **Automation → Workflows** in your HighLevel sub-account.
2. Create a workflow or open an existing one.
3. Open the Workflow Builder.

### **Step 2: Add the Task Completed Trigger**

1. Click **Add New Trigger**.
2. Search for and select **Task Completed**.  
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155083620352/original/7Q50u0YYf7uodJiXxdhBAmsFk9WEOrz-Bw.png?1792396086)
3. Choose the appropriate **Space**.
4. Select the **Website Design** List, choosing its Folder first if needed.
5. Add any other required filters, such as Status or Priority.
6. Save the trigger.

**![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155083620457/original/L9R2bx75sZPJY686ZzBLoMVMqvizXCKLQQ.png?1792396179)**

### 

### **Step 3: Configure the Add Task Action**

1. Click the **+** icon below the trigger.
2. Search for and select **Add Task**.
3. Enter **Begin Website Development** as the Task Name.
4. Select the destination Space and **Website Development** List.
5. Set the Status, Priority, and Assignee as needed.
6. Add a Description or task custom fields if needed.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155083620164/original/_0QpLln4JreQjb3FEZfb8qey9H4Puy4hyA.png?1792395998)

### **Step 4: Set the Due Date**

1. Under **Due Date**, enter `2` in Value.
2. Select **Days** as the Unit.
3. Choose the required time.
4. Enable **Skip weekends** if needed.
5. Click **Save action**.

The new task's due date will be calculated when the workflow runs.

### 

### **Step 5: Save, Test, and Publish**

1. Click **Save** in Workflow Builder.
2. Use **Test workflow** where supported.
3. Confirm the workflow creates the task in the correct List with the expected details.
4. Change the workflow from **Draft** to **Publish** when ready.

```
Important: Saving a workflow does not automatically publish it.
```

---

## **Frequently Asked Questions**

**Q: What is the difference between Task Added and Add Task?**

A: Task Added is a trigger that starts a workflow. Add Task is an action that creates a new task.

**Q: Can I create a task in another List?**

A: Yes. Select the destination Space, optional Folder, and List in the Add Task action.

**Q: Can I run workflows only for high-priority tasks?**

A: Yes. Use the Priority filter in a supported trigger.

**Q: Can I schedule reminders before a task's start date?**

A: Yes. Task Reminder supports start dates, due dates, and supported custom date fields.

**Q: Can I automatically assign tasks?**

A: Yes. You can select a specific user or use a supported dynamic value.

**Q: Can I use task information in the new task's name or description?**

A: Yes. Use dynamic values to insert supported task information.

**Q: What happens when a due date falls on a weekend?**

A: If Skip weekends is enabled, the due date moves to the next weekday.

**Q: Why isn't my workflow running?**

A: Check that the workflow is published, its trigger filters match the task, and the required Project Management features are available.

---

## **Related Articles**
