- [Workflow Trigger – Task Added](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000003260/create_ticket)
- [Workflow Trigger – Task Completed](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000001166-workflow-trigger-task-completed)
- [Workflow Trigger – Task Reminder](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000003261-workflow-trigger-task-reminder)
- [Workflow Builder Walkthrough](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000001254-workflow-builder-walkthrough)
- [Use Custom Fields on Tasks](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000008453-use-custom-fields-on-tasks)

title_en: Content AI with Social Planner
source_md:
Create high-quality, platform-specific social media content faster with HighLevel’s new guided Content AI questions in Social Planner. This update streamlines your workflow, ensures brand consistency, and helps you generate more engaging posts tailored to each platform.

---

**TABLE OF CONTENTS**

- [What is Content AI in Social Planner?](#What-is-Content-AI-in-Social-Planner?)
- [Key Benefits of Content AI in Social Planner](#Key-Benefits-of-Content-AI-in-Social-Planner)
- [How Guided Content Questions Work](#How-Guided-Content-Questions-Work)
- [Using Brand Voice with Content AI](#Using-Brand-Voice-with-Content-AI)
- [How to Create a Social Post with Content AI](#How-to-Create-a-Social-Post-with-Content-AI)
- [Refine Your Generated Post](#Refine-Your-Generated-Post)
- [Frequently Asked Questions](#Frequently-Asked-Questions)
- [Related Articles](#Related-Articles)

---

# **What is Content AI in Social Planner?**

Content AI in Social Planner helps you create social media post drafts using guided inputs tailored to your selected platform and content type. You can provide information about your content goal, audience, call to action, and Brand Voice, then use Content AI to generate a draft directly within your social post workflow. After generating the content, you can review and refine the copy before publishing immediately or scheduling it for later.

Content AI simplifies the process of turning an idea into social media copy. Guided Content Questions collect relevant information about the post you want to create, while Brand Voice can help generated content reflect your established brand identity. Because the inputs can adapt to the platform and content type you select, you can provide context that is relevant to the post you are creating.

> **Prerequisite:** Connect at least one supported social account to Social Planner before creating and publishing social content. If you have not configured Social Planner yet, see [Getting Started - Setup Social Planner](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000005063).

---

## **Key Benefits of Content AI in Social Planner**

Content AI combines guided content creation with the existing Social Planner workflow, helping you move from an idea to a reviewable social post without leaving HighLevel. Platform-aware questions, optional Brand Voice information, and AI-assisted editing provide additional context and control over the generated copy.

- **Guided Content Creation:** Answer focused questions about the post you want to create instead of writing a complete prompt from scratch.
- **Platform-Aware Inputs:** Content AI adapts its guided questions based on the selected social platform and content type.
- **Brand Voice Support:** Apply a saved Brand Voice to help generated content align with your established brand identity.
- **Flexible Content Refinement:** Review and manually edit generated copy or use available AI editing tools before publishing.
- **Integrated Social Publishing:** Create, refine, and continue to publishing or scheduling from the Social Planner workflow.

---

## **How Guided Content Questions Work**

Guided Content Questions help Content AI gather the context needed to create your social post. The questions presented can change based on your selected platform and content type, allowing the generation process to focus on information relevant to the post you are creating.

When creating content, you can provide information such as:

- The social platform where you plan to publish.
- The type of content you want to create.
- The purpose or goal of the post.
- Information you want included in the generated content.
- Your preferred call to action.
- Brand Voice information when available.
- Additional optional details that provide more context.

Some questions are required to generate the post, while additional questions can be expanded and completed when you want to provide more context.

Providing optional information can help Content AI create a draft that more closely reflects the specific message you want to communicate.

---

## **Using Brand Voice with Content AI**

Brand Voice allows Content AI to use saved information about how your brand communicates. Selecting an existing Brand Voice can help maintain greater consistency across generated content while still allowing you to adjust information for an individual social post.

If a Brand Voice is available, select the appropriate Brand Voice when creating your content. Review the information being applied and adjust or override values for the individual post when needed.

> **Note:** If you have not created a Brand Voice, you can configure one from **Marketing > Brand Boards > Brand Voice**. See [Create a Brand Voice from Text or URL](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000007263) for setup instructions.

For more information about how saved Brand Voice information works with generated content, see [Brand Voice Integration in Content AI](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000005308).

---

## **How to Create a Social Post with Content AI**

Creating a post with Content AI starts in the standard Social Planner workflow. Selecting the destination platform, content type, and relevant content details before generation gives Content AI the context it needs to create an editable first draft.

1. From your sub-account, navigate to **Marketing > Social Planner**.  
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155080971315/original/iNTxBqP5CDKWgcM5Ut7id0-cgyBIU3hM3Q.jpeg?1789475201)
2. Click **+ New Post** and select the option to create content using **Content AI**.  
     
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155080971293/original/fMD2-TzWb8Gd695YAVlG8Nkafz4vjflvEg.png?1789475192)

3. Select the social platform where you want to publish the content.  
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155080972474/original/-zcbyPo4aETTPgrpZDKTnDPfHnDNwDZ7pw.png?1789475764)

4. Select the appropriate **content type** for the post.

5. Select your **Brand Voice** if you want to use saved brand information.  
     
   Review the Brand Voice information and adjust any values you want to customize for this particular post.  
     
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155080972521/original/QERMjTZsPRaXq22xBmWB01dAFnlBx0kB-w.jpeg?1789475809)

6. Complete the required **Guided Content Questions**.  
     
   Provide clear information about what you want the post to communicate. Expand and answer optional questions when you want to give Content AI additional context.  
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155080972599/original/DvxtvO_zk0CsgmYwvASnaCFjIj1LKCNFaA.png?1789475844)

7. Click **Generate** to create the social post draft.  
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155080972746/original/VYyEQ2Onk2f5rlx_ZAbYUcYsfnvZKqo3_w.png?1789475905)
8. Review the generated content before publishing.  
     
   Check the copy for accuracy, tone, brand alignment, links, calls to action, and any information that should be changed before your audience sees it.  
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155080972653/original/iJPor01x5xo4YGuSJfyXWiU6zc8Yld5nhw.png?1789475877)

9. Make any necessary changes to the generated content. You can manually edit the draft or use the available AI-assisted editing options to refine it further.

10. Add or review any media required for your post.  
      
    Supported image, video, and other post requirements vary by social platform. See [Social Planner Content Guidelines - Image, Video, and Text](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/48001210585) if you need to verify platform-specific requirements.

11. Complete the normal Social Planner publishing workflow by choosing whether to **publish the post immediately or schedule it for later**.

---

## **Refine Your Generated Post**

AI-generated content should be treated as an editable draft rather than content that must be published exactly as generated. Social Planner provides multiple ways to refine the copy so you can correct details, adjust the wording, or better match the message you want to communicate.

After generating your draft, you can:

- **Edit manually:** Change any part of the generated text directly in the post editor.
- **Use Quick AI actions:** Apply available one-click AI editing actions to make targeted improvements to selected content.
- **Use Edit with Ask AI:** Provide custom instructions for how you want the content changed when a more specific revision is needed.

For example, you might ask AI to adjust the tone, rewrite a portion of the post, or make another contextual change before publishing.

For detailed instructions, see [Use Edit with Ask AI in Social Planner](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000005765).

---

## **Frequently Asked Questions**

**Q: Do I need to connect a social account before using Content AI in Social Planner?**

A supported social account should be connected to Social Planner before completing the publishing workflow. The accounts connected to Social Planner also determine which destinations are available when creating your post.

**Q: Do I need to create a Brand Voice before I can use Content AI?**

No. Brand Voice provides additional brand context for generated content, but you can create Content AI content without first configuring a Brand Voice.

**Q: Do the Guided Content Questions change depending on the social platform?**

Yes. Content AI can adapt the guided inputs based on the selected platform and content type so the information collected is relevant to the post being created.

**Q: Do I have to use Content AI to create posts in Social Planner?**

No. Content AI provides an AI-assisted creation workflow, but you can continue creating posts using Social Planner's standard post creation options when you prefer to write the content yourself.

**Q: Can I edit Content AI-generated content before publishing it?**

Yes. Generated content can be reviewed and edited before publishing. You can make manual changes or use available AI-assisted editing tools to refine the draft.

**Q: How can I provide feedback about Content AI output?**

Supported AI-generated content in Social Planner can be rated using the available **thumbs-up or thumbs-down** feedback controls. Selecting negative feedback may provide additional options for sharing information about the result. See [Thumbs Up/Down Feedback for Content AI](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000005517) for more information.

**Q: Are image and video requirements the same for every social platform?**

No. Supported formats, dimensions, file sizes, and other media requirements can differ between social platforms. Review the Social Planner content guidelines before publishing if your post includes media.

---

## **Related Articles**

- [Getting Started - Setup Social Planner](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000005063)
- [Brand Voice Integration in Content AI](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000005308)
- [Create a Brand Voice from Text or URL](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000007263)
- [Use Edit with Ask AI in Social Planner](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000005765)
- [Thumbs Up/Down Feedback for Content AI](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000005517)
- [Social Planner Content Guidelines - Image, Video, and Text](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/48001210585)

title_en: Dedicated Email Sending Domains Overview & Setup
source_md:
Email Services

# Dedicated Sending Domain

A dedicated sending domain gives your business full control over what email servers deliver on your behalf — helping you avoid spam filters, protect your brand reputation, and improve deliverability.

⚠️

LC Email Users Only

Dedicated sending domains apply **only** to accounts on the [LC Email system](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/48001222501). Warm up any brand-new domain before emailing large lists to avoid poor deliverability.

ℹ️

Using a Third-Party SMTP?

If you want to connect an external provider instead, see [Setting Up SMTP Providers](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/48001059689-setting-up-smtp-providers).

## What is a Dedicated Sending Domain?

A dedicated sending domain lets you send emails that appear to come directly from your brand — not from HighLevel's shared infrastructure. This protects your sender reputation and gives recipients a trustworthy, consistent experience. Any sub-account or agency can set one up quickly.

By default, all emails sent through the platform show HighLevel's sending servers in the **"sent on behalf of"** or **"sent via"** headers, as shown below:

![Default sent-on-behalf-of header](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/48265938968/original/spw7PyvCIf6DlxRXiukwE1KRAbxsW5nK9w.png?1669638686)

⚙️

## Configuring Dedicated Sending Domains

You can create multiple sending domains and assign different ones for 1-to-1 emails, workflow emails, marketing campaigns, and payment/invoice emails.

[동영상](https://www.youtube.com/embed/Hwi1PVclDEo?&wmode=opaque)

### Navigate to Email Services

- Go to **Settings → Email Services**
- Click the **"Dedicated Domain and IP"** tab.

![Settings Email Services](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155039358860/original/SDAmMz_uAVt2ybizJ-_9H4TdvCGO9uG8bw.png?1736193889)
![Dedicated Domain and IP button](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155039359007/original/fPkMuNjtNulufDsHraKqi_RhiT7kVj6i7g.png?1736194222)

---

### Add Domain Information

- Click **"Add Domain"** to begin configuring.
- Enter the sub-domain you want to use for sending.

![Add Domain flow](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155039359484/original/eF1kHVNdn9F8E4LQc47YnPLKxFqETCQFag.gif?1736195532)
?

What is a Sub-Domain?

Sub-domains are variants of your root domain. For example, if your root domain is **agency123.com**, you can create sub-domains like emails.agency123.com or no-reply.agency123.com.

You can create as many sub-domains as you like and use different ones for different campaigns or communication types.

---

### Verify DNS Records

After adding your sub-domain, you'll need to verify DNS records. HighLevel can auto-configure them, or you can add them manually if auto-configuration isn't available.

?

**Propagation can take up to 24 hours.** If it's been longer, double-check your DNS settings. Note: **Multiple DKIM records for the same domain are not supported.**

![Verify DNS flow](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155039360349/original/P-zGHtE40RWBS1c78K9-QxTVmAZcGYspOA.gif?1736198292)

#### Manually Adding DNS Records

To add DNS records manually, create them in your hosting provider's dashboard using the values HighLevel provides (as shown below). Then verify them from the HighLevel settings panel.

![DNS Records example](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155039360663/original/HzBGtABLJsce2UkbD9t9VMG5rxqjnhBPfg.png?1736199195)

Instructions for common DNS providers:

- ▸ [GoDaddy](https://www.godaddy.com/help/manage-dns-zone-files-680)
- ▸ [Google Domains](https://support.google.com/a/answer/48090?hl=en)
- ▸ [Hostgator](https://www.hostgator.com/help/article/manage-dns-records-with-hostgatorenom)
- ▸ [Hover](https://help.hover.com/hc/en-us/articles/217282457)
- ▸ [Namecheap](https://www.namecheap.com/support/knowledgebase/article.aspx/9214/31/cpanel-email-deliverability-tool--spf-and-dkim-records/)

- ▸ [AWS Route 53](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/Route53/latest/DeveloperGuide/resource-record-sets-editing.html)
- ▸ [Cloudflare](https://developers.cloudflare.com/dns/manage-dns-records/how-to/create-dns-records/)
- ▸ [Bluehost](https://www.bluehost.com/help/article/dns-management-add-edit-or-delete-dns-entries)
- ▸ [Hostinger](https://www.hostinger.com/tutorials/how-to-use-hostinger-dns-zone-editor)
- ▸ [InMotion](https://www.inmotionhosting.com/support/domain-names/create-cname-record/)

---

### Dedicated Sending Domains for Calendar Emails

You can assign dedicated sending domains specifically for Calendar emails (confirmations, reminders, reschedules) to protect deliverability for time-sensitive appointment communications.

① Go to Settings → Email Service → SMTP Service

![SMTP Service settings](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155064125555/original/Dy-QEZM3XvMs3u8XmtdQ29qdiEk6YH7vMw.png?1770150834)

② Select Dedicated Domain and IP

![Dedicated Domain and IP](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155064125509/original/617xc1HLrTXNE-33RpoYWkoBCPkU6T-nZw.png?1770150765)

③ Under Domain Configuration → Calendar, add up to 5 domains

![Calendar domain dropdown](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155064125759/original/T6e4IJkNkOpE5WWg4LVsxbIJt0zqHwPX-w.png?1770151371)

④ Set percentage-based distribution across multiple Calendar domains

![Distribution settings](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155064125862/original/PJo--R5OwIcyYgi5iiKypuhjotEyGck1PA.png?1770151576)

Only sub-account–created domains are available for selection. This feature is available for **LC Email users only**.

?

## Set Up Google Postmaster Tools

For your dedicated sending domain

Google Postmaster Tools (GPT) helps you monitor Gmail-specific deliverability for your HighLevel dedicated sending domain. Track domain/IP reputation, spam rate, authentication alignment, and delivery errors to diagnose inboxing issues and improve performance.

Sign in to Google Postmaster Tools

Visit [gmail.com/postmaster](https://gmail.com/postmaster/) with a Google account.

Add your domain (e.g., `yourbrand.com` or `mail.yourbrand.com`)

![GPT add domain](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155064881962/original/qmIt0mt7eOEjspzPldDL1WuWoDHfmqav5Q.jpeg?1770994245)

Choose Verify and copy the TXT record

![GPT TXT record](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155064882021/original/0t5JorwG7N5BNjfTtJP0EcRwEQaQvrCT8g.png?1770994314)

Add TXT record to your DNS host exactly as shown, then save

![Add TXT to DNS](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155064888368/original/zt-XcQXZF4ZbVfVswWouRQGDDnWwyqCQZQ.png?1770996887)

Return to GPT and complete verification. Google may take some time to detect the record.

Send email from HighLevel using your verified dedicated domain.

After Google collects sufficient volume, review **Domain Reputation**, **IP Reputation**, **Spam Rate**, **Authentication**, and **Delivery Errors** dashboards.

?

## Shared Domain Email Refactoring

When using a shared sending domain (HighLevel-owned or an Agency Shared Domain), HighLevel automatically refactors the actual sent address to match the shared-domain infrastructure.

### How It Works

HighLevel keeps the From address you configured, but rewrites the sending address behind the scenes using a "plus" format:

# From address (as configured)

test@gohighlevel.com

# Shared domain (account-level)

mg.msgsndr.com

# Actual sent address

test+gohighlevel.com@mg.msgsndr.com

Applies To:

- All agency sub-accounts created after August 26th
- All locations under these agencies using shared domains
- Refactoring will be automatically applied to all existing agencies within the next 2 weeks

Existing agencies are **not impacted yet**. The same functionality is planned to be available in **Labs** for existing agencies for testing and gradual rollout.

✅

To avoid email refactoring and maintain your brand identity:

Set up a dedicated sending domain following the steps in this article. With a dedicated domain, your emails send exactly as configured — no modifications.

?

## Troubleshooting Dedicated Sending Domains

Below are common issues you may encounter when setting up your dedicated sending domains, along with how to resolve them without contacting support.

?

Error: "Domain already pointing to email server!"

This means your domain already has DNS records connected to a different service. You'll need to remove any existing **MX** or **SPF records** (even HighLevel ones) before connecting it here.

Use a free lookup tool to check your current records: [mxtoolbox.com/SuperTool.aspx →](https://mxtoolbox.com/SuperTool.aspx)

❓

## Frequently Asked Questions

Q: How do I choose a sending domain name for my account?

Use a unique subdomain not used for any other purpose. For example, if your root domain is **yourbrand.com**, create a subdomain like `mg.yourbrand.com` where **"mg"** is the subdomain portion.

Q: How do I set up a dedicated IP address?

Setting up a dedicated IP address is a separate process. [Click here to learn more about dedicated IP addresses →](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000001152)

Q: What do I do if some DNS records are not verified yet?

Force the verification process manually. If records still aren't verified after that, contact your hosting provider — there may be an issue they can help resolve on their end.

Q: How do I generate an SSL certificate for dedicated sending domains?

The SSL certificate is automatically generated when your domain is verified. If it's showing as verified but no SSL exists, re-verify by going through the full verification process again. If that doesn't work, contact your hosting provider.

Q: What if my domain has a wildcard DNS record?

Wildcard records (e.g., `*.yourdomain.com`) act as catch-alls, so any subdomain already "exists" by default — this causes a "pre-existing record" error.

**Fix:** Temporarily remove the wildcard record, verify the dedicated domain, then add the wildcard back. Alternatively, manually add DNS records for each subdomain to override the wildcard.

Q: Will my recipients see the refactored email address?

Yes — recipients will see the refactored sending address (e.g., `support+yourbusiness.com@mg.msgsndr.com`) in their email client.

Q: How can I prevent my email addresses from being refactored?

Set up a dedicated sending domain. With a dedicated domain, your emails will send with your exact From address — no modifications applied.

Q: Does refactoring affect my reply-to address?

No — refactoring only affects the sending address. Your reply-to address remains exactly as configured.

**Q: What is the difference between the sending email address and the reply-to email address? Can I use my root domain instead of a subdomain?**

The sending email address (From address) is used to send emails and must be authenticated using a dedicated sending domain, typically set up as a subdomain. The reply-to email address is where recipient replies are delivered and can be configured independently without requiring domain authentication.

While your From address can appear as a root domain email, using a subdomain for sending is recommended to protect domain reputation and improve deliverability. You can still set the reply-to address to your root domain email to receive replies in your main inbox.

title_en: Contact Activity Panel Upgrade: New Activity Cards, Filters, and Navigation
source_md:
The upgraded Contact Activity Panel in HighLevel provides a cleaner, more organized way to track activities and interactions associated with a contact. With new activity cards for opportunities, appointments, notes, and tags, along with advanced filters and expandable event details, users can review contact history more efficiently. The Activity panel is now positioned alongside Conversations by default, making it easier to switch between communication history and other contact events.

---

**TABLE OF CONTENTS**

- [What is the Contact Activity Panel?](#What-is-the-Contact-Activity-Panel?)
- [Key Benefits of the Contact Activity Panel](#Key-Benefits-of-the-Contact-Activity-Panel)
- [Activity Timeline and Redesigned Cards](#Activity-Timeline-and-Redesigned-Cards)
- [New Activity Cards: Opportunities, Appointments, Notes, and Tags](#New-Activity-Cards%3A-Opportunities,-Appointments,-Notes,-and-Tags)
- [Advanced Activity Filters](#Advanced-Activity-Filters)
- [Contact Activity Panel Placement and Customization](#Contact-Activity-Panel-Placement-and-Customization)
- [Frequently Asked Questions](#Frequently-Asked-Questions)
- [Related Articles](#Related-Articles)

---

## **What is the Contact Activity Panel?**

The Contact Activity Panel in HighLevel is a centralized timeline that displays recorded activities and interactions associated with an individual contact. It helps users understand what happened, when it happened, and who performed the activity, providing valuable context for sales, support, and follow-ups.

The upgraded panel introduces a refreshed interface with redesigned activity cards, additional activity types, and improved navigation. Activities are organized chronologically, and users can expand individual cards to review more information without leaving the Contact Detail Page.

---

## **Key Benefits of the Contact Activity Panel**

- Centralized Activity Tracking: Review opportunity updates, appointments, notes, tags, and other supported interactions in one location, providing a more complete view of the contact's journey.
- Faster Activity Navigation: Use Duration, Activity, and Users filters to locate relevant events quickly, even when a contact has an extensive activity history.
- Detailed Event Insights: Expand activity cards to review important information, including opportunity changes, appointment details, note updates, and tag modifications.
- Flexible and Organized Workspace: Switch between Conversations and Activity in the center panel, or customize the layout to position Activity in the right panel according to your team's workflow.

---

## **Activity Timeline and Redesigned Cards**

The refreshed Activity timeline organizes contact interactions chronologically, making it easier to understand recent activity and track changes over time. Redesigned cards use activity-specific icons, timestamps, and clear summaries to help users identify events without reviewing every detail.

Activities are grouped under date headings such as Today, Yesterday, or specific dates for older events.

Individual cards can be expanded or collapsed to reveal additional information while keeping the timeline easy to navigate.

Each activity card can display:

- Activity Type: The recorded event, such as Appointment booked, Opportunity created, Note updated, or Tag removed.
- Performed By: The user or system associated with the event.
- Timestamp: When the activity occurred.
- Activity Summary: Important information about the event or associated record.
- Related Links: Links to associated opportunities, appointments, or other records, when available.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155083555995/original/hqTwbyHGF6BSLY52F5ew-uva6l-sLV2LIQ.png?1792188978)

---

## **New Activity Cards: Opportunities, Appointments, Notes, and Tags**

The upgraded Activity panel introduces four additional activity-card categories to provide greater visibility into important contact interactions. Each card presents information relevant to its activity type, reducing the need to navigate between different modules to understand what changed.

### **Opportunities**

Opportunity activity cards track supported sales-related events, including opportunity creation, pipeline stage changes, status updates, and other important modifications.

Expanding an opportunity card can display:

- Opportunity name and ID.
- Opportunity status and value.
- Associated pipeline and stage.
- Assigned opportunity owner.

For example, an Opportunity created event displays the opportunity name, while the expanded view provides additional details about its pipeline, stage, status, and ownership. A related record link may also be available to open the opportunity.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155083555788/original/M5NaY9dcbat7ZV6n58I2oYoaM63OtViOZA.png?1792188054)

### **Appointments**

Appointment activity cards provide visibility into appointment bookings, rescheduling, cancellations, and status changes associated with a contact.

The activity summary can display the appointment title, date, and scheduled time. Additional details available through More info may include:

- Appointment date, time, and duration.
- Calendar and appointment owner.
- Appointment status and meeting type.
- Timezone and appointment identifiers.
- Source type, channel, and creation timestamp.

These details help users understand a contact's scheduling history without navigating to the Calendar module.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155083555801/original/z1qtsFH9BlCCwNje5YQbJBHaoM9xSZByJQ.png?1792188135)

### **Notes**

Note activity cards help users track important information added to or updated on a contact record. This provides visibility into internal observations, follow-up details, and information recorded by team members.

A note activity may display its title or a preview of the note content. Additional details can include:

- Note title and content.
- Note ID and color.
- Updated date.
- Source type and channel.

For supported events, users can open More info to review the recorded note information and associated event data.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155083555820/original/PsSWm2VcQvekH5O7ZVsbP-mqJgQzZcwjEA.png?1792188243)

### **Tags**

Tag activity cards help users track changes to contact categorization and segmentation, including tags being added, removed, or renamed.

Events involving multiple tags can display the number of affected tags, while labeled chips help identify individual tags.

For tag-renaming events, the expanded card can display:

- Previous tag name.
- Updated tag name.
- Tag category.
- Tag description.

The previous and updated names appear with an arrow indicating the change, making it easy to identify how the tag was renamed.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155083555834/original/CMYCDcMlhiebleB0_xnjj1X3ta1vzKudUw.png?1792188293)

---

## **Advanced Activity Filters**

Activity filters help users narrow the timeline to specific dates, event categories, or team members. This is particularly useful when reviewing contacts with numerous recorded interactions, allowing users to focus on the information most relevant to their current task.

The upgraded Activity panel includes three filters: Duration, Activity, and Users.

| Filter | Available Options | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **Duration** | Any time, Today, Yesterday, Last week, Last month, Custom date range | Filters activities by a selected time period. Choose **Custom date range** to select a specific start and end date using the calendar picker. |
| **Activity** | All activity, Opportunities, Messages, Appointments, Notes, Tags, Forms, Payments, Others | Displays activities associated with selected modules or event categories. Use the dropdown checkboxes to select the relevant activity types. For example, select **Opportunities** to review sales pipeline events or **Appointments** to review scheduling activities. |
| **Users** | All or specific users | Filters activities associated with selected team members. This helps users review individual interactions when multiple people manage the same contact. Select **All** to return to a broader activity view. |

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155083555883/original/ZzXA-MVuQg4EHAKDFE8EBzH2s6tQXX2ejg.png?1792188492)

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155083555886/original/ObM6vLldSZPIIavlOOH0h7g9cmRDiYeZzg.png?1792188504)

---

## **Contact Activity Panel Placement and Customization**

The Activity panel now appears in the center of the Contact Detail Page alongside Conversations by default. This placement makes it easier to switch between communication history and recorded contact activities without navigating across different areas of the page.

Users who prefer the previous layout can have the Activity panel positioned in the right panel through Contact Detail Page customization.

Available placement options include:

- **Center Panel:** Recommended for users who frequently switch between Conversations and Activity or review detailed activity cards.
- **Right Panel:** Useful for teams that prefer keeping Conversations as their primary center-panel workspace while accessing contact activities from the side.

Administrators can manage supported module placements through customized Contact Detail Page views.

For detailed instructions, see [How to Customize the Contact Detail Page](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000007588).

---

## **Frequently Asked Questions**

**Q: Why do some activities show "By System" instead of a user's name?**

Some activities are attributed to System rather than an individual team member. This indicates how the event was recorded and does not necessarily identify the underlying process responsible for the change.

**Q: Why is an appointment's activity timestamp different from its scheduled time?**

The activity timestamp indicates when the event was recorded, while the scheduled appointment time indicates when the meeting takes place. For example, an appointment booked today may be scheduled for a future date.

**Q: What should I do if an expected activity is missing from the timeline?**

Confirm that you are viewing the correct contact, review the selected Duration, Activity, and Users filters, and click Refresh. Event visibility also depends on whether the action was recorded as a supported activity.

**Q: Does the Contact Activity Panel display every action performed in HighLevel?**

No. The Activity panel displays supported events associated with the selected contact. It is not a complete record of every account-level action and should not be treated as a replacement for administrative Audit Logs.

---

## **Related Articles**

- [Contacts – All-New Contact Detail Page](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000006651-the-all-new-contact-detail-page)
- [How to Customize the Contact Detail Page](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000007588)
- [HighLevel Notes for Managing Contacts, Opportunities and Company Records](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000004555-adding-and-managing-notes)
- [Organize and Personalize Tags with Categories and Colors](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000008705-organize-and-personalize-tags-with-categories-and-colors)
- [Understanding Opportunities in HighLevel](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000001983-understanding-opportunities-in-highlevel)

title_en: How to Use Site and Funnel Analytics in HighLevel
source_md:
The Site and Funnel Analytics dashboard empowers you to quickly understand performance across funnels, websites, blogs, webinars, forms, surveys and QR codes. You can effortlessly track and analyze key metrics, optimize online presence and drive results with graph-based visual insights.

[동영상](https://www.youtube.com/embed/eYJ7cpkKOmY?&wmode=opaque)

---

**TABLE OF CONTENTS**

- [What is the Site and Funnel Analytics Dashboard](#What-is-the-Site-and-Funnel-Analytics-Dashboard)
- [Key Benefits of Site and Funnel Analytics](#Key-Benefits-of-Site-and-Funnel-Analytics)
- [Key Metrics in Site and Funnel Analytics](#Key-Metrics-in-Site-and-Funnel-Analytics)
- [Select Asset Type](#Select-Asset-Type)
- [Filter by Date Range and Asset](#Filter-by-Date-Range-and-Asset)
- [Interactive KPI Cards](#Interactive-KPI-Cards)
- [How to Use Site Analytics](#How-to-Use-Site-Analytics)
- [QR Code Analytics](#QR-Code-Analytics)
  - [1. Access QR Code Analytics](#1.-Access-QR-Code-Analytics)
  - [2. Review QR Scans and Unique QR Scans](#2.-Review-QR-Scans-and-Unique-QR-Scans)
  - [3. Analyze Scans by Device Type](#3.-Analyze-Scans-by-Device-Type)
  - [4. Analyze Top Browsers](#4.-Analyze-Top-Browsers)
  - [5. View Geographic QR Code Analytics](#5.-View-Geographic-QR-Code-Analytics)
  - [6. View Historical QR Code Analytics](#6.-View-Historical-QR-Code-Analytics)
- [Frequently Asked Questions](#Frequently-Asked-Questions)
- [Related Articles](#Related-Articles)

---

## **What is the Site and Funnel Analytics Dashboard**

Site & Funnel Analytics is the central workspace for measuring how your web assets attract, engage, and convert visitors. It provides a single, consistent place to review KPIs and charts without hopping between individual funnels, pages, or tools.

You choose one asset type to analyze (such as Funnels or Websites), optionally narrow to a specific asset, and set a date range.

The dashboard then summarizes results with clear KPI cards and visuals. Because the KPIs and visuals are tailored to the asset type you select, the view stays focused on the metrics that matter most while still giving you a fast path to explore deeper.

---

## **Key Benefits of Site and Funnel Analytics**

This feature aims to save you time and effort, allowing you to focus on what matters most, growing your business.

- **User-Friendly Interface:**Navigate through your data with ease, thanks to our intuitive design.
- **Actionable Insights:** Make informed decisions to optimize your funnels and websites for better performance.
- **Efficient:**Quickly identify trends and patterns without the hassle of manual data compilation.

---

## **Key Metrics in Site and Funnel Analytics**

- **Page Views:** See how many times any funnel, website or other asset was visited, along with insights on unique page views.
- **Page Views by Step:**Click any funnel, website, or webinar in the Page Views chart to drill down into step-level performance.
- **Opt-in:** Number of conversions in your funnel/website (e.g. purchased a product OR submitted a form/survey OR booked appointment).
- **Time on Page:**Length of time the user stayed.
- **Sales:**Revenue generated by your funnel/website.
- **Opt-in Conversion Rate:**Opt-ins divided by unique page views.

```
For information on additional metric definitions, see: Funnel & Website Stats Definitions.
```

---

## **Select Asset Type**

Start by choosing the asset family you want to analyze. This selection is required and only one asset type can be active at a time. This selection determines which KPI cards and charts appear in the dashboard.

Use the dropdown to choose one asset type from the following options: Funnels, Websites, Blogs, Webinars, Forms, Surveys, QR Codes, or External Tracking.

```
Note: The metrics shown in the dashboard change based on the selected asset type.
```

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155063812398/original/PwR6sv1S-lkGiAkwJrHTxMqcygx2NSNTkw.png?1769726971)

---

## **Filter by Date Range and Asset**

Focus your analysis by applying two filters: pick a specific asset and set a date range.

### **Filter by Specific Asset (Optional)**

Choose a single asset within the currently selected asset type (e.g., a specific funnel, website, blog, webinar, form, survey, or QR code). Leaving this set to **All** aggregates results for all assets in that type. Changing the Asset Type resets this filter to All.

**![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155084305574/original/1vCdlr7FgnQauAbn6mTsgFmfnHWEHJt1Xw.png?1793103797)**

### **Filter by Date Range**

Use the date range picker in the upper-right to select a time period to filter the data. This allows you to view detailed timelines of page views, opt-ins, sales, and order conversion rates for your chosen duration. The dashboard compares data from this time period to the immediately previous matching period.

The date range defaults to **Last 14 days**.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155084305685/original/QUZohNs6mt0hddP8ZDMKQhU1vQE8QniGKw.png?1793103853)

---

## **Interactive KPI Cards**

KPI cards act like tabs. Selecting a KPI card updates the charts and breakdowns below to explore that metric in depth. Some asset types have fewer (or zero) KPI cards.

```
Note: The metrics shown in the dashboard change based on the selected KPI card.
```

**![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155063811885/original/J0cUyiKprRdG8Ttw99euUSIxgLEShz8AcA.jpeg?1769725482)**

---

## **How to Use Site Analytics**

#### **Step 1:** Navigate to Analytics

From your location dashboard, use the left-side navigation bar to go to **Sites**. Select the **Analytics** tab from the top navigation ribbon.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155063720257/original/Z9EarHA2C261BFLN856U9ki9oyk0iDUVBw.png?1769640197)

#### **Step 2:**Select Asset Type

Use the dropdowns to selectanasset type (e.g. Funnels) and optionally choose a specific asset to narrow the focus.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155063876592/original/kSAYyhJ2QIA1FwpCVwjJctLCAeSB0R71vw.jpeg?1769787689)

#### **Step 3:**Set Date Range

Choose a **Date Range** that matches your goals.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155063876707/original/FD3KBD7Iz1fOzvoWVWzSzI01vETcJzG_hQ.jpeg?1769787771)

#### **Step 4:** Explore Your Data

Click KPI cards to refocus charts, scan trends and breakdowns. Repeat as needed for other asset types, assets or time frames.

**![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155063876889/original/uNvCzwLpQnJekaGgqfAGzGLTErAV1VJ-LQ.jpeg?1769787913)**

---

## **QR Code Analytics**

QR Code Analytics helps you understand how your QR Codes perform by displaying scan activity, device types, browsers, and geographic locations. You can use these insights to identify engagement trends and optimize your QR Code campaigns.

### **1. Access QR Code Analytics**

1. Navigate to **Sites → Analytics**.
2. Select **QR Codes** from the asset type dropdown.
3. Select **All** to view combined analytics, or choose a specific QR Code.
4. Use the date range picker to select the period you want to analyze.
5. Review the available scan metrics and reporting charts.

**![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155084304500/original/khJvmmy649IOHNUJdHWayRYC9sUaMxdLCw.png?1793103373)**

### **2. Review QR Scans and Unique QR Scans**

The dashboard displays two scan metrics:

- **QR scans:** The total number of recorded QR Code scans.
- **Unique QR scans:** The number of unique scans recorded during the selected period.

The scan chart shows activity over time, helping you identify changes in QR Code engagement.

### **3. Analyze Scans by Device Type**

The **Scans by device type** chart displays the distribution of QR Code scans across device categories.

The dashboard includes the following device types:

- Desktop
- Mobile
- Tablet
- Unknown

Use these insights to understand which devices your audience uses when scanning QR Codes.

### **4. Analyze Top Browsers**

The **Top browsers** section displays the browsers associated with QR Code scans.

You can view browser usage information for supported browsers, such as Chrome, Safari, and Edge.

This information helps identify the browsing environments commonly used to access your QR Code destinations.

**![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155084304587/original/ABKxxjL5d2zj9pQE6r0Usgw2EtPuOYWr-g.png?1793103410)**

### **5. View Geographic QR Code Analytics**

The geographic analytics section displays a map and location-based visitor information.

Use the **Top visits by** dropdown to choose the geographic breakdown.

#### **1. Country-Level Analytics:**Select **Country** to view visitor distribution by country. The **Countries** panel lists countries and their corresponding visitor counts.

**![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155084304861/original/4vNQfRNjmXEeMyENDWGpoAynsqy7NjWBrA.png?1793103533)**

#### **2. State-Level Analytics:**Select **State** to view visitor distribution by state or province. The **States / Provinces** panel displays regional visitor counts.

**![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155084305008/original/r64flIzlBIalcGTPfBVrEKhbtM8jOApbCA.png?1793103584)**

#### **3. City-Level Analytics:**Select **City** to view visitor distribution by city. The **Cities** panel lists cities and their corresponding visitor counts.

**![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155084305055/original/kC1MVSUDgYjauxebUhJuV9n8EHdaZMKFeQ.png?1793103609)**

### **6. View Historical QR Code Analytics**

Advanced QR Code Analytics supports scan data recorded from **August 28, 2024, onward**.

You can select a supported historical date range to review available device, browser, and geographic analytics for existing QR Codes.

This allows you to analyze supported historical scans without creating new QR Codes.

---

## **Frequently Asked Questions**

**Q: Why don’t I see KPI toggles for QR Codes?**  
QR Codes use a dedicated analytics view rather than the standard KPI card toggles. This view includes QR scans, unique QR scans, device types, browsers, and geographic insights by country, state, and city.

**Q: How is the previous‑period % calculated?**The dashboard compares your selected range to the immediately prior period of equal length (e.g., last 14 days vs. the 14 days before).

**Q: What affects data availability for External Tracking?**  
The External Tracking script must be installed and functioning on the external site. If missing or blocked, views/submissions won’t appear.

**Q: Can I see page views for a specific step of a funnel?**

Click an item in Page Views to view step-level performance and engagement metrics.

---

## **Related Articles**

- [Funnel & Website Stats Definitions](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000005698)
- [Funnel Statistics](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/48001190447)
- [Browsers and IPs in Funnel Analytics](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000004701)
- [Traffic Source Analytics for Sites](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000006772)
- [Top Countries, States and Cities in Funnel Analytics](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000004967)
