Skills teach Ask AI how you want work done. A Skill is a named instruction set that Ask AI applies whenever your request matches—or that you invoke on demand by typing **/skill-name** in the composer. Skills work in both text and voice chats.

You can write a Skill from scratch, upload an existing markdown playbook, or ask Ask AI to create one during a conversation. Once saved, a Skill becomes part of your personal library and is matched automatically when relevant.

**Write a Skill** — In **Customize → Skills**, provide a name, a one-line "use when…" trigger, and a markdown body that describes the process Ask AI should follow.

**Upload a Skill** — Drop a .md file and Ask AI reads it, names it, and summarizes it for you. Uploading the same file twice creates a versioned copy (e.g., "PDF Processing 2") instead of overwriting.

**Invoke on demand** — Type **/** in the composer to see your Skills library and pin a specific Skill to that message, bypassing automatic matching.

**Enable, disable, or remove** — A disabled Skill stays in your library but is invisible to Ask AI until re-enabled. You can also delete a Skill permanently.

**Self-maintaining Skills** — When you say "save this as a skill," Ask AI writes one. If a Skill turns out to be wrong mid-conversation, Ask AI can correct it iteratively, creating a self-learning workflow.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155078134848/original/mrXn_a9G2sj22MNNiAXDOLxo-aITnquJyg.png?1786454006)

Security First

No credentials are stored or shown to the AI

Ask AI stores only a reference to your connected account. Access tokens are minted per call, never persisted, and never logged.

## How to Connect an App

Follow these steps to link a new connector to Ask AI and configure which tools it may use.

Step 1

Open the Connectors panel

Click the **plus** icon in the Ask AI sidebar, then select **Connectors**.

Step 2

Browse the marketplace

Click **Manage Connectors** to open the MCP app browser. Search or scroll to find the app you want—Notion, GitHub, Canva, HubSpot, Cal.com, and more.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155078135225/original/uoppXEf_H2yu9SZRU6NEiNtT2TvUV5T30g.png?1786454111)

Step 3

Connect your account

Select the app and click **Connect**. You'll be redirected to authenticate with the service. Once authorized, the app appears in your **Connected apps** list.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155078135464/original/WZA1XBtJp0VYHaI2S68yrWpxrbZa1qn8NA.png?1786454187)

Step 4

Configure tools (optional)

Click the app name in **Connected apps** to see the full list of tools it offers. Toggle **All tools** off to individually enable only the actions you want Ask AI to use (e.g., **notion-search**, **notion-create-page**).

Step 5

Enable the connector

Flip the toggle next to the app name to **Enabled**. Ask AI will now use that connector when fulfilling your requests.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155078135619/original/jZg98NjxdE8oXFmlYxn7DY4vTlDWhoAUgA.png?1786454246)

Quick Tip

You can also access the connector toggle from the composer **+** menu at the bottom of any Ask AI chat.

## How to Create or Upload a Skill

You can create a Skill in three ways: let Ask AI write it for you, upload an existing document, or write it manually. Once created, you can enable, disable, or delete Skills at any time.

Option 1: Create with Ask AI

Step 1

Start a chat and describe your workflow

In any Ask AI conversation, say something like "Save this as a skill: When I ask you to generate a PDF report, use the following steps…" Ask AI will draft the Skill for you.

Step 2

Review and confirm

Ask AI shows you the generated Skill. Confirm to add it to your library, or refine it by providing more detail.

Option 2: Upload a Skill file

Step 1

Navigate to Skills

Click **Customize → Skills** in the Ask AI sidebar.

Step 2

Upload your .md file

Click **Upload a skill** and select a markdown file. Ask AI reads it, proposes a name and one-line summary, and adds it to your library. Uploading the same file twice creates a versioned copy (e.g., "Report Generation 2").

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155078135891/original/of7La46H-Ro1D3Itya7x3xA14-4sJaVaiw.png?1786454353)

Option 3: Write a Skill manually

Step 1

Click Write skill instructions

In **Customize → Skills**, click **Write skill instructions**.

Step 2

Fill in the form

Provide a **Name**, a **Use when…** trigger description (one line), and a **Markdown body** with the full process Ask AI should follow.

Step 3

Save

Click **Save**. Your new Skill appears in the library and is enabled by default.

Managing Skills

Invoke on demand

Type / to pick a Skill

In the Ask AI composer, type **/** and select a Skill from the dropdown. That Skill will be pinned to your message, bypassing automatic matching.

Disable or remove

Toggle or delete from the library

In **Customize → Skills**, toggle a Skill off to hide it from Ask AI without deleting it. Click the trash icon to remove it permanently.

Iterative Correction

If a Skill produces the wrong output mid-conversation, Ask AI can correct it on the fly. Provide feedback ("That didn't work; update the Skill to…"), and Ask AI will revise the Skill instructions iteratively.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155078135971/original/Euz__p9EYFw5K8T4VTeD4Yc0ZD44P8tqJQ.png?1786454401)

## Security and Reliability

Ask AI Connectors and Skills are designed to be secure by default and resilient to common failure modes. Your credentials, tools, and instructions are scoped to your user account and never shared across organizational boundaries.

Your library is yours

User-scoped storage

Skills and connector settings are keyed to your user within a company. Agency and sub-account scopes never leak into each other.

No credentials in Ask AI

Token-less architecture

Ask AI stores only a reference to your connected account. Access tokens are minted per call, never persisted, never shown to the AI, and never logged.

Isolated connector execution

A broken connector can't break your chat

Each app is isolated, so one failing integration is dropped for that turn while everything else keeps working.

Self-healing connections

Automatic account repair

If a connected account is rotated or reconnected elsewhere in HighLevel, Ask AI finds the healthy reference and repairs the saved setting on its own.

Privacy by Design

No connector or Skill data is shared across users, sub-accounts, or agencies. Your connections and instructions remain private to you.

## Frequently Asked Questions

Q: Are Connectors and Skills available on all HighLevel plans?

Connectors and Skills are part of Ask AI, which is available to all HighLevel users. Specific MCP apps in the marketplace may have their own authentication or subscription requirements.

Q: Can I connect the same app to multiple HighLevel accounts?

Yes. Connectors are user-scoped, so you can connect different app accounts in different HighLevel sub-accounts or agencies. Each connection is independent and isolated.

Q: How do I revoke access to a connector?

Toggle the connector off in **Customize → Connectors**, or disconnect it via **Manage Connectors**. You can also revoke access from the third-party app's settings (e.g., Notion's integrations page).

Q: What happens if I upload a Skill file twice?

Ask AI creates a versioned copy with a number suffix (e.g., "Report Generation 2") instead of overwriting the original. You can then enable, disable, or delete any version.

Q: Can I share a Skill with my team?

Skills are currently user-scoped. To share, export your Skill as a .md file (copy the markdown body) and have your teammate upload it to their own Ask AI library.

Q: Does Ask AI use my connector credentials for training?

No. Connector credentials and access tokens are never logged, never shown to the AI model, and never used for training. Ask AI sees only the data returned by the tool call, which it uses to fulfill your request.

Q: What is the Browser Control connector?

Browser Control lets Ask AI open pages, click, fill forms, and complete multi-step tasks in a supported Chromium-based browser (Chrome, Edge, Brave, Arc). You must install the Ask AI Chrome extension to enable this connector.

Q: How does Ask AI decide which Skill to use?

Ask AI matches your request against the "use when…" triggers of all enabled Skills. If multiple Skills match, it picks the best fit. You can override automatic matching by invoking a Skill with **/skill-name**.

title_en: Account Billing Dashboard
source_md:
Billing • Sub-Accounts

Billing Dashboard

The Billing Dashboard gives sub-account users one place to manage subscriptions, payment methods, billing information, invoices, transaction history, and wallet balances. It also supports saved-card management and SaaS V2 primary-card synchronization for the sub-account's active SaaS subscription. Use this guide to understand each billing area and manage common billing tasks.

What You'll Learn

Learn how to manage subscriptions and payment methods, delete saved cards, update billing information, review invoices and transactions, and monitor wallet balances from the sub-account Billing Dashboard.

# What Is the Billing Dashboard?

The Billing Dashboard is the central location for managing financial activity within a HighLevel sub-account. Keeping billing settings in one place makes it easier to review current subscriptions, payment methods, invoices, transaction history, and wallet funds.

From the Billing Dashboard, you can manage:

- Subscriptions
- Payment methods
- Billing information
- Charges, invoices, and transaction history
- Wallet balances

To open the Billing Dashboard, go to **Settings > Billing** in the sub-account.

![Sub-account Billing Dashboard in Settings](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155081957125/original/XnSTGWITHWlGr40gmEhrph5NXcZZVdgm-A.png?1790572666)

## Manage Subscriptions

The Subscriptions area provides a consolidated view of recurring services connected to the sub-account so you can monitor the billing relationships that are currently active.

- **SaaS subscriptions:** Manage software-as-a-service subscriptions associated with the sub-account.
- **Reselling subscriptions:** Review subscriptions related to resold services.
- **Marketplace app subscriptions:** Oversee subscriptions for Marketplace applications connected to the account.

![Billing Dashboard showing sub-account subscriptions](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155081957130/original/D8q1vWiONvWxXEgMClXu8y6XjPdV6fVngA.png?1790572675)

## Payment Methods

Payment Methods controls which saved cards are available for supported billing activity. Keeping the primary card current helps reduce interruptions to wallet recharges and, for eligible SaaS V2 accounts, keeps the active SaaS subscription aligned with the selected primary card.

- **Add New Cards:** Add a new payment method when another card is needed.
- **Delete Existing Cards:** Remove outdated or unused saved payment methods.
- **Set Primary Card:** Choose the default card used for supported billing activity.

| Billing Use | Primary Card Behavior |
| --- | --- |
| **SaaS V2** | **For an active SaaS V2 subscription, changing the sub-account's primary card also updates the payment method used for that sub-account's SaaS subscription. Other subscriptions associated with the same contact are not updated.** |
| **Wallet recharges** | For SaaS V2 sub-accounts, the primary card continues to be used for wallet recharges. |

![Payment Methods area showing saved cards and primary-card controls](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155081957132/original/LyHhV1CifVXzP-OOhhpvrLmO0r4rXL3aRg.png?1790572686)

## Delete a Saved Payment Method

Removing unused cards keeps the Billing Dashboard organized and reduces the chance that a user selects an outdated payment method. SaaS V2 sub-accounts can delete saved payment methods directly from the Billing Dashboard.

1. From the **Sub-Account view**, select **Settings** in the left menu.
2. Select **Billing**.
3. Select the **Payments** tab.
4. Open **Manage your payment methods** from the **Payment Method** area.
5. Locate the saved card you want to remove.
6. Click the **three dots (⋮)** next to the card.
7. Select **Delete Card**.

![Saved payment methods menu showing the Delete Card action](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155081957139/original/3EAmVCmSwW1MPQATrCwjAOTNhAqGUVj3mA.png?1790572713)

8. Review the deletion confirmation.
9. Click **Delete Now** to remove the saved payment method, or click **Not now** to cancel.

**Important:** HighLevel may display a warning when the selected card funds active subscriptions. Review and update those subscriptions before deleting the card to reduce the risk of future payment failures.

![Delete payment method confirmation warning for a saved card](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155081957162/original/WFXch_IZwvgKAtRtQ0VflQk1H5A_DPmgTg.png?1790572759)

**Note:** Saved payment method deletion is available to SaaS V2 sub-accounts. SaaS V1 already supported saved-card deletion.

## Update Billing Information

Accurate billing information supports successful transactions and helps meet billing requirements in regions where a current billing address is required for recurring products.

- **Update Billing Address:** Edit the billing address to keep the account's billing information current.

![Billing Information area for updating a sub-account billing address](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155081957107/original/7xvNk8z1AoXZySBtFptMkHKVTysMdTKsAw.png?1790572636)

## View Charges and Transaction History

Charges and transaction history provide visibility into what the sub-account has been billed for and make it easier to identify invoices, products, transaction IDs, and external charges.

- **Detailed Charges Overview:** Review a list of charges associated with the account.
- **Invoices:** View invoice details, identify products connected to each charge, and download invoices when needed.
- **Transaction History:** Review past transactions to monitor account spending.

![Billing charges and transaction history view](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155081957167/original/bifsfRPnj7Oa2D2vDFmGyabrtECoeQpfLQ.png?1790572781)

### View and Manage Invoices

The invoice list provides enough context to understand each charge before you open or download the invoice.

![Invoice list showing charge details and products](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155079551373/original/AnrFdRJVtKAyTU6Oz9b0omNs4ZC8_bjrqQ.png?1787922325)

#### Identify Products on an Invoice

The Products column helps you identify which products contributed to a charge before opening the invoice.

For an invoice with multiple products, the first product name appears with a **+n** badge showing the number of additional products. Hover over the badge to view all product names included on the invoice. Invoices containing one product show only the product name, and long product names may be truncated with an ellipsis.

![Products column showing multiple products on an invoice](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155079551615/original/qQDhqDImThUqXk5bemVluHgIF__aEVM7ug.png?1787922454)

#### View and Copy the Transaction ID

Transaction IDs help identify individual invoice rows when you need to reference a specific billing event.

The Transaction ID appears truncated in the table. Click the copy icon next to the Transaction ID to copy the full ID to your clipboard. You can also view the full Transaction ID from the invoice details.

![Transaction ID with copy control in the invoice list](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155079551681/original/0zEb6abZZc2Mza97IydkE8MUW9XEW60Qfw.png?1787922503)

#### View Invoice Details

Invoice details provide a focused view of the charge without automatically downloading the invoice PDF.

Click **View** for an invoice to open details that include:

- Invoice ID
- Invoice type
- Date
- Amount
- Card
- Status
- Products

Close the invoice details by clicking the **X** or clicking outside the modal.

#### View or Download an Invoice

Invoice actions let you either continue into Stripe for more details or download a PDF copy for your records.

![Invoice details showing View in Stripe and Download Invoice actions](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155079551873/original/opglcUuV60zVqEeC-npIg9UDiOlHvxvUYg.png?1787922594)

- **View in Stripe:** Opens the Stripe invoice in a new browser tab.
- **Download Invoice:** Downloads the invoice as a PDF.

#### Identify External Charges

Invoices and products originating outside the HighLevel platform display an **External** badge in the invoice list and invoice details. Use the badge to distinguish external charges from charges originating within HighLevel.

## Understanding Wallet Balances

The Wallet lets a sub-account add funds in advance and use those funds as credits for paid services. Auto-recharge helps maintain the wallet balance so supported services can continue without interruption when credits fall below the configured threshold.

When wallet credits drop below the configured amount, the default card is automatically charged and additional credits are added to the wallet.

- **View Current Balance:** See available wallet funds at a glance.
- **Monitor Complimentary Credits:** Track complimentary credits provided to the account.
- **Manage Funds:** Add funds to help keep supported paid services running.

![Wallet balance and wallet funding controls in the Billing Dashboard](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155081957118/original/W0F-vgajOf7GlcOjwqkqg1L7yGzI9Q6lVA.png?1790572657)

## Frequently Asked Questions

Q: Why aren't my customers receiving receipts for wallet reloads or SaaS plan rebills?

Customers do not automatically receive receipts for wallet credit reloads. These wallet transactions are visible to the agency but are not sent to the client by default. For SaaS plan rebills, receipts are handled by Stripe. To send them, go to your Stripe account's email receipt settings and enable receipt emails for successful payments.

Q: How can I add a new payment method?

Open the Payment Methods area in Billing, click **Add New Card**, and enter the required card details.

Q: Is it possible to have multiple active subscriptions?

Yes. SaaS, reselling, and Marketplace app subscriptions can be managed from the Subscriptions area.

Q: How do I update my billing address?

In Billing, locate the Billing Information area and use the available edit control to update the billing address.

Q: Where can I view my past invoices?

Use the Charges and Transaction History area in Billing to view invoice details and download available invoices.

Q: How do I add funds to my wallet?

In the Wallet area, click **Add Funds** and follow the prompts to add the desired amount to the wallet balance.

title_en: Phone System Pricing & Billing Guide
source_md:
Overview

This guide outlines the full pricing structure for the native Phone System within the platform, including phone number rental, SMS/MMS messaging, voice calling, carrier pass-through charges, and A2P registration. Pricing matches Twilio's rates.

All prices are in USD.

**Ready to purchase a phone number?** For detailed instructions, see [How to Purchase a Phone Number](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000003226). To purchase a toll-free number, see [How to buy a toll free number.](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/48001204834)

## Phone Numbers

All phone numbers are charged monthly. Below are the US/Canada rates:

| Number Type | Monthly Cost |
| --- | --- |
| Local Numbers | $1.15 / month |
| Toll-Free Numbers | $2.15 / month |

Note

For all other countries, refer to the country-specific pricing PDFs attached at the bottom of this page.

## Messaging — SMS & MMS

SMS

Per-segment pricing — US/Canada

MMS

For segment calculation details, refer to the [How to Calculate SMS and MMS Costs](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/48001203458-how-to-calculate-sms-and-mms-costs) guide.

Carrier Fees

Passed through by the recipient's carrier

Carrier fees are charged by the recipient's carrier on top of standard SMS/MMS rates. Amounts vary by carrier and message type.

| Carrier | SMS Out | SMS In | MMS Out | MMS In |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |

## Voice

Voice call costs are billed per minute. Below is the breakdown for US and Canada, plus additional charges for recording, transcription, and related services.

Outbound Calls

**Total: ~~**~~~~$0.0180~~~~**~~ $0.0166 / minute**  
*(Discount on US & Canada outbound calling rates)*

**Total: ~~~~**~~~~$0.0129~~~~**~~~~ $0.01165 / minute**

International Forwarding

BILLING $ REGIONALS NOTES  
Calls are billed in full minutes, any partial minute rounds up. Calls to **Alaska** and **Yukon Territory** follow Twilio's regional pricing, not standard US/Canada rates.

## A2P Pricing

A2P Brand and Campaign registration fees for Low Volume and High Volume campaigns:

| Type | Daily Segment Limit | Monthly Campaign Fee | One-Time Registration Fee |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Sole Proprietor | 3,000 segments/day | Upto $2.10 /Campaign | $22.50 (incl. $3 Fast Track) |
| Low Volume (LV) | 6,000 segments/day | $1.50- $10.50 /Campaign | $22.50 (incl. $3 Fast Track) |
| High Volume (HV) | 6,00,000 segments/day | $10.50 /Campaign | $64.00 (incl. $3 Fast Track) |

IMPORTANT

- **Submitting your campaign starts both your one time registration fee and monthly campaign fee, regardless of the review outcome.**
- **Don't want to continue?** Delete your campaign to stop future monthly charges.
- The **$3 Fast Track fee** is **non-refundable** and speeds up the campaign review process.
- **Starting February 1, 2026:** A2P campaign resubmissions are **free**. The previous **$15 resubmission fee** has been removed.

## Pass-Through Charges & Re-billing

Certain communication products are classified as **pass-through charges**.  
A fixed **5% markup** is applied to these charges at the location (sub-account) level, only when re-billing is enabled.

Which charges get the 5% markup?

| Category | Description |
| --- | --- |
| A2P Registration Fees | One-time Brand Registration, Campaign Registration, and recurring monthly campaign fees. |
| SMS Carrier Fees | Carrier surcharges applied by mobile carriers for inbound and outbound SMS messages. |
| MMS Carrier Fees | Carrier surcharges applied by mobile carriers for inbound and outbound MMS messages. |
| Verified Caller ID | Charges associated with the Verified Caller ID service. |
| RCS Messaging Carrier Fees | Carrier fees associated with Rich Communication Services (RCS) messaging. |

How Re-billing Works

The 5% markup  applies to the categories listed above, if your agency has re-billing enabled.

- **Re-billing enabled:**  
  Base cost → +5% location markup
- **Re-billing disabled:**  
  No re-billing markup is added.

Example (Base SMS Carrier Fee = $10.00, Agency Reselling Multiplier = 2x)

| Item | Rebilling Enabled | Rebilling Disabled |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Base carrier fee | $10.00 | $10.00 |
| 5% location markup ($10.00 × 1.05) | $10.50 | $10.00 |
| Agency rebilling ($10.50 × 2) | $21.00 | — |
| Final amount billed to the location | $21.00 | $10.00 |

Where to configure Re-billing?

Agency owners configure re-billing from **Agency View → Reselling → Core Services**. From there you can:

- Set the Resell Amount (re-billing multiplier) for supported platform services.
- Set custom pricing for Marketplace Apps.
- Control the pricing your sub-accounts (locations) pay for supported products.

Key Points

- The 5% markup always applies to the pass-through categories listed above, at the location (sub-account) level if rebilling is enabled.

## Number Intelligence

Number Intelligence is a bundle of three functions that are turned on/off together. Refer to **Number Intelligence — Number Validation, Spam Detection, and Unknown Caller** for full details.

![Number Intelligence settings](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155074921397/original/BjtQ36oYFNcmxgwnzeDrTp947lm9jNgt5A.png)

- **Number Validation — $0.005 / call:** Before sending an SMS, check if the number is valid. If invalid, the SMS is not sent.
- **Spam Detection — $0.005 / test:** When receiving an incoming US call, test it for spam and mark as "spam likely" if it fails.
- **Name Lookup — $0.01 / lookup:** When receiving an incoming US call, look up the caller's name if the number is not linked to a contact or the contact name is empty.
- **Number Format Lookups:** All number format lookups to support calls are free of cost.

## Frequently Asked Questions

Q: Why am I being charged for incoming SMS?

The native phone system charges for both inbound and outbound SMS at the same rate.

Q: Will SaaS rebilling work if I move sub-accounts to the native Phone System?

Yes, SaaS rebilling will continue to work with the native Phone System.

Q: Which categories have a 10% discount applied?

**Phone Numbers** — US and Canada only, all number types.  
**SMS** — US/Canada to US/Canada only, both inbound and outbound.  
**Voice Calls** — US/Canada to US/Canada only, both incoming and outgoing (excludes items listed in Additional Voice Charges).

Q: I was billed $20 right away but haven't made any calls. Is this expected?

Yes. The wallet auto-recharged as soon as the balance dropped below the threshold set in the wallet configurator.

![Wallet configurator](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155074921482/original/fRdWrXrG4mZyZYHUrBkJuFzpnuX9Y_1eMg.png)

Q: Will I be charged if I encounter an error when sending an SMS?

If there's an internal error before the message is handed off to the phone provider, you won't be charged. However, charges apply to every message where a delivery attempt has been made — regardless of the final delivery status. This includes toll-free numbers, A2P numbers, and messages undeliverable due to country restrictions. Refunds will not be provided for undelivered SMS.

Q: Why am I getting charged for Call Recording Storage even though I didn't record calls recently?

Any call recording stored — including older recordings — incurs ongoing storage charges billed daily per sub-account. To avoid these charges, go to **Settings → Phone Numbers → Advanced Settings → Voice Calls → Call Recording** to automatically delete older recordings, or set the deletion period to 1 day and disable call recording for future calls.

![Call recording settings](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155074920889/original/3QRuC0klOSV2enbNRc8_wM_gz53n8JTg3g.png)

Q: Why do I pay Conference Call charges for all outgoing calls, even without a transfer?

The outgoing call flow is optimised for seamless, low-latency transfers. A Conference Call is initiated for all outgoing calls as part of the standard call flow implementation.

title_en: Test Workflow
source_md:
## **Table of Contents**

- [Overview](#overview)
- [Key Benefits](#key-benefits)
- [Ways to Test](#ways-to-test)
- [Test a Trigger](#test-a-trigger)
- [Test an Action](#test-an-action)
- [Test the Whole Workflow](#test-the-whole-workflow)
- [Review History and Retry a Run](#review-history-and-retry-a-run)
- [Run and Step Statuses](#run-and-step-statuses)
- [Things to Know](#things-to-know)
- [Use Case](#use-case)
- [FAQs](#faqs)

## **Overview**

Test Workflow lets you check a workflow before it goes live. You can test a single trigger with a real event from your account, test a single action with that event’s data, or run the whole workflow step by step and watch each step pass or fail.

Every test runs the real steps, so when a test works, you know the workflow works.

## **Key Benefits**

- **Real data:** test with real events from your own account, not made-up values.
- **One step at a time:** test a trigger or a single action without running the whole workflow.
- **Live progress:** watch each step of a whole-workflow test run on the canvas.
- **Faster debugging:** open any step to see its input and output, and retry a run in one click.
- **Confidence to publish:** go live knowing every step has already worked.

## **Ways to Test**

The Test tab on a trigger, and the Test workflow panel, offer two ways to test.

| **Option** | **What it does** | **Use it when** |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **Test using events** | Listens for the next real event in your account for 15 minutes and runs the test on it. | You can fire the trigger yourself, for example by submitting the form. |
| **Enroll a contact** | Runs the test for a contact you pick, as if the trigger fired for them. | Firing a real event is not practical. |

## **Test a Trigger**

This example tests a Form Submitted trigger with a real form submission.

### **Step 1: Open the Test tab**

Click the trigger on the canvas. In the panel that opens, click the Test tab next to Setup. Choose Test using events.

![The Test tab on a Form Submitted trigger](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155083699859/original/-HgLokCLFgT3YSGxZK3OW5GruYN2C2YCnw.png?1792438853)

*The Test tab on a Form Submitted trigger*

### **Step 2: Switch on Listen for events**

Turn on the Listen for events toggle. The panel shows how much listening time is left and how many events were recorded.

![Listening for events, with the time left and the events recorded](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155083699860/original/gnbKXy4krdvtyXZjV9ZkrWt1XBSGzUhnVA.png?1792438859)

*Listening for events, with the time left and the events recorded*

### **Step 3: Fire the trigger**

Do the thing that fires the trigger. For Form Submitted, open the form and submit it. The event appears in the panel within seconds.

Select the event under Select event. Event data lists every field it carries, including the form fields and the contact details.

![A recorded event and its event data](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155083699863/original/my0wteO24M3kxefJpLX_NwJJXfPG5TNbyg.png?1792438864)

*A recorded event and its event data*

### **Step 4: Click Test Trigger**

Click Test Trigger. When the test passes, the panel shows Trigger tested and the event is pinned. Every action below the trigger is tested with this event’s data.

![Trigger tested, with the pinned event as output](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155083699864/original/4MjOKtmzGQZw2EKWP_RgeVUuXVdn16hYRA.png?1792438869)

*Trigger tested, with the pinned event as output*

**Note:** Click Retest at any time to test the trigger again with a different event.

## **Test an Action**

### **Step 1: Review the setup**

Click the action on the canvas. On the Setup tab, check its fields. Fields that use custom values, such as Contact Full Name, are filled from the pinned event during the test.

### **Step 2: Run the test**

Open the Test tab. Input lists the values the action will use, built from the pinned event. Click Test action.

![The action’s input, filled from the pinned event](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155083699865/original/6xZWh1-HCfE3s2bLOuuHPbU63sQpCYEkqQ.png?1792438874)

*The action’s input, filled from the pinned event*

### **Step 3: Check the output**

When the test passes, the panel shows Action tested. Switch to Output to see the result, for example Success, the message and the new record’s ID. These fields are now available to later steps.

![Action tested, with the output of Create Opportunity](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155083699869/original/Xog3i_ETN1IKuSRNxiL3wCZaWaE58_gfMQ.png?1792438879)

*Action tested, with the output of Create Opportunity*

**Note:** The action runs for real. In this example, the test creates a real opportunity in the pipeline.

## **Test the Whole Workflow**

### **Step 1: Open Test workflow**

Click Test workflow in the top right of the builder. The Test workflow panel opens on the New test tab.

### **Step 2: Pick the trigger and the event**

Choose Test using events or Enroll a contact. Under Select Trigger, pick the trigger to run. Under Select event, pick the event to test with, or switch on Listen for events to record a new one. Check the event data, then click Start test run.

![The Test workflow panel with the trigger and event selected](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155083699875/original/Pt8fmywtE9NotPD3Ylvejtuf2LM0_O3-gQ.png?1792438902)

*The Test workflow panel with the trigger and event selected*

### **Step 3: Watch the run**

The workflow runs action by action. Each step on the canvas shows its status as it finishes, and the History tab shows the run as Test running.

![A test run in progress: finished steps show Success and the current step shows Running](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155083699879/original/uVlUPzbTmlmIMY9rTzI75oBBEM2WDVXFjw.png?1792438908)

*A test run in progress: finished steps show Success and the current step shows Running*

### **Step 4: Review the result**

When the run ends, the canvas shows the result of every step and History shows the final status, such as Completed with skipped steps. The canvas is read only while you view a run.

![A finished run: every step’s status on the canvas and the run in History](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155083699887/original/8O7VyhkhnTNjD4pp6oIB0P1uUrsbDQ0vBg.png?1792438915)

*A finished run: every step’s status on the canvas and the run in History*

Click any step to open its Input and Output. Use this to find the step that caused a problem.

![The output of one step from a test run](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155083699889/original/9V8zX0gtOdjGEJNkXN7HKfB6mhSs82RCUQ.png?1792438922)

*The output of one step from a test run*

## **Review History and Retry a Run**

Open the History tab in the Test workflow panel to see every test run. Filter the list by All, Success, Failed or Skipped.

![The History tab with a past test run](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155083699966/original/OILvWfAo7AdU1X3r3vpYNksw5WvvY5f5xw.png?1792439010)

*The History tab with a past test run*

To run the same test again, hover over a run and click Retry run. The retry uses the same trigger data and action configuration, and appears in History as a new run.

![Retry run on a past test run](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155083699970/original/2wsA1VfJWWSsYBsIZ5_hn6lgso5SLx41tA.png?1792439016)

*Retry run on a past test run*

## **Run and Step Statuses**

| **Status** | **Meaning** |
| --- | --- |
| **Test running** | The run is in progress. History shows the step that is running now. |
| **Success** | The step ran and finished without errors. |
| **Failed** | The step ran and returned an error. Open the step to see the error in its output. |
| **Action skipped** | The step did not run in this test run. |
| **Completed with skipped steps** | The run finished, and one or more steps were skipped. |

## **Things to Know**

- **Tests are real.** Messages are sent, and records are created or changed.
- **Testing is optional.** You can save and publish without testing.
- **The pinned event stays** until you retest the trigger with another event.
- **Listening lasts 15 minutes.** Switch it on again if your event did not arrive in time.

## **Use Case**

**Scenario:** A video agency builds a workflow for its Video Production and Editing Request form. When someone submits the form, the workflow creates an opportunity, sends a welcome email, adds a High Priority tag and creates a follow-up task.

The builder switches on Listen for events on the trigger, submits the form with their own details and tests the trigger with that event. They test Create Opportunity, check that the opportunity appears in the pipeline with the right name, then click Test workflow and run every step on a second event. The run shows each step’s result, so they publish the workflow knowing it works.

## **FAQs**

**Q: Does a test send real emails or create real records?**

Yes. Every test runs the real action. A test of Send Email sends the email, and a test of Create Opportunity creates the opportunity. Test with your own details or a test form entry when you don’t want to reach a customer.

**Q: What if no event arrives while I’m listening?**

Listening records events for 15 minutes. If nothing arrives, switch on Listen for events again and fire the trigger once more, for example by submitting the form.

**Q: Can I test a trigger without firing a real event?**

Yes. Choose Enroll a contact on the Test tab. The test runs for the contact you pick, as if the trigger fired for them.

**Q: Do I need to test the trigger before I test an action?**

Yes. An action test uses the data of the event pinned by the trigger test. Test the trigger first, then test the actions below it.

**Q: Do I have to test every step before I publish?**

No. Testing is optional. You can save and publish a workflow without running any test.

**Q: Where can I see a test I ran earlier?**

Click Test workflow and open the History tab. Every run is listed with its status, and you can filter by Success, Failed or Skipped.

**Q: What does Retry run use?**

The same trigger data and the same action configuration as the original run, so you can check a fix against the exact same event.

title_en: Manage Your Communities and Courses with GoKollab Studio

Kollab Studio is HighLevel’s creator hub, built to give community and course owners a single, streamlined place to manage all their digital products. Whether you’re updating content, adjusting pricing, or launching something new, Kollab Studio keeps everything organized in one dashboard so you can work faster and smarter.

[동영상](https://www.youtube.com/embed/CYbBBfTtIgs?&wmode=opaque)

---

**TABLE OF CONTENTS**

- [What is Kollab Studio?](#What-is-Kollab-Studio?)
- [Key Benefits of Kollab Studio](#Key-Benefits-of-Kollab-Studio)
- [Sales Page Media Preview for Communities](#Sales-Page-Media-Preview-for-Communities)
- [Structured Course Preview on Sales Pages](#Structured-Course-Preview-on-Sales-Pages)

- [Step 1: Navigate to Memberships → Gokollab Marketplace](#Step-1%3A-Navigate-to-Memberships-%E2%86%92-Gokollab-Marketplace)
- [Step 2: Open the Kollab Studio](#Step-2%3A-Open-the-Kollab-Studio)
- [Step 3: Manage your Communities and Courses](#Step-3%3A-Manage-your-Communities-and-Courses)
- [Communities Section](#Communities-Section)
- [Courses Section](#Courses-Section)
- [Best Practices for Using Kollab Studio](#Best-Practices-for-Using-Kollab-Studio)
- [Frequently Asked Questions](#Frequently-Asked-Questions)
- [Related Articles](#Related-Articles)

---

# **What is Kollab Studio?**

Kollab Studio is a centralized management hub in HighLevel that consolidates all your communities and courses into one workspace. Instead of navigating multiple pages to update or review your products, you can now handle everything from a single, intuitive dashboard. This eliminates scattered settings and gives you complete control over your digital offerings.   
  
Kollab Studio is perfect for:

- Community owners
- Course creators
- Anyone selling digital products via GoKollab

There’s no migration needed; all your existing communities and courses automatically appear in Kollab Studio.

---

## **Key Benefits of Kollab Studio**

The main advantage of Kollab Studio is efficiency, it gives you quick, organized access to every product you own, helping you keep offerings updated and members engaged.

- **Manage All in One Place**– Access all communities and courses from a single dashboard.
- **Move Faster** – Edit access, pricing, and content in seconds.
- **Stay Active & In Control** – Easily publish, unpublish, or tweak content as needed.
- **Boost Retention & Revenue** – Better tools help you deliver better products, which means more engaged members.
- **Preview Before Publishing** – Review enhanced sales pages before going live. Community sales pages can display media carousels, while course sales pages can show structured curriculum previews.

---

## **Sales Page Media Preview for Communities**

   
Community sales pages now support a media carousel that can display images and videos, including YouTube, Loom, and Vimeo videos. Media added to the community About page automatically stays synced with the sales page, so you do not need to update the listing separately.

The carousel auto-cycles through available media to give visitors a more dynamic preview of the community before they join.

---

## **Structured Course Preview on Sales Pages**

Course sales pages now display a structured curriculum preview. Visitors can review modules, lessons, and thumbnails in an organized format before enrolling.

This gives visitors a clearer view of the course content and helps them understand what they will access after joining.

---

## **How to Access Kollab Studio**

Accessing Kollab Studio takes just a few clicks from your HighLevel profile. Once inside, you’ll find separate tabs for managing communities and courses.

#### **Step 1: Navigate to Memberships → Gokollab Marketplace**

You can find the GoKollab URL here, which is nothing but your GoKollab Marketplace Dashboard.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155051213939/original/63T6gI6LOaC9EKA_ohT0iSRyt6VboQoETA.png?1754656174)

```
IMPORTANT: Make sure the email you use to sign in to the HighLevel dashboard and GoKollab is the same. This ensures your communities and courses are properly linked to your profile and visible in Kollab Studio. If your email addresses don’t match, your products may not appear.
```

#### **Step 2: Open the Kollab Studio**

After logging in to the GoKollab dashboard, under your profile icon in the top-right corner, select Kollab Studio from the dropdown menu.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155051214836/original/CoFVGAwV6E9YLK8_AAr2zwLDEa2ozWHxUQ.png?1754656491)

#### **Step 3: Manage your Communities and Courses**

Finally, getting a unified dashboard to manage your communities and courses more efficiently.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155051215664/original/OjLDbKVYEHonHIbp6Ok4mHsEdF1-fl3JuA.png?1754656750)

---

## **Communities Section**

 

The Communities section is your control center for all the communities you’ve created. Here, you can quickly preview, adjust, and control their visibility without navigating away from the dashboard.

   
Community sales pages now support a richer media experience. Images and videos from the community About page automatically sync to the sales page, so you do not need to update the same media in multiple places. The sales page can display this media in an auto-cycling carousel to help visitors understand your community before they join. 

Supported video sources include YouTube, Loom, and Vimeo.

You can:

 

- Preview enhanced sales pages for each community.
- Display images and videos in a sales page carousel.
- Publish or unpublish instantly.
- Access community settings directly from the menu.
- Stay on top of activity with unread post counts for each channel.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155051216024/original/vgdRFr9_uL8HM6V_KxTwynNOmqb3piL6kA.png?1754656900)

```
IMPORTANT: Only communities you have created will appear in Kollab Studio. If you are just a member or admin of a community created by someone else, it will not be listed here.
```

---

## **Courses Section**

The Courses section gives you a centralized view of all your training content. You can manage publish status, preview each course sales page, and review how your course appears to visitors before enrollment.

   
Course sales pages now include a structured curriculum preview. Visitors can see modules, lessons, and thumbnails in a clean format, which helps them understand the course content before enrolling. 

You can:

- View all courses in a single list.
- Preview enhanced course sales pages.
- Show modules, lessons, and thumbnails on the course sales page.
- Edit publish status with one click.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155051216541/original/pYehW4oZ_24GB08hCYouYiaRxrxk6APguQ.png?1754657034)

```
IMPORTANT: Only courses you have personally created in Memberships will display here. If you’ve added your course to the GoKollab Marketplace, it will also appear in Kollab Studio. Courses you have not created will not be shown. For more you can also refer to Getting Started - Launch a Course
```

---

## **Best Practices for Using Kollab Studio**

Using Kollab Studio effectively can help increase member engagement and product performance. These best practices will help you get the most out of it.

 

- Keep sales pages updated with fresh content and current offers.
- Add polished images and videos to your community About page. These media items can automatically appear on the community sales page carousel.
- Keep course modules, lessons, and thumbnails organized so visitors can clearly understand the course before enrolling.
- Refresh course and community content regularly to maintain member interest.
- Unpublish inactive products to keep your dashboard clean and organized.
- Keep your community About page media current, since supported media can appear on the community sales page.
- Use clear course modules, lesson titles, and thumbnails to improve the course sales page preview.

---

## **Frequently Asked Questions**

**Q: What is Kollab Studio?**  
Kollab Studio is a centralized dashboard in HighLevel that lets you manage communities and courses in one place.

**Q: How do I publish or unpublish a community?**  
In the Communities Section, use the toggle option to quickly change the publish status after previewing the sales page.

**Q: Can I edit course details within Kollab Studio?**  
Yes, you can adjust the publish status and preview each course’s sales page right from the Courses Section.

**Q: What appears on a community sales page?**

A community sales page can show images and videos in an auto-cycling media carousel. Media added to the community About page automatically syncs to the sales page. 

**Q: Which video sources are supported for community sales page media?**

Community sales page media supports YouTube, Loom, and Vimeo videos.

**Q: What appears on a course sales page?**  
A course sales page can show a structured curriculum preview with modules, lessons, and thumbnails. This helps visitors understand the course before enrolling.

**Q: Will there be additional editing features for courses?**  
Additional course editing options are on the roadmap and will be available in upcoming updates.

**Q: Do I need to migrate my existing data to use Kollab Studio?**  
No migration is necessary. All your current digital product data automatically integrates into the new dashboard.

**Q: Why don’t I see my courses or communities in Kollab Studio?**Kollab Studio only displays products you have created. For courses, you must have created them inside Memberships. For communities, you must be the original creator. Courses added to the GoKollab Marketplace will also display.

---

## **Related Articles**

title_en: How to Transfer Calls to Staff Without a Personal Phone Number
source_md:
Mobile Calling

# How to Transfer Calls to Staff Without a Personal Phone Number

Transfer inbound or outbound calls from the HighLevel mobile app to staff members using their configured Web App, Mobile App, phone, or SIP deskphone destinations.

What You'll Learn

You can transfer a live call to another staff member even when that person does not have a personal phone number connected to their HighLevel user profile. HighLevel uses the receiving staff member's available calling destinations to determine where the transferred call can ring.

This article explains how to prepare staff members to receive transferred calls, start a transfer from the mobile app, choose between a warm or blind transfer, and understand what the receiving staff member sees when the call arrives.

## How Call Transfers Without a Personal Number Work

A call transfer allows one staff member to hand an active customer call to another staff member. The receiving staff member does not need a dedicated personal phone number to receive the transfer. Instead, HighLevel checks the destinations enabled for that staff member under their Call & Voicemail Settings.

For example, a staff member may be configured to receive calls in the Web App and Mobile App but have no personal phone number assigned. That staff member can still appear as available in the transfer list because HighLevel has valid destinations where the transferred call can be delivered.

Supported call directions and transfer types

This works for both inbound and outbound calls and supports both warm and blind transfers.

## Configure Where Staff Can Receive Calls

Before transferring a call, make sure the receiving staff member has at least one destination enabled under **Forward Calls to**. These settings determine which devices or apps can ring when HighLevel sends that user a call.

Step 1

Open the staff member's settings

In HighLevel, go to **Settings → My Staff**, select the staff member, and open **Call & Voicemail Settings**.

Step 2

Review Forward Calls to

Enable one or more destinations that the staff member can use. Available destinations can include **Web App**, **Mobile App**, **My Phone Number**, and **Deskphone (SIP)**.

When more than one destination is enabled, the transferred call can ring those enabled destinations at the same time. The staff member can answer on whichever available device is most convenient.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155080947373/original/jdyps_pez8OB-3P3GZywiLQ4ZzF1I1BQdA.png?1789465174)Why a staff member may appear disabled

If a staff member has no eligible receiving destination configured, that person appears disabled in the transfer list and cannot be selected.

## Start a Transfer From the Mobile App

You can begin a transfer while you are already connected to a customer in the HighLevel mobile app. The original call can be inbound, where the customer called you, or outbound, where you called the customer.

Step 1

Connect to the call

Make an outbound call or answer an inbound call from the mobile app as usual.

Step 2

Tap Transfer

While the call is active, tap the **Transfer** icon in the upper-right area of the call screen.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155080947643/original/Kvo39kQY2frnWhCuyADppLXshu4vUC3GlA.png?1789465268)

## Choose a Staff Member

The transfer screen lets you select the person who should receive the call. HighLevel also shows device icons beside staff members so you can understand which destinations are available for each person before starting the transfer.

Step 1

Open the Staff Members tab

From the transfer screen, go to **Staff Members**. You can search for the person you want to receive the call.

Step 2

Check the available devices

Look at the icons displayed beside the staff member's name. These indicate where that person can receive the transferred call, such as the mobile app, Web App, phone, or SIP deskphone.

Step 3

Select the staff member

Tap the staff member you want to transfer the call to. Staff members without a configured receiving destination cannot be selected.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155080948303/original/yFpHoEzrOYDjlyWBzM7ao3DH2EPNEaGrXQ.png?1789465513)

## Choose a Warm or Blind Transfer

HighLevel supports two common transfer methods. The best option depends on whether you want to speak with the receiving staff member before handing over the customer.

Warm Transfer

Call and Hold

Choose **Call and Hold** when you want to place the customer on hold and speak with the receiving staff member first. This is useful when you need to provide context, explain why the customer is being transferred, or confirm that the other person is ready to take the call.

Blind Transfer

Transfer and End

Choose **Transfer and End** when you want to send the customer directly to the selected staff member and leave the call without first speaking to that person.

Which option should I choose?

Use a warm transfer when the next staff member needs context before talking to the customer. Use a blind transfer when no introduction is necessary and the call can be handed off immediately.

More Flexible Call Routing

Transfer to the Staff Member, Not Just a Personal Number

HighLevel can deliver the transfer through the staff member's configured calling destinations, helping teams receive transferred calls across the devices they already use.

## What the Receiving Staff Member Sees

Transferred calls include information that helps the receiving staff member recognize that the call is being handed off by another team member. The exact incoming-call display differs slightly between iOS and Android.

iOS

Contact name followed by the transferring staff member

On iOS, the incoming call can show the contact name followed by **via** and the name of the person transferring the call. For example: **John Doe via Michael Scott**.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155080948559/original/SMVrWvTB9aGfnFoxPmzEGCYHaf8kKpqSaQ.png?1789465606)

Android

Transferred call attribution

On Android, the incoming call screen identifies the call as transferred and shows who transferred it, for example: **Transferred call from Michael Scott**.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155080948974/original/5eQc1Z96dI3JWPGR9olQfbjL6vVCNr-rMQ.png?1789465782)

The receiving staff member taps **Answer** to accept the transferred call.

## Complete a Warm Transfer

A warm transfer gives you a short private conversation with the receiving staff member before the customer is fully handed over. During this process, the original customer remains on hold while you connect with your teammate.

Step 1

Wait for the staff member to answer

After you choose the warm-transfer option, the original caller is placed on hold while HighLevel calls the selected staff member.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155080949178/original/HAPSGqMCbyhxlaPyafrd6wLKEYcn4UYTJQ.png?1789465885)

Step 2

Provide any needed context

Once the staff member answers, explain who is calling and why you are transferring the conversation. This gives the receiving person the information they need before speaking with the customer.

Step 3

Finish the handoff

Complete the warm transfer using the normal transfer controls. The receiving staff member can then continue the conversation with the customer.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155080949264/original/uWISq_FnIlm1yRQjoQoC0p9VPtOVKq9_zg.png?1789465944)

## Important Behaviors and Limitations

Understanding how HighLevel routes transferred calls can help you configure staff correctly and avoid confusion when a person appears unavailable in the transfer list.

**Multiple enabled destinations can ring together** — If a staff member has several destinations enabled under **Forward Calls to**, HighLevel can ring those destinations at the same time when the transfer is sent.

**The mobile app can be both the source and destination** — A staff member can start a transfer from the mobile app, and another staff member can receive that transferred call in their mobile app when Mobile App calling is enabled for them.

**Inbound and outbound calls are supported** — You can transfer a customer who called you or a customer you called from the mobile app.

**Transferred calls can be received across configured sub-accounts** — If you are configured to receive mobile calls from multiple sub-accounts, transferred calls can also be received from those configured sub-accounts.

Re-transferring is not currently supported

If a call has already been transferred to you, you cannot transfer that same call again to another staff member.

## Frequently Asked Questions

Q: Does the receiving staff member need a personal phone number?

No. A personal phone number is not required as long as the staff member has at least one eligible destination configured under **Forward Calls to**, such as the Web App, Mobile App, My Phone Number, or Deskphone (SIP).

Q: Why is a staff member grayed out or unavailable in the transfer list?

The staff member does not currently have an eligible receiving destination configured. Review that user's **Call & Voicemail Settings** and enable at least one option under **Forward Calls to**.

Q: What is the difference between a warm transfer and a blind transfer?

A warm transfer lets you speak with the receiving staff member before handing over the customer. A blind transfer sends the customer directly to the selected staff member and ends your participation in the call.

Q: If several devices are enabled, which one receives the transfer?

The enabled destinations under **Forward Calls to** can ring at the same time. The receiving staff member can answer the transferred call from an available device.

Q: Can I transfer a call that was already transferred to me?

No. Re-transferring a call that has already been transferred is not currently supported.

Q: Can I use this for both inbound and outbound calls?

Yes. The transfer workflow can be used during both inbound and outbound calls in the mobile app.

Q: How does the receiving staff member know the call was transferred?

The incoming call provides transfer context. On iOS, the contact can appear with the name of the transferring staff member, such as **John Doe via Michael Scott**. On Android, the call screen can display a message such as **Transferred call from Michael Scott**.

title_en: Guided Form Based Setup for Conversation AI
source_md:
This article provides a step-by-step guide to setting up Conversation AI V3 using the Guided Form approach in HighLevel. With the Guided Form method, you can create bots without writing prompts—just fill out a simple form, define your objectives, and let the system handle the logic. It’s perfect for quickly building effective, on-brand AI conversations.

---

**TABLE OF CONTENTS**

- [What is the Guided Form Bot?](#What-is-the-Guided-Form-Bot?)
  - [Key Benefits of the Guided Form Bot](#Key-Benefits-of-the-Guided-Form-Bot)
  - [How to Set Up the Guided Form Bot](#How-to-Set-Up-the-Guided-Form-Bot)
  - [Additional Instructions](#Additional-Instructions)
  - [Frequently Asked Questions](#Frequently-Asked-Questions)
  - [Related Articles](#Related-Articles)

---

# **What is the Guided Form Bot?**

The Guided Form Bot is a user-friendly setup option within Conversation AI that removes the need for manual prompt engineering. Instead, it walks you through creating a bot using a structured form. You define key goals—like collecting contact details or answering FAQs—and the system builds a logic-driven, objective-based conversation flow behind the scenes.

---

## **Key Benefits of the Guided Form Bot**

- **Simpler setup:** Build a Conversation AI bot by completing guided fields instead of writing detailed prompts from scratch.
- **Structured conversations:** Define objectives and questions so the bot knows what information to collect and what goal to complete.
- **Better consistency:** Keep bot behavior aligned across conversations by using clear setup fields, fallback messages, and additional instructions.
- **Improved lead qualification:** Ask targeted questions that help identify contact needs, urgency, budget, service interest, or appointment readiness.
- **Action-based automation:** Configure actions such as collecting contact details, triggering workflows, or helping contacts move toward booking.
- **Easier bot updates:** Edit objectives, instructions, questions, or actions as your business process changes.
- **Reduced prompt complexity:** Give the bot clear direction without needing to understand advanced AI prompting techniques.

---

## **How to Set Up the Guided Form Bot**

Proper setup ensures the bot collects the right information, follows the intended conversation path, and takes the correct action after each objective is completed.

#### **Step 1:**Open Conversation AI

Navigate to **AI Agents** in the left menu, then select the **Conversation AI** tab. Click **+ Create Bot** in the upper-right corner to start creating a new Conversation AI agent.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155072409045/original/TbqdYZFH58Tba9kb8L5NKAp5kBpETn8lLg.png?1779984082)

#### **Step 2:**Select Guided Form Based Setup

Choose **Guided Form Based Setup** as the setup method.  
  
![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155072409078/original/nYjEBwGYO0w8LcSJAB5SOceEmqRE7kXd7A.png?1779984119)

#### **Step 3:** Select Type of Bot

Select the type of bot you would like to create (*General Q&A* or *Appointment Booking*) then click **Continue**.  
  
![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155072409134/original/4Mjr8pZKYYdpZMQ5rGgpxzP_AzJy6x-APw.png?1779984169)

#### **Step 4: Select Brand Voice**

Choose a **Brand Voice** from the dropdown or create a new Brand Voice before continuing. After selecting a Brand Voice, you can optionally click **Edit** to adjust the voice settings.  
  
For more info on creating a brand voice, see: [Create Your Brand Voice](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000007263)  
  
![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155072409282/original/gqhyuCNLQplYU26LrvtvCrlZ8CPtJN47zQ.png?1779984267)

#### **Step 5:**Bot Settings

Configure Your Bot's Communication Preferences and Language Settings.

- **Bot Name:**Give your bot a friendly identifier.
- **Preferred Channels:**Select the channels where the bot should respond, such as Instagram, Facebook, SMS, and any other available connected channels.
- **Bot Initial Message:**This is the first message the bot will send to users. If left empty, the bot will use a generic greeting.
- **Make this as Primary Bot:**Enable this option if this bot should reply to inbound messages as the Primary Bot. Make sure the preferred channels are assigned to this bot.
- **Wait Time Before Responding:**Set how long the bot should wait before replying, such as 2 seconds.

Click **Next** after the Bot Settings are complete.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155072409617/original/_nnWEVTqmw6HeVYirKkMV-qomkT2HIz9zw.png?1779984603)

#### **Step 6:**Information Collection

Choose the contact details the bot should collect. Available options shown in the setup include Name, Email, Phone, Street Address, and City.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155072418618/original/FZs1_81_xSlSo6fzqs1DK9OqFtMV6VniSw.png?1779996844)

#### **Step 7:**Custom Question / Objectives

Add all the objectives you’d like the bot to complete. Enable **Skip if Already Filled**to prevent asking for existing contact data.

Common use cases include:

- Ask for name, email, phone
- Qualify lead with Yes/No questions
- Offer scheduling link

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155072419146/original/xIWyrjSnVtGqrP-OLMl2yE6HL07i6_P9Iw.png?1779997566)

#### **Step 8:** Appointment Details

Enable **Appointment Booking** to allow the bot to book an appointment, then select the calendar the bot should use.

You can also select workflows under **Trigger Workflows After Appointment Booking** if an automation should run after the appointment is booked.

Use the secondary appointment toggles to decide whether the bot can manage existing appointments.

- Enable **Allow bot to cancel the appointment** if the bot should be able to cancel appointments.
- Enable **Allow bot to reschedule the appointment** if the bot should be able to reschedule appointments.

**![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155072418930/original/_KzipL4mnZTYBP-5J0s-Q411thpiAd9BeA.png?1779997366)**

#### **Step 9:**Email Notification Settings

Use Email Notification Settings to receive an email when the bot does not know the answer. Enable **Receive Email Notification if The Bot Doesn’t Know the Answer**, then choose who should receive the notification.

**![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155072418938/original/UFjBV2F9DqT1nikEwiaRNIG3qGgUhIvynw.png?1779997390)**

#### **Step 10:**Enable Conversation Summary

Enable **Conversation Summary** when the system should generate a summary after a conversation becomes inactive. Configure the **Set Inactivity Time** value and the **Minimum Messages required to generate Summary** value.

You can also choose whether to trigger a workflow when the summary or transcript is generated, save the summary to a custom field, or receive an email notification for the conversation summary.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155072418961/original/fk5FHlR_Ki4pTkgK9bFiOiZz_KIL0gLN3Q.png?1779997430)

#### **Step 11:**Save the Bot

After Bot Goals are configured, click **Save**.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155072419766/original/maEWvd491TY0rruiGQRG7r4z2KKrtR1tbA.png?1779998884)

#### **Step 12:**Set the Status

After the bot is created, the **Bot Created Successfully** modal appears. The bot’s initial status is set to **Off**, which means it is not actively responding in conversations yet.

Choose one of the available status options:

- **Off:** Turns off Conversation AI so the bot does not actively respond.
- **Suggestive:** Suggests prompts within the chat window for a team member to review and send.
- **Auto Pilot:** Allows the bot to reply automatically based on trained data.

From this modal, you can also click **Test Your Bot**, open **Go To Advanced Settings**, or click **Save and Close** to finish setup.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155072419833/original/9dyC8NK5VALmZvNhjdHQNlDPoR3zR_t87w.png?1779999055)

---

## **Additional Instructions**

Use Additional Instructions to give your bot extra context and guardrails so it follows your processes consistently and handles edge cases confidently. Character limit: Up to 2,000 characters (previously 1,200).

Best practices

- Define the bot’s role and boundaries.
- Use clear do/don’t rules for tricky scenarios.
- Keep bullets concise; put critical steps first.

Where to find it

1. Go to Conversation AI and select Edit on the bot you would like to add instructions to.
2. Locate Additional Instructions.
3. Enter your guidance and Save.

---

## **Frequently Asked Questions**

**Q: Can I switch between Guided Form and prompt-based bots?**

Yes! From the bot creation screen, click the dropdown arrow next to “Create Bot” to choose your setup method.

**Q: Can I edit the bot after it’s created?**

Absolutely. Just open the bot from the Bot Manager and click “Edit.”

**Q: What happens if the user doesn’t answer a question?**

The bot will either retry, move on, or end the conversation—based on how you’ve configured each objective.

**Q: Can I duplicate a bot?**

Yes. Use the Duplicate option in the bot menu to reuse a configuration.

**Q: Can I use Guided Form bots across channels like Instagram or WhatsApp?**

Yes, as long as those channels are integrated into your HighLevel setup.

**Q: When does the Guided Form flow start if I set an Initial Message?**

If you configure an Initial Message, the bot sends that welcome message first and waits for the contact’s next reply before starting the objectives/questions flow. If you leave Initial Message blank, the flow starts immediately on the first message.

---

## **Related Articles**

- [Setting Up Conversation AI](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000004401)
- [Conversation AI - Transfer Bot Action](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000005371)
- [Auto-Pilot Mode in Conversation AI for Efficient Communication](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000001022)
- [Conversations AI - Suggestive Mode](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000007994)
