title_en: Conversations - Search Messages by Keyword
source_md:
The Keyword Search feature helps you quickly find specific messages across your Conversations inbox or within an individual conversation, without manually scrolling through message history. This article explains how keyword search works, how to find and filter messages, and how to navigate search results.

---

**TABLE OF CONTENTS**

- [What is Keyword Search in Conversations?](#What-is-Keyword-Search-in-Conversations?)
- [How to Use Keyword Search in Conversations](#How-to-Use-Keyword-Search-in-Conversations)
- [Tips for Better Search Results](#Tips-for-Better-Search-Results)
- [Frequently Asked Questions](#Frequently-Asked-Questions)
- [Related Articles](#Related-Articles)

---

# **What is Keyword Search in Conversations?**

**Keyword Search** allows you to find messages containing specific words, phrases, or numbers directly within Conversations inbox. You can search for a quoted price, customer complaint, product name, promised date, or any other detail mentioned in a previous conversation.

The feature offers two ways to search:

| Search Type | Where to Access | What It Does |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **Cross-Conversation Search** | Search icon at the top of the Conversations list | Finds conversations containing your keyword and displays matching message previews. |
| **In-Conversation Search** | Search icon in an open conversation's header | Finds and highlights matching messages within a single thread, with navigation between matches. |

You can also use the main search box to find contacts by **name, email address, or phone number**.

---

## **How to Use Keyword Search in Conversations**

You can search across your entire accessible inbox or within a specific contact's conversation.

### **Search Across All Conversations**

Use this option when you remember what was said but aren't sure which contact mentioned it.

```
Important:

• If multiple messages from the same contact match your search, the conversation appears once, showing the most recent matching message in the preview.

• Search includes all conversations you have permission to view. If your access is restricted to assigned conversations, only those conversations appear in the results.
```

1. Go to **Conversations** from the left menu.
2. Click the **Search icon** at the top of the conversation list. A search box appears with the placeholder **Search by keyword, name, email or phone**.
3. Enter a keyword or phrase. Results appear as you type, with the total number of matches displayed at the top. Each result includes the contact name, channel icon, date, and a message preview with the matching keyword highlighted in yellow.
4. Click a result to open the matching conversation, or press **Enter** to view the full results list. The conversation opens with the keyword automatically entered in the in-conversation search.
5. Use the **Sort icon** next to the result count to arrange results by newest or oldest.
6. Click the **Back arrow** beside the search box to return to your normal inbox.

![](https://jumpshare.com/share/fkKRKbgv881IKXBElcTg+/GIF+Recording+2026-10-26+at+17.26.34.gif)

### **Search Within a Conversation**

Use this option when you already know the contact but need to find a specific message, such as a price you quoted or a date they confirmed.

```
Note: In-conversation search covers the contact's full message history, including older messages that aren't currently visible. Older matching messages load automatically when you navigate to them.
```

1. Open the contact's conversation in **Conversations**.
2. Click the **Search icon** in the conversation header. A search box appears at the top-right of the message thread. If you opened the thread from a cross-conversation search, the keyword is already filled in.
3. Enter the word or phrase you want to find. Matching messages are highlighted in yellow, and a counter displays your position among the matches, such as **4/4**.
4. Use the **Up** and **Down arrows** beside the counter to move between matching messages. The thread automatically scrolls to each match and keeps it highlighted.
5. Click **X** to close the search box. The conversation remains at your current position.

![](https://jumpshare.com/share/NHloJhGiHWTvt9cl3D6e+/GIF+Recording+2026-10-26+at+17.30.48.gif)

### **Narrow Search Results with Filters**

If your keyword returns too many results, you can apply filters to find the relevant conversations more quickly.

1. After searching for a keyword, click the **Filter icon** at the top-right of the results list.
2. Choose the filters you want to apply. Filter chips appear above the search results, and the total result count updates as filters are applied.
3. Review the filtered conversations and select the matching result.
4. Click **Clear** at the end of the filter row to remove all applied search filters.

#### 

#### Available Search Filters

| Filter | What It Does |
| --- | --- |
| **Date Range** | Limits results to messages sent or received within a selected period. Choose dates manually or use Today, Last 7 Days, Last 30 Days, or Last 90 Days, then click **Confirm**. |
| **Channel** | Filters by one or more channels, including Email, SMS, Facebook, WhatsApp, Instagram, Live Chat, GBP, and Call. |
| **Has Attachments** | Shows conversations where the matching message contains an attachment. |
| **Direction** | Filters messages by inbound or outbound direction. Available under **More Filters**. |
| **Owner** | Narrows results based on the assigned conversation owner. Available under **More Filters**. |
| **Followers** | Filters conversations based on their followers. Available under **More Filters**. |

![](https://jumpshare.com/share/vyN7TN8I8Z4TIy0RvEwV+/GIF+Recording+2026-10-26+at+17.37.09.gif)

---

## **Tips for Better Search Results**

Keep these tips in mind when searching messages:

- **Minimum characters:** Enter at least 3 characters to start searching.
- **Case-insensitive search:** Searching for "Refund", "refund", or "REFUND" returns the same results.
- **Partial word matching:** Searching for "invoic" can find messages containing "invoice" or "invoicing".
- **Multiple words:** Searches containing multiple words find messages with all those words, regardless of their order.
- **Exact phrases:** Use double quotation marks to search for an exact phrase, such as `"not interested"`.
- **Numbers:** You can search for numbers just like words. For example, searching for "299" can help locate a quoted price of $299.
- **Combine filters:** Use date range, channel, attachments, direction, owner, and follower filters to narrow down cross-conversation results.

---

## **Frequently Asked Questions**

#### **Q: Does keyword search replace the existing contact search?**

Yes. The same search box lets you find contact names, email addresses, phone numbers, and message content. Contact name matches appear first.

#### **Q: Do my existing inbox filters affect keyword search results?**

No. Keyword search starts across all conversations you have permission to access, regardless of your current inbox filters. You can apply filters within the search results to narrow them down.

#### **Q: Can agency users search conversations across multiple sub-accounts?**

No. Keyword search is limited to the sub-account you're currently working in.

#### **Q: Are archived conversations included in keyword search?**

Yes. Archived conversations appear in search results, but deleted conversations do not.

#### **Q: Who can use keyword search?**

Any user with access to Conversations in the sub-account can use keyword search. No additional keyword-search permission is required.

Search results respect existing access permissions. For example, users restricted to assigned conversations can only find messages within those conversations.

#### **Q: Why does nothing happen when I start typing?**

Keyword search requires at least **3 characters** before displaying results. Until then, the search box indicates how many more characters are needed.

#### **Q: Why is a conversation missing from my search results?**

This may happen if:

- A search filter is still applied.
- The conversation has been deleted.
- You don't have permission to view the conversation.

Click **Clear** to remove filters. If the conversation is still missing, check its assignment and your access permissions with your administrator.

#### **Q: Why does in-conversation search miss some messages?**

In-conversation search respects any message-type filters applied to the thread.

For example, if the conversation is filtered to show only WhatsApp messages, the search will only return matching WhatsApp messages.

Remove the message-type filter to search across all available channels in that conversation.

---

### **Related Articles**

- [Getting Started with the Conversations Tab](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000006610-getting-started-with-the-conversations-tab)
- [Overview of Conversation Filters](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/48001222121-overview-of-conversation-filters)
- [How to Generate Conversation Summaries and Transcript in Conversation AI](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000006597)
- [Conversations - How to Add Internal Comments & Mention Users](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000003877)a

title_en: Conditional Logic V2 in Forms
source_md:
Conditional Logic v2 helps you create smarter, more dynamic forms. It lets you show or hide fields, redirect users, display messages, or disqualify leads based on how someone answers.

This guide explains how to use Conditional Logic v2 in forms, its key features, and which fields are supported.

[동영상](https://www.youtube.com/embed/cPYLvR304Lw?&wmode=opaque)

# 

# **What is Conditional Logic V2 in Forms?**

Conditional Logic V2 in HighLevel Forms lets you create personalized forms that respond to customer answers and product selections. You can show or hide fields, redirect users, display custom messages, and disqualify leads. With Product-Level Conditional Logic, you can also control the visibility of individual products and variants within the Sell Products element.

---

## **Key Benefits of Conditional Logic V2**

Conditional Logic V2 makes forms more interactive by automatically adjusting fields, products, and outcomes based on customer responses.

- **Personalized Forms:** Display relevant fields based on customer answers.
- **Better Lead Qualification:** Automatically disqualify leads that do not meet your criteria.
- **Dynamic Product Visibility:** Show or hide individual products and variants.
- **Flexible Redirects:** Send customers to relevant pages after submission.
- **Simplified Form Management:** Handle multiple customer scenarios within one form.

---

## **Available Conditional Logic Actions**

Conditional Logic V2 offers four actions that determine what happens when a customer meets a specific condition.

- **Redirect to URL:** Redirect customers to a specified webpage.
- **Display Custom Message:** Show a personalized message after submission.
- **Disqualify Lead:** Prevent qualifying disqualification scenarios from proceeding.
- **Show/Hide Fields:** Dynamically show or hide form fields and supported elements.

**Note:** The first three actions apply during submission, while Show/Hide Fields updates dynamically as customers interact with the form.

---

## **Use Product-Level Conditional Logic**

Product-Level Conditional Logic allows you to create personalized order forms based on customer selections. You can use individual products as conditions and control which products or variants appear within the Sell Products element.

**Use Products as IF Conditions**

Individual products can trigger all four conditional actions:

- **Redirect to URL:** Redirect customers based on the selected product.
- **Display Custom Message:** Display a message related to the product.
- **Disqualify Lead:** Disqualify leads based on product selection.
- **Show/Hide Fields:** Display relevant fields or elements based on the selected product.

**Example:** If a customer selects an Enterprise package, redirect them to a dedicated consultation page.

**Show or Hide Individual Products and Variants**

The Show/Hide Fields action supports three visibility levels:

- **Entire Sell Products element:** Show or hide the complete element.
- **Individual products:** Control specific products without hiding the entire element.
- **Product variants:** Show or hide specific variants within a product.

**Example:** If a customer selects "Ecommerce Website," display the relevant website package and hide unrelated products.

**Important:** Product-Level Conditional Logic works in both old and new Forms builders. Existing functionality for showing or hiding the entire Sell Products element remains available.

---

## **Supported Fields and Operators**

Conditional Logic V2 supports multiple field types and comparison operators. Available operators depend on the selected field.

| Field Type | Supported Operators |
| --- | --- |
| Text | Equal to, Not equal to, Contains, Does not contain, Starts with, Ends with, Is empty, Is filled |
| Number, Monetary, Score | Equal to, Not equal to, Greater than, Less than, Between, Is empty, Is filled |
| Date | Equal to, Before, After, Between, Is empty, Is filled |
| Single Dropdown | Is equal to, Is not equal to, Is empty, Is filled |
| Multi Dropdown, Checkbox | Is equal to, Is not equal to, Is empty, Is filled |
| Terms & Conditions | Is checked, Is not checked |
| File Upload, Signature | Is empty, Is filled |

Product selections can also be used as IF conditions. Text, HTML, Image, Payment, and Sell Products elements can be relevant visibility targets.

**Note:** The Between operator includes both boundary values.

---

## **Conditional Logic Rule Evaluation**

HighLevel evaluates conditional rules in a defined order. Understanding rule priority helps prevent conflicting actions and unexpected field or product visibility.

- **Submission Actions:** Only the first matching Redirect, Custom Message, or Disqualify rule applies.
- **Show/Hide Fields:** Later matching rules can override earlier visibility rules.
- **AND Conditions:** All conditions must match.
- **OR Conditions:** At least one condition must match.

You cannot combine AND and OR connectors within the same rule.

**Example:** If one rule shows a product and a later matching rule hides it, the later rule determines its visibility.

---

## **Conditional Logic in Calendar Booking Forms**

Conditional Logic V2 also works with custom forms in supported calendar booking flows. This allows businesses to qualify customers and customize booking outcomes.

- Show/Hide rules control field visibility.
- Disqualifying conditions prevent appointment creation and payment collection.
- Redirects and custom messages can customize the confirmation experience.

To use conditional redirects or messages, select **Use custom form rules** in the calendar confirmation settings.

For additional details, see [Adding Custom Forms to Calendars](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/48001076135-adding-custom-forms-to-calendars).

---

## **How to Set Up Conditional Logic V2**

Proper configuration ensures customers see the correct fields, products, and submission outcomes based on their answers.

1. Navigate to **Sites → Forms** and open or create a form.
2. Click **Conditional Logic** in the Form Builder.  
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155084139706/original/-MbWvRG6fk5OYkAfbk6Hs4CZqTQtT_cxTg.png?1792926983)
3. Select **Add New Condition**.
4. Choose an action: Redirect to URL, Display Custom Message, Disqualify Lead, or Show/Hide Fields.  
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155084139720/original/I05L517P6M5UfFuQdmLHNQ3e731Ge9Gb6Q.png?1792927021)
5. Configure the IF condition by selecting a field or supported product, an operator, and a value.  
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155084139728/original/PqJuVsSia-4_RHoWkWbbFW_C08RsMQFfxQ.png?1792927063)
6. Configure the THEN action, such as displaying fields, hiding products, redirecting users, or showing a message.
7. Save the condition and preview the form to test the expected behavior.

### **Configure Product-Level Visibility**

To control individual products or variants:

1. Open **Conditional Logic → Add New Condition**.
2. Select **Show/Hide Fields**.  
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155084139774/original/Gr7NWl5lVUsF7gDa-ypC0x1Td7Msr-GQFg.png?1792927274)
3. Define the condition using a customer response or product selection.
4. Select the entire Sell Products element, an individual product, or a specific variant.
5. Configure whether the selected item should appear or disappear.
6. Save and test the rule.

---

## **Frequently Asked Questions**

**Q: Can individual products trigger conditional actions?**

Yes. Product selections can trigger Redirect to URL, Display Custom Message, Disqualify Lead, and Show/Hide Fields.

**Q: Can I hide a specific product without hiding the entire Sell Products element?**

Yes. You can control individual products while keeping the Sell Products element visible.

**Q: Can I show or hide specific product variants?**

Yes. You can configure conditional visibility for individual product variants.

**Q: Does Product-Level Conditional Logic work in old Forms builders?**

Yes. It is supported in both old and new Forms builders.

**Q: What happens if multiple conditional rules match?**

For submission actions, the first matching rule applies. For Show/Hide rules, later matching rules can override earlier ones.

**Q: Why can't I save a conditional rule?**

Check that all required fields, operators, values, and action settings are configured.

---

## **Related Articles**

- [Conditional Logic in Surveys (v2)](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000005564-conditional-logic-in-surveys-v2-)
- [Adding Custom Forms to Calendars](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/48001076135-adding-custom-forms-to-calendars)
- [How to Create and Manage a Contact Form in HighLevel](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000004549/)
- [Getting Started - Create & Sell Products](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000005071-getting-started-create-sell-products)
- [How to Use Order Upsell in Forms](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000006914-how-to-use-order-upsell-in-forms)

title_en: Conversation AI Multi-Calendar Booking Setup Guide
source_md:
Enhance your scheduling flexibility with **HighLevel’s Conversation AI – Multiple Calendars Support**. This new capability enables AI bots to intelligently detect and book appointments across multiple calendars, simplifying multi-specialty or multi-department scheduling for your business.

---

**TABLE OF CONTENTS**

- [What is Multiple Calendars Support?](#What-is-Multiple-Calendars-Support?)
- [Key Benefits of Multiple Calendars Support](#Key-Benefits-of-Multiple-Calendars-Support)
- [Smart Calendar Detection](#Smart-Calendar-Detection)
- [Fallback Calendar](#Fallback-Calendar)
- [How to Configure Multiple Calendars for Appointment Booking](#How-to-Configure-Multiple-Calendars-for-Appointment-Booking)
- [AI Configuration Tips (Prompts & Keywords)](#AI-Configuration-Tips-(Prompts-&-Keywords))
- [Viewing Booked Appointments and Calendar Details](#Viewing-Booked-Appointments-and-Calendar-Details)
- [Frequently Asked Questions](#Frequently-Asked-Questions)
- [Related Articles](#Related-Articles)

---

[동영상](https://www.youtube.com/embed/bj\_g5hKmjg4?&wmode=opaque)

---

## **What is Multiple Calendars Support?**

Multiple Calendars Support allows your AI Appointment Booking Bot to route booking requests to the correct calendar based on the customer’s intent. Instead of limiting your bot to a single calendar, you can now configure several calendars—each representing a service, department, or specialist—and let the AI automatically determine which one to use.

This feature is available under **Conversation AI → Appointment Booking Bot Goal** when setting up or editing an appointment booking flow.

---

## **Key Benefits of Multiple Calendars Support**

- **Smart Calendar Detection:** The AI automatically matches user requests to the most appropriate calendar based on descriptions and keywords.

- **Effortless Multi-Department Booking:** Manage appointments for different teams or services (e.g., Cardiology, Neurology, Physiotherapy) within one AI bot.

- **Fallback Calendar Assurance:** Ensure no booking is missed by setting a default fallback calendar for unmatched requests.

- **Seamless Workflow Integration:** Supports all previous workflow triggers (cancel, reschedule, post-booking automation) used with single-calendar booking.

- **Transparent Tracking:** Instantly view which calendar was used when reviewing appointment details in the conversation or appointment record.

---

## **Smart Calendar Detection**

The AI automatically detects and routes appointments to the right calendar using your configured **calendar names, descriptions, and optional keywords**. When a user types something like:

> “I want to consult a Neurologist for migraine headaches.”

The AI identifies the relevant **Neurology** calendar and retrieves available slots for booking.

---

## **Fallback Calendar**

The fallback calendar acts as a safety net when none of the configured calendars match the user’s message. This ensures every appointment request is captured and booked, avoiding any lost opportunities.

- Select one of your configured calendars as the fallback option.
- If no intent matches the AI descriptions, the appointment will automatically book on this fallback calendar.

---

## **How to Configure Multiple Calendars for Appointment Booking**

Follow these steps to enable and configure Multiple Calendars in your Conversation AI bot:

```
Note that the Appointment Booking option in Bot Goals has a prompt and also has details about the calendars. The calendar details are ONLY for intent classification. If you want the bot to be able to answer questions that information needs to be in the prompt (above the Appointment Booking button).

For example: if you want the bot to be able to discuss what kind of appointment to book and why, you need to duplicate that information into the prompt. The bot will not be able to discuss the details it finds in the calendar details.
```

1. Navigate to **AI Agents → Conversation AI → Bot Goals** and select **Appointment Booking**.  
  
![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155055452724/original/ADKs-aZGBhqN-7v-7TtzmqO3GAWtFYDVqw.png?1759854653)

2. Choose the **Multiple Calendars** option at the top of the setup window.

*![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155055452799/original/TVBNcuppvPui33rNLYt2aKmH3L-GCWse4A.png?1759854733)*

3. Under **Calendar Selection**, pick the calendars you want to include. Each calendar’s name and description are auto-fetched.  
  
![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155055458637/original/0e3EEuOCqecPsHt0tViUWJtylV1K9rnt1A.png?1759859784)

4. Optionally, add **Additional Keywords & Descriptions** to help the AI recognize user intent. This is helpful if the calendar itself, in its calendar settings, does not have a detailed name & description. If the calendar has a detailed name & description then you don't need to put anything here.  
  
![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155055458476/original/Ij9k6v74boU-1hwSoaLHkfX-_1texe_lmA.png?1759859603)

5. Configure a **Fallback Calendar** to handle unmatched requests. This can be unchecked to have no fallback calendar.  
  
![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155055458890/original/3C_GDut3Q5QD9da_QPFtYOr9BsooKN6LJg.png?1759860013)

6. Proceed to **AI Configuration** and define your **AI prompt** (e.g., “Which type of consultation would you like to book?”).

*![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155055452947/original/y0tdQp5-yX14ncT-9GMtNbPf1bYqCYuFwA.png?1759854856)*

7. Proceed to Advanced Options

1. Pause bot response after booking
2. Trigger workflows after booking
3. Transfer employee post appointment booking
4. Allow bot to cancel the appointment
5. Allow bot to reschedule the appointmen  
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155055458984/original/taubBBqVVsTtgk5FESVJws1jx1r1fcwCvg.png?1759860118)

8. Save your configuration.

9. Bot Goals Preferences - Conversation Summary and Transcript are described in detail in this article:

[Conversation AI Summary and Transcript](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000006597).

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155055460915/original/XpzPuGZEuhgJ7lqFMuczHpE8qDnh8ghnKg.png?1759862596)

Once enabled, the bot will automatically detect user intent and book appointments in the correct calendar based on conversation context.

---

## **AI Configuration Tips (Prompts & Keywords)**

Designing effective AI prompts and keywords helps ensure accurate routing:

- Use **clear service-based keywords** like “dentist,” “eye check,” or “consultation.”
- Write calendar descriptions in **plain language** so the AI can understand the context.
- Include **alternative phrases** for common user intents (e.g., “I need a doctor for my eyes” → Ophthalmology).
- Keep prompts concise and user-friendly: *“Which service would you like to book?”* works better than long or complex phrasing.

---

## **Viewing Booked Appointments and Calendar Details**

After an appointment is created, both the **conversation** and the **appointment detail drawer** will display which calendar was used to complete the booking.

- Open the conversation thread to see the AI’s confirmation message and slot details.
- Click **View Appointment** to open the details panel.
- The assigned calendar name (e.g., Neurology) appears clearly in the **Calendar** field.

---

## **Frequently Asked Questions**

**Q: Can I use both Single and Multiple Calendar modes?**

Yes. You can choose either mode based on your use case. Single Calendar works best for one service; Multiple Calendars is ideal for multi-specialty businesses.

**Q: How many calendars can I add?**

You can add multiple calendars, but it’s recommended to keep the list concise for more accurate AI matching.

**Q: What if the AI can’t identify the correct calendar?**

The fallback calendar will automatically handle such cases, ensuring every request results in a booked appointment.

**Q. What happens if no calendar matches the user's request?**  
The booking is routed to the configured fallback calendar.

**Q: Will my existing workflows still trigger?**

Yes. All previous automations and workflow triggers (such as notifications, reminders, and post-booking workflows) continue to work as before.

---

title_en: SaaS: Reselling Add-Ons with SaaS Plans
source_md:
SaaS Configurator • Add-Ons • Agency Billing

Package Add-Ons with SaaS Plans in HighLevel

HighLevel lets agencies include paid add-ons directly inside SaaS plans through the SaaS Configurator. Supported add-ons are provisioned with the plan, while the agency is responsible for the bundled add-on cost. This guide explains how to select products, review agency costs, price plans appropriately, and manage bundled add-ons after purchase.

What You'll Learn

Learn how SaaS plan add-ons work, who pays for bundled products, how to add products in the SaaS Configurator, how the cost calculator supports pricing decisions, and what to review for existing or canceled SaaS customers.

Important

Add-ons bundled directly inside a SaaS plan are billed to the **agency**, not individually to the subscribing sub-account. Include the add-on cost in your SaaS pricing so the plan covers your agency cost and desired margin.

# What Are SaaS Plan Add-Ons?

SaaS plan add-ons are paid HighLevel products that agencies can package directly with a recurring SaaS subscription. Bundling these products lets a qualifying customer receive the selected capabilities as part of the SaaS package instead of purchasing each bundled product separately.

Depending on current availability, the **Add-Ons** area of the SaaS Configurator can include products such as:

- WordPress
- WhatsApp
- Ad Manager
- Listings
- AI Employee
- Other supported add-ons displayed in the Configurator

**Availability can change:** Always use the current **Add-Ons** area in the SaaS Configurator to confirm which products and prices are available to your agency.

## Key Benefits of SaaS Plan Add-Ons

Bundling add-ons helps agencies create more complete SaaS packages while keeping product selection, provisioning, and cost visibility inside the SaaS Configurator.

- **Create Differentiated Plans:** Include different products across plan tiers to build distinct SaaS offers.
- **Automate Provisioning:** Supported bundled add-ons are provisioned when a qualifying customer purchases the SaaS plan.
- **Simplify Packaging:** Manage included products from the same Configurator used for plan features and pricing.
- **See Agency Costs Up Front:** Review the displayed cost of selected add-ons before finalizing the plan.
- **Protect Margins:** Use the combined add-on cost when deciding how much the SaaS subscription should cost customers.

## Prerequisites and Limitations

Reviewing your billing setup, plan structure, and product availability before adding paid products helps prevent provisioning issues and unexpected agency costs.

- You need access to **Agency View → SaaS Configurator**.
- Create a new SaaS plan or open an existing plan you are permitted to edit.
- Use the applicable SaaS billing architecture and payment setup for the plan.
- A SaaS plan must contain at least one product feature before the plan can be completed.
- Available add-ons and pricing depend on what is currently displayed in your SaaS Configurator.
- The agency is responsible for the cost of add-ons bundled directly into the SaaS plan.
- **Marketplace Apps** use their own dedicated SaaS Configurator area and eligibility rules rather than the standard Add-Ons configuration.

## How To Add Products to a SaaS Plan

Add products only after reviewing the plan's pricing and target customer. Each selected product adds to the agency's ongoing cost, so the final SaaS subscription price should account for the complete bundle.

### Step 1: Open the SaaS Configurator

Open the plan you want to configure so you can review its features, pricing, and optional products together.

1. Switch to **Agency View**.
2. Click **SaaS Configurator**.
3. Create a new SaaS plan or open an existing plan.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155081375705/original/bGyrXZJSb0g0hF3-qJWakT34-gzqqkt3_w.png?1789880361)

### Step 2: Select Add-Ons

The Add-Ons area displays the paid products currently available for direct deployment with the SaaS plan.

1. Open the plan's **Add-Ons** section.
2. Review the available products and agency-billing notice.
3. Select the add-ons you want included with the plan.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155081375701/original/Z2az7Mr3nCGa4iJ3h4JiZxQhQ2pC5oxH0Q.png?1789880336)

### Step 3: Review the Add-On Cost

The cost calculator updates as products are selected or removed, giving you a clearer view of the agency's recurring cost per subscriber.

1. Review the displayed cost for each selected product.
2. Review the combined add-on cost shown by the Configurator.
3. Use the total when determining the customer-facing SaaS subscription price.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155081375686/original/LCuCF28qDBJjEtBGAX8rY6jiYS8biHHGEA.png?1789880203)

### Step 4: Review and Save the Plan

Reviewing the complete plan before saving helps confirm that pricing, entitlements, and optional products align with the package you intend to sell.

Review applicable plan settings, including:

- Plan details and category
- Pricing
- Features and snapshot
- Add-ons
- Marketplace Apps, when applicable
- Trial and credits
- Usage billing

Save the plan after confirming the configuration.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155081375696/original/bprupEIEDC34jXzCjijeTdFi5-9tOvJScQ.png?1789880313)

## How Add-On Billing Works

Add-ons bundled inside SaaS plans use a direct-deployment model. Understanding who receives the product and who pays HighLevel is essential when calculating the selling price of the plan.

**Direct Deployment:** When an add-on is included directly in a SaaS plan, the subscribing sub-account receives the bundled product, but HighLevel bills the **agency** for the add-on.

- HighLevel bills the **agency** for selected bundled add-ons.
- The sub-account is not individually charged for those add-ons through the bundled SaaS plan.
- The Configurator displays the agency's current add-on costs.
- The agency should include those costs when calculating the SaaS subscription price.

### Pricing the Plan

Plan pricing should cover the agency's add-on costs along with any other plan expenses and the margin the agency wants to retain.

**Example:** If the Configurator shows that the bundled add-ons cost your agency **$100 per month per subscriber**, your SaaS plan price should account for at least that $100 before considering your other costs and desired margin.

Always use the **current prices displayed in the SaaS Configurator** rather than relying on older examples or historical pricing.

## Managing Existing SaaS Customers

Updating a plan's bundle is not a substitute for managing products already provisioned to existing sub-accounts. Review current subscribers separately whenever you change included add-ons or when a SaaS subscription ends.

### When You Change the Plan

Bundle changes apply to future provisioning and should not be assumed to retroactively update products that have already been provisioned to existing customers.

1. Review the sub-accounts currently using the plan.
2. Compare their active add-ons with the updated plan configuration.
3. Add or remove products separately when required for an existing customer.

### When a SaaS Customer Cancels

Canceling the main SaaS subscription does not automatically uninstall bundled add-ons. Review the sub-account's active products and remove add-ons that should no longer remain active.

**Important:** If a bundled add-on remains active after the SaaS customer cancels, the agency can continue to incur the add-on cost. Review and remove products manually when required.

## Frequently Asked Questions

Q: Who pays for add-ons included in a SaaS plan?

HighLevel bills the agency for add-ons bundled directly inside the SaaS plan. Include those costs when setting the customer-facing plan price.

Q: Where do I add products to a SaaS plan?

Go to **Agency View → SaaS Configurator**, create or edit a plan, and open the **Add-Ons** area.

Q: Which products can I include?

The Add-Ons area shows the products currently available to your agency. Availability and pricing can change, so use the Configurator as the current source of truth.

Q: Are bundled add-ons provisioned automatically?

Supported add-ons selected in the SaaS plan are provisioned as part of the qualifying SaaS purchase and onboarding flow.

Q: Do existing customers automatically receive add-ons I add to the plan later?

Do not assume a bundle change updates existing sub-accounts retroactively. Review existing subscribers and manage their add-ons separately when required.

Q: Are bundled add-ons automatically removed if the SaaS customer cancels?

No. Bundled add-ons do not automatically uninstall when the SaaS subscription is canceled. Review the sub-account and remove products manually when appropriate.

Q: Are Marketplace Apps configured the same way as standard SaaS add-ons?

No. Eligible Marketplace Apps are configured from the dedicated **Marketplace Apps** area of the SaaS Configurator and have their own eligibility, installation, and lifecycle rules.

title_en: How to Edit an Email Template in HighLevel
source_md:
Email templates in HighLevel help you create consistent, professional emails without rebuilding the same design every time. You can edit existing email templates to update messaging, change images, adjust layouts, and maintain your brand's appearance. HighLevel's Email Builder provides tools to customize templates for different campaigns and audiences. This guide explains how to edit an email template, save your changes, and preview and test your email before using it.

---

**TABLE OF CONTENTS**

- [What is Email Template Editing in HighLevel?](#What-is-Email-Template-Editing-in-HighLevel?)
- [Key Benefits of Editing Email Templates](#Key-Benefits-of-Editing-Email-Templates)
- [Email Template Editing Options](#Email-Template-Editing-Options)
- [How to Edit an Email Template](#How-to-Edit-an-Email-Template)
- [Frequently Asked Questions](#Frequently-Asked-Questions)
- [Related Articles](#Related-Articles)

---

# **What is Email Template Editing in HighLevel?**

Email template editing allows you to modify the content, appearance, and layout of an existing email template without starting from scratch. Templates can contain reusable elements such as headers, footers, text, images, buttons, and branding. By updating an existing template, you can keep your email communications consistent while adapting the content to different campaigns or business needs.

HighLevel's Email Builder supports visual editing through the Design Editor, allowing you to customize individual elements and arrange your email layout without writing code.

---

## **Key Benefits of Editing Email Templates**

Editing existing email templates helps you maintain brand consistency while reducing the time spent creating new emails. Reusing and updating templates also makes it easier to keep messaging relevant and maintain a consistent experience for recipients.

- **Save Time:** Update an existing email template instead of designing a new email from scratch.
- **Maintain Brand Consistency:** Keep your logos, colors, fonts, and layouts consistent across email communications.
- **Customize Content:** Update text, images, buttons, and other elements to match different campaigns or audiences.
- **Improve Email Design:** Adjust spacing, alignment, and layout to create professional-looking emails.
- **Reuse Existing Designs:** Create reusable email layouts that can be adapted for future campaigns.
- **Reduce Errors:** Preview and test updated templates to identify formatting issues, incorrect links, or missing content before sending.

---

## **Email Template Editing Options**

HighLevel's Email Builder provides several tools for modifying email templates. Understanding the available editing options helps you choose the appropriate controls when updating the content, appearance, or structure of an email.

The following options are available when editing templates using the Design Editor.

**Editing Text and Content**

Text elements let you update written content, including headings, descriptions, promotional messages, and calls to action.

You can:

- Edit existing text directly in the email layout.
- Adjust font styles, text alignment, and formatting.
- Add new text elements when additional content is needed.
- Insert supported custom values to personalize email content.

**Editing Images and Branding**

Image and Logo elements help maintain the visual identity of your business across emails.

You can:

- Replace existing images with updated visuals.
- Add logos, banners, or promotional images.
- Adjust supported image settings and alignment.
- Update branding to match your business's current style.

**Editing Buttons and Links**

Buttons help direct recipients toward actions such as booking an appointment, visiting a website, or viewing an offer.

You can:

- Update button labels.
- Modify the destination URLs.
- Adjust button appearance and alignment.
- Add buttons to different parts of the email.

**Editing Layout and Appearance**

Layout and appearance controls help organize email content and create a consistent reading experience.

You can:

- Add or rearrange email elements.
- Adjust spacing between content blocks.
- Add Dividers or Spacers.
- Modify supported layout and appearance settings.
- Review how the email appears on different screen sizes.

**Tip:** The available controls depend on the element you select and the editor used to create the email. For a complete explanation of supported elements, refer to [Different Elements in Email Builder](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000006657-different-elements-in-email-builder).

---

## **How to Edit an Email Template**

Editing an existing email template allows you to update its content and design while preserving its reusable structure. Following the correct editing and saving process helps ensure your changes are available when you use the template in future email campaigns.

1. From the left navigation menu, click **Marketing**. Navigate to **Emails**.
2. Select the **Templates** tab. Locate the template you want to edit.  
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155083531782/original/a6lVuLsr4rEWPs-qScaF-Zp5O9NEoX56YQ.png?1792162591)
3. Browse the existing templates or use the available search functionality to find a specific template.
4. Once the template opens in the Email Builder, select the elements you want to modify.
5. Click the template to open it in the Email Builder.  
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155083532254/original/b3cbAgKOYXcN6J6ttjrQIAD8NT5u5cALMw.png?1792162799)
6. Click an existing **Text** element to edit its content and formatting.
7. Select an **Image** element to update its image or available display settings.
8. Click a **Button** element to modify its label, link, or appearance.
9. Make any additional content changes needed for your email.  
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155083532322/original/2xTAxzLO5yERtiVULEQabM_XElasVyPaYA.png?1792162838)
10. Open the **Add Elements** panel to access available content elements.
11. Drag the desired element into the email canvas.
12. Click the added element to customize its content, style, and settings.
13. Rearrange existing elements by dragging them to the desired position.
14. Use the **Appearance** settings, where applicable, to adjust the overall styling.  
      
    ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155083532625/original/2ISTN9VWUY_KdYzzVWudXbRVEjMXSlp3NQ.png?1792162989)
15. Review the changes made to the template.
16. Click **Save Template** to save the updated template when the manual save option is available.

---

## **Frequently Asked Questions**

**Q: Can I duplicate an email template before making changes?**

Duplicating a template can be useful when you want to preserve an existing design while creating a different version. Check the options available in the template's action menu. If a duplicate option is available, create a copy before editing so you can retain the original template.

**Q: Can I recover a previous version of an email template?**

Yes. HighLevel's Email Builder supports Version History for reviewing and restoring saved versions when the feature is available. Open the email editor and access Version History to review available versions.

**Q: Can multiple team members edit the same email template?**

Team members with the necessary account permissions may have access to the same template. To reduce the risk of overwriting changes, coordinate edits and review the latest saved version before making significant updates.

**Q: Does editing an email template automatically send an email to my contacts?**

No. Editing and saving a template does not itself send an email campaign. Sending requires a separate campaign or an appropriately configured workflow.

**Q: Can I edit a template without changing its original version?**

You can preserve the original by creating a separate version where the relevant duplicate or save-as-new option is available. When editing a template inside a workflow, keeping continuous synchronization disabled helps prevent workflow-specific changes from automatically updating the source template.

---

## **Related Articles**

- [How to Use the Email Builder and Its In-line Editor](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000000087)
- [Different Elements in Email Builder](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000006657-different-elements-in-email-builder)
- [Email Builder Autosave](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000008667-email-builder-autosave)
- [Preview and Test Your Email Campaigns/Templates](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/48001215382-preview-and-test-your-email-campaign-templates)
- [Managing Email Templates in Workflow Steps](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000005553-managing-email-templates-in-workflow-steps)
- [Save and Reuse Items in the Email Builder](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000002467/)

source_md:
[동영상](https://www.youtube.com/embed/3LphthBR4J0?&wmode=opaque)

HighLevel’s upgraded **Add Contact** sidebar streamlines contact creation and keeps your CRM consistent. Admins can choose which fields appear (including custom fields), set required fields, and reorder the form to match team workflows. The result is faster data entry, better data quality, and a consistent experience across desktop and mobile.

```
IMPORTANT: Add Contact Modal — Upgrade & Customization is currently available in Labs. If you don't see it, ask an admin to enable it at Agency settings > Labs. For more, refer to Labs features - Complete overview
```

---

**TABLE OF CONTENTS**

- [What is the Add Contact Modal Upgrade and Customisation of Contact Form?](#%E2%80%8B%E2%80%8BWhat-is-the-Add-Contact-Modal-Upgrade-and-Customisation-of-Contact-Form?)
- [Key Benefits of the Add Contact Modal Upgrade & Customization](#Key-Benefits-of-the-Add-Contact-Modal-Upgrade-&-Customization%C2%A0)
- [Admin Permissions & Access](#Admin-Permissions-&-Access)
- [Duplicates & Data Quality Tips](#Duplicates-&-Data-Quality-Tips)
- [How To Setup the Customization of the Add contact Modal](#How-To-Setup-the-Customization-of-the-Add-contact-Modal)
- [Accessing the Add Contact Modal](#Accessing-the-Add-Contact-Modal)
- [Frequently Asked Questions](#Frequently-Asked-Questions)
- [Related Articles](#Related-Articles)

---

# **What is the Add Contact Modal Upgrade and Customization of Contact Form?**

The upgraded Add Contact experience replaces the classic pop-up with a modern slide-out and adds admin controls for which fields show up and in what order. By aligning the form with your process and using required fields for must-have data, you reduce errors at the source and standardize intake across your team.

Designed for productivity, the slide-out modal supports **standard** and**custom fields**, **drag-and-drop field ordering**, **field-level Required** toggles, **Preview**, and **unsaved-changes** protection. Admins define the layout once; all users then enjoy a consistent, responsive create flow with Save and Save & Add Another actions.

---

## **Key Benefits of the Add Contact Modal Upgrade & Customization**

These benefits focus on speed, data accuracy, and governance—so you capture the right data the first time.

- **Faster entry:** Slide-out UI keeps you on the page while creating contacts.
- **Cleaner data:** Show only the fields your team actually needs; hide the rest.
- **Higher quality:** Make critical fields required (for example, **Contact Type**) to prevent incomplete records.
- **Works with custom fields:** Include **contact-level custom fields** so your unique data points are captured at creation.
- **Admin control:** Admins govern the layout so standards stay consistent while users focus on selling.

---

## **Admin Permissions & Access**

Limiting layout control to admins protects your data model while allowing end users to focus on selling and support.

- **Who can customize the layout?** Admin-level users in the sub-account (via Roles & Permissions).
- **Who can create contacts?** Any user with access to the Contacts area can open **Add Contact** and use the configured form.

---

## **Duplicates & Data Quality Tips**

Contact intake quality depends on how duplicates are handled. Configure deduplication preferences so new entries behave the way you expect.

- Configure **Settings → Business Profile → Contact Deduplication Preferences** to control matching behavior (choose primary/secondary match fields like **Email** or **Phone**).
- **CSV imports** always check email/phone and merge matches—duplicates cannot be created via CSV.
- If duplicates slip in from forms or integrations, you can **merge up to 10 contacts** and choose a master record.

---

## **How To Setup the Customization of the Add contact Modal**

A short, sequenced setup prevents rework and ensures your team starts in a smooth, consistent state.

**Step 1: Open the Add Contact sidebar**  
  
In your Sub-Account, Go to **Contacts → Smart Lists → + Add Contact** to launch the modal.  
  
![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155055509615/original/eKKyA8Sama6VPdu9ZXNBmHq7E52JzZBhuQ.gif?1759921782)

**Step 2: Customize the form (admins)**

Click **Customize Form** → Add/Remove **standard** and **contact-level custom** fields; drag to reorder.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155055510030/original/O0uF5kQeH1kzsyx-IyLi-xkhZCwT98H2Sg.png?1759921995)

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155055510437/original/M4jdFf6S0tGS_tuhtsrUfqTXfNnaFgpeRw.gif?1759922166)

**Step 3: Set required fields**

Turn on **Required** for any field that **must** be completed before saving the contact form.

*![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155055510628/original/Vfe0w0j5_ZdyXEmbzalWmYyrAlqLjCazGA.png?1759922233)*

**Step 4: Preview & Save**

Use **Preview** to validate, then save the layout for your team.

*![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155055510842/original/yXDkoYAcXB6rLa0JKj9XdWD-5yNXBUOWmw.gif?1759922354)*

**Step 5: (Optional) Automate next steps via Workflows**

Use a **Contact Created** trigger in a **Workflow** to send welcomes, assign owners, or tag new contacts automatically.

---

## **Updated Smart Lists Actions Menu**

The **Manage Smart Lists** and **Restore** options have moved from the page header into the actions menu beside the **Add Contact** button.

To access these options:

1. Navigate to:  
     
   **Contacts → Smart Lists**
2. Click the three-dot (⋮) actions menu beside **Add Contact**
3. Select:
   - Manage Smart Lists
   - Restore

This update keeps Smart List management actions grouped together while simplifying the header layout.

## 

---

## **Accessing the Add Contact Modal**

Everyone on your team uses the same entry point to create new contacts, ensuring a consistent, predictable experience.

1. Go to **Contacts → Smart Lists → + Add Contact** to launch the slide-out modal.
2. Complete the required fields, then choose an action:

   - **Save** to create the contact
   - **Save & Add Another** for rapid back-to-back entries, or
   - **Cancel** to exit without saving

```
Note: If you try to close the modal without saving changes, you’ll get an unsaved-changes prompt to confirm.
```

## 

---

## **Frequently Asked Questions**

**Q: Who can customize the Add Contact form layout?**  
Admin-level users in the sub-account (via Roles & Permissions). Regular users use the configured form.

**Q: Can I include custom fields on the Add Contact form?**  
Yes. Any **contact-level custom field** can be added, reordered, and marked required. Manage fields in **Settings → Custom Fields**.

**Q: How do I prevent duplicate contacts during intake?**  
Configure **Contact Deduplication Preferences** (choose email/phone matching). CSV imports auto-merge by email/phone and can’t create duplicates.

**Q: What automations pair well with this?**  
Start with a **Contact Created** workflow to assign owners, tag by source, and send welcomes; use **Create Contact** and **Update Contact Field** actions as needed.

**Q: Does “Save & Add Another” keep the previous values?**  
It creates the contact and reopens a blank form for the next entry. Use workflows to auto-apply tags/owners if you need consistency.

**Q: Do modal-required fields affect CSV imports or API creates?**No. Required rules in the Add Contact modal apply to manual entry only. CSV imports and API requests have their own validations.

**Q: Will users see my layout changes immediately?**Yes for new sessions; existing users may need to refresh the Contacts page to load the latest configuration.

**Q: Where did the Manage Smart Lists option move?**

It is now located inside the actions menu (⋮) beside the Add Contact button.

**Q: How long can deleted contacts be restored?**

Contacts can be restored for up to 60 days after deletion.

**Q: Did Smart List permissions change?**

No. Only the location of the menu options changed.

---

## **Related Articles**

- [Getting Started - Create New Contact](https://gohighlevelassist.freshdesk.com/support/solutions/articles/155000005055-getting-started-create-new-contact)
- [How to Use Custom Fields](https://gohighlevelassist.freshdesk.com/support/solutions/articles/48001161579-how-to-use-custom-fields)

  - [How To Set Up Invoice Layout Customization](#How-To-Set-Up-Invoice-Layout-Customization)
  - [Frequently Asked Questions](#Frequently-Asked-Questions)
  - [Related Articles](#Related-Articles)

---

# **What is Invoice Layout Customization?**

Invoice Layout Customization lets you control the visual design and section wording of your invoices at the sub-account level. Instead of one fixed template, you can adjust branding, business and contact sections, and line-item labels so every invoice reflects your brand and the specifics of your industry.

---

## **Key Benefits of Invoice Layout Customization**

- **Brand Consistency:** Align colors and wording with your brand for a polished, trustworthy invoice.
- **Clarity for Clients:** Rename sections and labels so customers instantly recognize what they’re seeing.
- **Flexibility:** Show or hide fields and add up to 3 custom values in Business Information to fit regional or industry needs.
- **Efficiency:** Edit once and reuse, your saved layout appears in the invoice preview and PDFs.

---

## **Branding Settings**

Branding controls shape first impressions by adjusting the pay button’s color, border, and text. These choices help reinforce your brand and set the right context (e.g., “Pay” vs. “Donate”).

**What you can customize:**

- Pay Button Color (use the color picker)
- Border Color (use the color picker)
- Button Text (e.g., change **Pay** to **Donate**)

**![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155056925009/original/Fm7WAtJS1zxj6eo4VwfW94n1BJjyfKQJwg.png?1761577739)**

---

## **Business Information**

Business Information identifies who is issuing the invoice. Toggling fields or adding custom values keeps your documents compliant across regions while avoiding clutter.

**What you can do:**

- Show/Hide standard fields like Company Name, Phone, Address, Tax IDs.
- Add up to 3 custom values (e.g., Company Registration, VAT/GST, Website).
- Reorder or remove custom values as needs change (delete to remove).

```
Tip: Unchecked fields are hidden from recipients, but your team can still edit their values while creating an invoice.
```

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155056925491/original/OBfFw5p18L5Qqr-ExrQMWOZE1SONElxHeA.png?1761577982)

---

## **Contact Information**

This area defines the recipient block (e.g., “Billed to” or “Shipping details”). Renaming the section improves clarity for your use case (nonprofit, shipping-heavy, B2B, etc.).

**What you can do:**

- Rename the section header (e.g., **Billed to** → **Shipping details**).
- Add custom fields to capture extra recipient details.

**![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155056925822/original/dCYgLrqQx1VtYBIwrWt-BuJJ3cM95qViKQ.png?1761578086)**

---

## **Invoice Information**

Invoice Information covers core document details such as invoice number and dates. Keeping only what you need simplifies the layout for customers.

**What you can do:**

- Show/Hide **Invoice Number**, **Issue Date**, **Due Date**, and similar fields.

- Keep internal fields editable during invoice creation even if they’re hidden on the recipient view.

**![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155056926101/original/qEBj-ysK3jun6PBadHsvh6ugYS6vFAzVSA.png?1761578206)**

---

## **Labels**

Labels define the column headers for your line items, what customers read at a glance. Clear labels reduce questions and accelerate payment.

**What you can do:**

- Rename column headers (e.g., Item Name → Product Name).
- Show/Hide Price, Quantity, Tax, Subtotal, etc.
- Respect character counters (e.g., up to 75 characters) to avoid wrapping.

```
Tip: If you uncheck a label, that column is hidden from recipients; your team can still enter values during invoice creation.
```

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155056926419/original/Mx8LTrXcLvpdZ8AEVR280cKv83utIRU9YA.png?1761578408)

---

## **How To Set Up Invoice Layout Customization**

Follow these steps to locate the controls, adjust the layout, and save your design so every new invoice uses your preferred styling.

#### **Step 1:**Navigate to Invoices

From the **sub-account** dashboard, go to **Payments → Invoices & Estimates**.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155056946969/original/XN3ho3AwucKdpBgHCWOlD1xYcMBYW2Wl3Q.png?1761592498)

#### **Step 2:** Settings

Click the **Settings** button (top-right).

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155056947003/original/O3y68ZhdaYrWxKzH9f7jJFEUZwCeywxQaA.png?1761592540)

#### **Step 3:**Go to Layout

In the secondary navigation, choose **Title, Terms and Layout**.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155056947032/original/LTcoqUOgkDGAZM6mjfmH7KDPcNW3pprExg.png?1761592572)

#### **Step 4:**Click Customize Layout

Scroll to **Invoice Layout** and click **Customize Layout**.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155056947050/original/5mK453NMXcefScACguKvNAknu-0Cy9iXPw.png?1761592600)

#### **Step 5:** Layout Tab

In the **Layout** tab:

- Open **Branding Settings** → choose Pay Button Color and Border Color using the color picker; update **Button Text** if needed (e.g., **Donate**).
- Expand **Business Information** → check/uncheck fields; add up to **3 custom values**.
- Expand **Contact Information** → rename the section header (e.g., “Shipping details”) and add custom fields as needed.
- (Optional) Expand **Invoice Information** → show/hide Invoice Number, Issue Date, Due Date.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155056947144/original/A3R_5DM9DQgRt-NXaUVGXFKcX85Nfhgg9Q.png?1761592787)

#### **Step 6:** Update Labels

Switch to the **Labels** tab → rename or hide line-item columns (**Item Name, Price, Quantity, Tax, Subtotal**).

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155056947075/original/FSRtmhiOT-QWKJ4yQjJKgKuQNPqpJbc4iQ.jpeg?1761592635)

#### **Step 7:**Preview & Save Changes

Review the **live preview** to ensure everything looks correct. Click **Save changes** (top-right) to apply your design.

```
Tip: To start over, click Reset All Changes to restore defaults.
```

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155056947116/original/Z-zfPz8tryRSR0UvCBdKoJFHy8r5AMdywQ.png?1761592739)

---

## **Frequently Asked Questions**

**Q: Do these changes apply to all invoices in my sub-account?**  
Yes. Layout customizations are saved at the sub-account level and used for invoices you create in that sub-account.

**Q: Will previously sent PDFs update after I change the layout?**  
No. Previously delivered PDFs won’t change automatically. Create a fresh PDF or resend the invoice so recipients see your latest layout.

**Q: Can I hide a column but still enter those values when creating an invoice?**  
Yes. Hiding a label only hides it from the recipient view; your team can still edit the values during invoice creation.

**Q: How many custom values can I add to Business Information?**  
Up to **3** custom values.

**Q: Do layout changes appear in downloaded or emailed PDFs?**  
Yes. PDFs reflect the saved layout when you generate or resend them. See [PDF Generation for Invoices and Receipts](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000005216) for details.

---
