- [Understanding Listings & Categories](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000006573)
- [Create & Edit Listings](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000006579)

title_en: WordPress - How to Add Domains to Sites
source_md:
Adding a domain to a WordPress site is necessary to make the website accessible to the public through that Domain. A domain serves as the website's address, and visitors can use it to access the site. The article provides step-by-step instructions for adding a primary domain and additional domains to a WordPress site.

---

**TABLE OF CONTENTS**

- [What is Adding a Domain to WordPress Sites in HighLevel?](#What-is-Adding-a-Domain-to-WordPress-Sites-in-HighLevel?)
- [Key Benefits of Adding a Domain to WordPress Sites](#Key-Benefits-of-Adding-a-Domain-to-WordPress-Sites)
- [Prerequisites](#Prerequisites)
- [How to Add a Domain for a WordPress Site in HighLevel](#How-to-Add-a-Domain-for-a-WordPress-Site-in-HighLevel)
- [How to Add a Sub-Domain for a WordPress Site](#How-to-Add-a-Sub-Domain-for-a-WordPress-Site)
- [Comprehensive Domain/Sub-Domain Dashboard](#Comprehensive-Domain/Sub-Domain-Dashboard)
- [Frequently Asked Questions](#Frequently-Asked-Questions)
- [Related Articles](#Related-Articles)

---

# **What is Adding a Domain to WordPress Sites in HighLevel?**

WordPress Domain Management connects your purchased domain (e.g., example.com) to your HighLevel WordPress site. The system verifies DNS records and issues SSL so your visitors can access a secure, branded website. Understanding how the primary domain, subdomains, and DNS verification work ensures a reliable, secure connection for your site.

```
Note: Domain Management is available in the Live environment only.

If you are in Staging, the domains area is disabled and shows: “This feature is only available in the live environment. Please switch to access it.”

Use the environment selector in the top-right header action bar to switch to Live.

![](https://jumpshare.com/share/1I4xuG6ynV5ETXtCcls4+/Screenshot+2026-02-11+at+5.38.08%E2%80%AFPM.png)
```

---

## **Key Benefits of Adding a Domain to WordPress Sites**

- **Primary domain & SSL issuance:** automatic SSL is issued after DNS verification for the primary domain, enabling secure HTTPS access.
- **Multiple domains supported:** connect additional domains or subdomains to route traffic as needed (within product limits).
- **Subdomain flexibility:** map subdomains (e.g., blog.example.com) without the extra SSL TXT validation step used for primary domains.
- **Domain Connect option:** authenticate with supported registrars to auto-configure DNS without manual record edits.
- **Clear status indicators:** view DNS/SSL status at a glance to quickly resolve issues and go live with confidence.

---

## **Prerequisites**

- Verifying these items up front prevents setup errors, speeds up SSL issuance, and reduces downtime during go-live.
- You’re working in the Live environment (use the environment selector in the top-right header to switch from Staging).
- Your WordPress site is already provisioned in the correct Sub-Account.
- You have access to your domain’s DNS settings at your registrar or DNS host (e.g., Cloudflare, GoDaddy, IONOS).
- If your DNS Provider is Cloudflare, please turn off Proxy Settings

---

## **How to Add a Domain for a WordPress Site in HighLevel**

1. Log into your sub‑account.
2. Go to **Sites** > **WordPress**.  
     
   ![](https://jumpshare.com/share/NGK21FCbtFdfuiqL3xej+/Screen+Shot+2026-02-11+at+5.15.43+PM.png)
3. Click on the **Manage Website** button for the site you want to add the domain for.  
     
   ![](https://jumpshare.com/share/ZUR1k8q62GCmfoC2wPcp+/Screen+Shot+2026-02-11+at+5.17.23+PM.png)
4. Navigate to the **Manage Your Domain** section in your site management dashboard and click on **+ Add Domain**.  
     
   ![](https://jumpshare.com/share/Ov0iQQe0ATfMbI8GJv1C+/Screen+Shot+2026-02-11+at+6.49.15+PM.png)
5. **Setup your Domain Name:** Enter your desired domain name.
6. Select **Auto** **Configure** or  **Add** **Manually.**(Our system will automatically verify if the domain is already associated with another location or agency.)
7. If the domain is available, proceed to the next step.  
     
   ![](https://jumpshare.com/share/ctti3dvwRVyj0RXnD6GT+/Screen+Shot+2026-02-11+at+6.52.48+PM.png)
8. After your domain is verified, you will need to configure your **SSL certificate**.
9. Add the provided **TXT** **records** to **your** **DNS** **provider like GoDaddy, Hostinger, Namecheap etc**.
10. While most SSL Records propagate within an hour, **global updates take up to 48 hours**. Configure your **TTL Value to 600 ms or the lowest value possible** for optimal ssl record propagation.
11. Once the TXT records are **successfully added and verified**, you can move on to the final step.  
      
    ![](https://jumpshare.com/share/4IIbR8naF6wr7la8ErGY+/jvDFyZPA87UqHBxsEtgj1B8l9Ct5TZujug.png)
12. Add the provided **CNAME** and **A** **records** to your **DNS** **provider**.
13. Once the records are successfully added click on '**Verify DNS Records**' button.  
      
    ![](https://jumpshare.com/share/vr5hZ7tZJiLnsY3pJBtl+/cDKrS-1v1iSnRRwt6-b5ZuBDGu75RefZ9w.png)

---

## **How to Add a Sub-Domain for a WordPress Site**

Adding sub-domain is similar to adding your Domain. The SSL certificate for additional domains will be Verified in the Update DNS step and hence adding the TXT records is not required.

1. Navigate to the **Manage Your Domain** section in your site management dashboard and click on **+ Add Domain**.  
    **![](https://jumpshare.com/share/Ov0iQQe0ATfMbI8GJv1C+/Screen+Shot+2026-02-11+at+6.49.15+PM.png)**
2. **Setup your Domain Name:** Enter your desired domain name.
3. Select **Auto Configure** or **Add Manually**. (Our system will automatically verify if the domain is already associated with another location or agency.)
4. Our system will automatically verify if the domain is already associated with another location or agency. If the domain is available, proceed to the final step of updating DNS records.  
     
   ![](https://jumpshare.com/share/ctti3dvwRVyj0RXnD6GT+/Screen+Shot+2026-02-11+at+6.52.48+PM.png)
5. Add the provided **CNAME** and **A** **records** to your **DNS** **provider**.
6. Once the records are successfully added click on '**Verify DNS Records**' button.  
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155064692102/original/2um_cn8g9ewwAHEArYffzvuAf3_I1G8MlA.png?1770817791)

---

## **Comprehensive Domain/Sub-Domain Dashboard**

Our new dashboard offers a comprehensive overview of domain management. 

- **SSL Issuance Status:** Monitor the status of your SSL certificate issuance to ensure it is properly configured using the 'SSL issued/ SSL Not Issued' tags.
- **DNS Record Verification:** Check the verification status of your DNS records to confirm they are correctly set up using the 'Verified/ Not Verified' tags.
- **Domain Management:** You can add up to 5 domains or sub-domains. Designate one as your primary domain for better organisation.
- **Easy Prefix Adjustment:** Easily switch between www and non-www prefixes with a simple adjustment in the dashboard using the 'Change prefix to WWW/ Remove WWW Prefix' option.

### 

---

## **Frequently Asked Questions**

**Q: Why does a primary domain require an SSL TXT record but subdomains don’t?**

The SSL TXT validation step confirms control of the apex domain for certificate issuance. Subdomains follow after the primary domain’s ownership is validated.

**Q: How long does DNS propagation take?**

It varies by provider. Many changes appear within minutes, but some can take longer. If you set a TTL around 600 seconds, re-check within 10–30 minutes.

**Q: My domain is already connected to another HighLevel location—what do I do?**

Ask the current owner to remove the domain from that location, or contact support for assistance if ownership is unclear.

**Q: Do I need both A and CNAME records?**

Add exactly the records shown in the UI for your site. Some setups require both; others may use only one type. Values are unique to your install.

---

### **Related Articles**

- [Connecting Your Domain on GHL - A Guide](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000005132)
- [WordPress: Domain Connect Integration](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000004155)
- [How to set up Root Domain/Subdomain for your Funnels/Websites?](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/48001153720)
- [Multiple WordPress Site Installs Under the Same Sub-Account](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000003677)

title_en: Multi-OAuth Support for Marketplace Apps
source_md:
Multi-OAuth Support allows users to connect and manage multiple external accounts for a single Marketplace app installation. This helps agencies, SaaS teams, and sub-account users manage multiple Google, Facebook, SurveyMonkey, CRM, or other OAuth-based accounts without installing duplicate apps or building custom connection workflows. This article explains how Multi-OAuth works, how to manage connected accounts, and where to set or remove external connections.

---

**TABLE OF CONTENTS**

- [What is Multi-OAuth Support for Marketplace Apps?](#%E2%80%8B%E2%80%8BWhat-is-Multi-OAuth-Support-for-Marketplace-Apps?)
- [Key Benefits of Multi-OAuth Support](#Key-Benefits-of-Multi-OAuth-Support%E2%80%8B)
- [How Multi-OAuth Works](#%C2%A0How-Multi-OAuth-Works%E2%80%8B)
- [Managing Multiple External Accounts](#Managing-Multiple-External-Accounts%E2%80%8B)
- [Setting a Default Connected Account](#Setting-a-Default-Connected-Account%E2%80%8B)
- [Disconnecting an External Account](#Disconnecting-an-External-Account%E2%80%8B)
- [Availability for New and Existing Apps](#Availability-for-New-and-Existing-Apps%E2%80%8B)
- [How To Use Multi-OAuth Support](#How-To-Use-Multi-OAuth-Support%E2%80%8B)
- [Frequently Asked Questions](#Frequently-Asked-Questions%E2%80%8B)
- [Related Articles](#Related-Articles)

---

# **What is Multi-OAuth Support for Marketplace Apps?**

Multi-OAuth Support allows a single Marketplace app installation to support multiple OAuth connections. Instead of being limited to one connected external account, users can connect more than one account to the same Marketplace app when the app supports Multi-OAuth.

Each connected account can be identified by account name, email, or account ID. HighLevel securely stores and refreshes the connected account tokens, helping apps support more reliable workflows, triggers, and actions across multiple external accounts.

---

## **Key Benefits of Multi-OAuth Support**

Multi-OAuth Support makes Marketplace apps more flexible for real-world agency and SaaS use cases where users may manage several external accounts.

- **Multiple Account Connections:** Connect more than one external OAuth account to a single Marketplace app installation.
- **Cleaner Account Management:** View, search, refresh, set default, or disconnect connected accounts from one connection panel.
- **Reduced Manual Work:** Avoid duplicate app installations or custom OAuth flows for every external account.
- **Secure Token Handling:** HighLevel stores and refreshes OAuth tokens through the platform.
- **Scalable App Workflows:** Use multiple connected accounts for workflows, triggers, and actions.
- **Better Agency Support:** Manage multiple client, brand, or platform accounts from one Marketplace app.

---

## **How Multi-OAuth Works**

Multi-OAuth expands Marketplace apps from a single-connection model to a multi-connection model. This allows one app installation to support several external accounts while keeping each connection separate and identifiable.

Here is how it works:

1. A user installs a Marketplace app that supports Multi-OAuth.
2. The user connects one or more external OAuth accounts.
3. Each connected account appears in the app’s **External Connection** tab.
4. HighLevel securely stores and refreshes the connected account tokens.
5. The app can use those connections for supported workflows, triggers, and actions.

---

## **Managing Multiple External Accounts**

The External Connection tab is where users can view and manage connected OAuth accounts for a Marketplace app. This makes it easier to confirm which accounts are connected and take action when an account needs to be refreshed, removed, or set as default.

From the External Connection tab, users may be able to:

- View connected accounts
- Search connected accounts
- Add another account
- Refresh a connection
- Set a default account
- Disconnect an account

---

## **Setting a Default Connected Account**

The default connected account is the account HighLevel uses by default for the app when a default selection is needed. Setting a default helps reduce confusion when multiple external accounts are connected to the same Marketplace app.

To set a default connected account:

1. Go to **App Marketplace**.
2. Open the installed Marketplace app.
3. Click the **External Connection** tab.
4. Locate the account you want to use as the default.
5. Select the radio button in the **Default** column.
6. Confirm the success message that the default account was updated.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155071950480/original/z3qbBEWM_CfGDyN-qIZCDHE5oQe8067MuQ.png?1779398816)

---

## **Disconnecting an External Account**

Disconnecting an external account removes that OAuth connection from the Marketplace app. This action should only be used when the account is no longer needed or should no longer be available for that app.

To disconnect an external account:

1. Go to **App Marketplace**.
2. Open the installed Marketplace app.
3. Click the **External Connection** tab.
4. Find the connected account you want to remove.
5. Click the delete icon for that account.
6. Review the confirmation message.
7. Click **Delete** to disconnect the account.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155071950509/original/ufgDxJbv-YHP2eg04wJKPtbe-Qp5bMuBag.png?1779398893)

---

## **Availability for New and Existing Apps**

Multi-OAuth Support is available for new Marketplace apps or new app versions that support multiple OAuth connections. Existing apps do not automatically gain Multi-OAuth Support unless a new supported version is added.

This means:

- New apps can be built with Multi-OAuth Support.
- Existing apps may need a new version to support multiple OAuth connections.
- Users may need to update or reinstall an app version if the developer releases Multi-OAuth Support.
- Apps that do not support Multi-OAuth may continue to allow only one OAuth connection.

---

## **How To Use Multi-OAuth Support**

Using Multi-OAuth Support helps ensure each external account is connected, organized, and available for the app’s supported actions. The available options may vary depending on how the Marketplace app was built.

To use Multi-OAuth Support:

1. Open the sub-account where the Marketplace app is installed.
2. Go to **App Marketplace**.
3. Select the installed app.
4. Open the **External Connection** tab.
5. Click **Add Account** to connect another external account.
6. Complete the OAuth authorization flow.
7. Confirm the new account appears in the connected account list.
8. Set a default account if needed.
9. Refresh or disconnect accounts when they need to be updated or removed.

---

## **Frequently Asked Questions**

**Q: What is Multi-OAuth Support?**  
Multi-OAuth Support allows a single Marketplace app installation to connect and manage multiple external OAuth accounts.

**Q: Can I connect more than one external account to the same app?**  
Yes. When the Marketplace app supports Multi-OAuth, you can connect multiple external accounts from the app’s External Connection tab.

**Q: Do existing apps automatically support Multi-OAuth?**  
No. Multi-OAuth Support is available for new apps or new app versions that support multiple OAuth connections.

**Q: Where do I manage connected accounts?**  
Connected accounts are managed from the installed app’s **External Connection** tab.

**Q: Can I choose which account is used by default?**  
Yes. You can select a default connected account from the **Default** column when multiple accounts are connected.

**Q: What happens when I disconnect an account?**  
The selected external account is removed from the app’s connected accounts and can no longer be used by that app unless it is connected again.

**Q: Are OAuth tokens refreshed automatically?**  
Yes. HighLevel securely stores and refreshes connected account tokens through the platform.

**Q: Can Multi-OAuth be used for workflows, triggers, and actions?**  
Yes. Apps can use connected OAuth accounts for supported workflows, triggers, and actions, depending on how the app is built.

---

### **Related Articles**

- [Marketplace Apps - Managing External Connections](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000004585)
- [API Security - OAuth Consent for Marketplace Apps](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000005002)

##

title_en: Use the Custom Objects side panel
source_md:
The redesigned side panel turns a Custom Object record, such as a Property or an Insurance Policy, into a workspace you can act from. It brings the record's fields, associations, appointments, tasks, notes, and conversations into one place, and lets you start a conversation, book or link an appointment, and manage linked records without leaving the panel. The record list stays open in the background.

```
Note

This feature is available only through a private beta and applies only to locations where it has been enabled.
```

---

**TABLE OF CONTENTS**

- [Use a record as a hub](#Use-a-record-as-a-hub)
- [Open a record](#Open-a-record)
- [Review record details](#Review-record-details)
- [Switch between tabs](#Switch-between-tabs)
- [Work with Conversations](#Work-with-Conversations)
- [Work with Appointments](#Work-with-Appointments)
- [Book a meeting](#Book-a-meeting)
- [Link an existing appointment](#Link-an-existing-appointment)
- [Record actions](#Record-actions)
- [Frequently Asked Questions](#Frequently-Asked-Questions)
- [Editorial checks before publication](#Editorial-checks-before-publication)

---

# **Use a record as a hub**

Because each tab lets you take action as well as review, the record becomes the place your team works from.

- **Properties:**Keep a listing's potential buyers, viewing appointments, and enquiries on the Property.
- **Insurance Policies:**Keep policyholders, renewal conversations, tasks, and notes with the Policy they belong to.
- **Any Custom Object:**Use the same tabs for whatever your object tracks, such as units, pets, or vehicles.

---

## **Open a record**

- Select the Custom Object from the left sidebar, then click a record in its list.

The record opens in the side panel. Use the arrows at the top to move to the previous or next record in the current list. Use **Close** to return to the list.

---

## **Review record details**

The **Details** tab shows the record's name, **Owner** and **Followers**, associations, and fields.

- **Associations:**Review linked records grouped by relationship. Use the add control beside a relationship to open its association selector, or **View all** when shown to see more associations.
- **Search fields and folders:**Find a field or folder without scrolling through the full record.
- **Hide empty fields:**Focus on fields that have values.
- **Folders and counts:**Expand folders to find their fields and see the field count.
- **Edit fields:**Click a field value to open its editor.

**Step 1:** Open a Custom Object, such as Properties, and click a record.

![Step 1: Open a Custom Object, such as Properties, and click a record.](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155084158146/original/dqZ-NwpyGJkPNQJ5xRmj4g8VKnIC9xs08g.png?1792994205)

**Step 2:** Review associations and fields in Details. Use field search and Hide empty fields to narrow the view.

![Step 2: Review associations and fields in Details. Use field search and Hide empty fields to narrow the view.](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155084158144/original/X2UiFW2M_htF9retGifkKAeOpJMB1hbdRA.png?1792994205)

**Step 3:** Use the icons on the right to switch tabs, such as Associations.

![Step 3: Use the icons on the right to switch tabs, such as Associations.](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155084158142/original/N6VeqwEOgZVpocud6dkeXb1jiiXX6dqNnA.png?1792994204)

**Step 4:** Open the three-dot menu to copy the record ID, view audit logs, or delete the record.

![Step 4: Open the three-dot menu to copy the record ID, view audit logs, or delete the record.](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155084158143/original/loyNOyx6SX6kS3kWLulyLB_mBfd1kvJL8Q.png?1792994205)

**Step 5:** Use the arrows at the top to move to the previous or next record.

![Step 5: Use the arrows at the top to move to the previous or next record.](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155084158138/original/x6EXBOdD9A6pVPR7RBU3U_qBkujSSbT_Fg.png?1792994204)

---

## **Switch between tabs**

Use the icons on the right edge of the panel:

| **Tab** | **Purpose** |
| --- | --- |
| Details | Review the record's fields and associations |
| Appointments | Review appointments linked to the record, book an appointment, or link an existing one |
| Associations | Open the record's associations section |
| Tasks | Open the record's tasks section |
| Notes | Open the record's notes section |
| Conversations | Review or create conversations associated with the record |

---

## **Work with Conversations**

1. Open the record and select **Conversations**.
2. Review the conversation feed. If there are no linked conversations, the panel shows an empty state.
3. Click **Create a conversation** or **Create new conversation**.
4. Select a **Contact**. The current record is already marked **Linked**.
5. Click **Create conversation** to continue.

The Contact is the person involved in the conversation. The linked record gives the conversation its Custom Object context.

**Step 6:** In Conversations, click Create a conversation. The record is already Linked. Select a Contact and continue.

![Step 6: In Conversations, click Create a conversation. The record is already Linked. Select a Contact and continue.](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155084158141/original/mAqDqMBJU5TkVP-Q57_4ZHD6jlzi0e0BSw.png?1792994204)

---

## **Work with Appointments**

1. Open the record and select **Appointments**.
2. Switch between **Upcoming** and **Past**.
3. Use **Search by Calendar Name** to find appointments.
4. Click **Add** to choose **Meetings**, **Services**, or **Link existing appointment**.

**Step 7:** In Appointments, click Add, then choose Meetings, Services, or Link existing appointment.

![Step 7: In Appointments, click Add, then choose Meetings, Services, or Link existing appointment.](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155084158139/original/NuGq7vPnJxJrU0JmhGyvwkJxPMgC1KTLmw.png?1792994205)

---

### **Book a meeting**

1. Select **Add → Meetings**.
2. Choose the calendar, appointment details, date, time, and Contact.
3. Review **Associated objects**. The current record is preselected.
4. Review the remaining booking details, then select **Book appointment**.

**Step 8:** When booking a meeting, open Associated objects to confirm the current record is preselected.

![Step 8: When booking a meeting, open Associated objects to confirm the current record is preselected.](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155084158145/original/tCL7lLTmuDiygCRyHenDXaX66kwgi4AC4w.png?1792994204)

---

### **Link an existing appointment**

1. Select **Add → Link existing appointment**.
2. Search for an appointment in the current location.
3. Select **Link** beside the appointment you want associated with this record.

**Step 9:** To use a booking that already exists, choose Link existing appointment, search, and click Link.

![Step 9: To use a booking that already exists, choose Link existing appointment, search, and click Link.](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155084158140/original/sd6Rff5eu74-9JZaGFbvFoNsiLAMILrZjA.png?1792994204)

---

## **Record actions**

Open the three-dot menu at the top of the panel to access **Copy record ID**, **View audit logs**, or **Delete**.

---

## **Frequently Asked Questions**

**Q: Why is the Conversations tab empty?**

The selected record has no conversations in its feed. You can start one from **Create a conversation** and choose a Contact.

**Q: Can I link an appointment that already exists?**

Yes. Open **Appointments → Add → Link existing appointment**, search, and select **Link** beside the appointment.

**Q: Why do I need to choose a Contact?**

Conversation creation requires a Contact. The current record is linked separately to provide context. The meeting booking form also requires a Contact.

**Q: Does this panel include Opportunity pipeline controls or a Payments tab?**

The Custom Objects panel has six tabs: Details, Appointments, Associations, Tasks, Notes, and Conversations. Opportunity-specific pipeline controls and a Payments tab are not present in this panel.

##

title_en: Contacts - Export as CSV Upgrade
source_md:
Exporting contacts from HighLevel is a simple process that allows you to download and store customer information for various purposes. Whether you need to back up your contact list, migrate data to another CRM, or analyze customer details, exporting to a **CSV (Comma-Separated Values) file** makes it easy. This guide will walk you through the process step by step, explain key export settings, and answer common questions.

---

**TABLE OF CONTENTS**

- [What is Export Contacts as CSV Upgrade?](#What-is-Export-Contacts-as-CSV-Upgrade?)
- [Key Benefits of Contacts Export Upgrade](#Key-Benefits-of-Contacts-Export-Upgrade)
- [Why Export Contacts](#Why-Export-Contacts)
- [Prerequisites and Limitations](#Prerequisites-and-Limitations)
- [How to Export Contacts as a CSV](#How-to-Export-Contacts-as-a-CSV)
- [Frequently Asked Questions](#Frequently-Asked-Questions)
- [Related Articles](#Related-Articles)

---

# **What is Export Contacts as CSV Upgrade?**

The Contacts Export Upgrade replaces the old, browser-based export with a scalable backend service. Instead of waiting for a CSV to download in the foreground, your export job is queued on HighLevel’s servers, processed in parallel, and tracked in real time from the Bulk Actions dashboard. Once complete, a ready-to-download file appears in Bulk Actions and remains available for 30 days.

---

## **Key Benefits of Contacts Export Upgrade**

- **Work Uninterrupted:** Exports run asynchronously—no UI blocking.
- **Scales to Big Data:** Far fewer failures on multi-million-row datasets.
- **Real-time Visibility:** Track progress on the Bulk Actions page.
- **Hands-free Alerts:** Get notified when files are ready—no manual checks.
- **Built-in Retention:** 30-day cloud storage protects against accidental loss.
- **Controlled Access:** Admin-only downloads support security and compliance.

---

## **Why Export Contacts**

The **Export Contacts** feature lets users download their HighLevel contacts into a CSV file. The exported file contains important details such as names, email addresses, phone numbers, tags, and custom fields (if selected). Some more reasons/use cases are as follows:

- **CRM Migration** – Moving contacts to a different CRM platform.
- **Marketing & Outreach** – Creating lists for email or SMS campaigns.
- **Data Backup & Security** – Storing an offline copy of your contacts.
- **Team Collaboration** – Sharing lists with colleagues or business partners.
- **Analytics & Reporting** – Using data to generate insights.

---

## **Prerequisites and Limitations**

- The file will be in **CSV format**and can be opened in **Excel, Google Sheets, or any spreadsheet software**.
- Some data, such as **notes exceeding 255 characters**, may be truncated.
- Exports do **not include automation history** (e.g., past emails, and SMS logs).
- **Only Admin Users Can Export Contacts.** If you do not see the export option, check your user role permissions or contact an admin.

---

## **How to Export Contacts as a CSV**

### **Step 1**: Navigate to the Contacts Page

1. Navigate to **Contacts** from your sub-account.
2. Click on **Smart** **Lists**.

![](https://jumpshare.com/share/1mr76Pjvq41YC62X9d9e+/Screen+Shot+2025-10-14+at+11.34.56+PM.png)

### **Step 2:** Selecting Contacts for Export

1. Use the **Advance Filters** to refine your selection.  
     
   ![](https://jumpshare.com/share/ccdRtfqt7fDs0vehmNIg+/Screen+Shot+2025-10-14+at+11.41.32+PM.png)
2. Check the **boxes** next to the contacts you want to export.
3. To export **all contacts**, click on the checkbox beside the filter fields (on the left) and click on **Select All Contacts.**  
     
   ![](https://jumpshare.com/share/Vqe73k6mjY8tZM1OvVRd+/Screen+Shot+2025-10-14+at+11.49.03+PM.png)

### **Step 3:** Customize Fields (Optional)

```
Note: The CSV file will only contain the columns that are currently visible in the Contacts table. If a field is missing in your exported data, go back and check the column settings before exporting again.
```

1. Click on the **Manage Fields** button.
2. **Check** or **Uncheck** boxes to include or exclude specific columns in the export.
3. Once you’ve selected the desired columns, they will be reflected in the **E****xported CSV file**.

![](https://jumpshare.com/share/O2M5Xzrwz5DHeEd8aIoB+/Screen+Shot+2025-10-14+at+11.56.10+PM.png)

### **Step 4:** Export Contacts

1. After selecting contacts, click on **More.**
2. Click on **Export**.  
     
   ![](https://jumpshare.com/share/6zQc3Epuz42Miqq7DVRu+/Screen+Shot+2025-10-15+at+12.02.19+AM.png)
3. or, click on the **three** **dots** beside + Add Contact button and click on **Export.**  
      
   ![](https://jumpshare.com/share/eP9CCZoxSiHY1eSTvI1A+/Screen+Shot+2025-10-15+at+12.12.16+AM.png)
4. Confirm your selection in the export modal and click on **Export**.  
     
   ![](https://jumpshare.com/share/GP9NMEGJgCLCd50wQuF6+/Screen+Shot+2025-10-15+at+12.19.41+AM.png)
5. You’ll see a success message indicating that the export has started.
6. Click on **Check** **Progress** to see the status of the export in Bulk actions or simply dismiss.
7. You can continue working—export runs asynchronously in the background.  
     
   ![](https://jumpshare.com/share/bspEDo6C9zEIv4dPwKC7+/Screen+Shot+2025-10-15+at+12.21.06+AM.png)
8. You’ll receive a **push notification** once the export file is ready for download.  
     
   ![](https://jumpshare.com/share/gDd8rmSp2UE2Pt8RPKSN+/Screen+Shot+2025-10-15+at+12.31.07+AM.png)

### **Step 5:** Downloading from Bulk Actions

1. Go to **Contacts** > **Bulk Actions**.  
     
   ![](https://jumpshare.com/share/pWdaJHArDfA6JcwH3SCR+/Screen+Shot+2025-10-15+at+12.34.45+AM.png)
2. Locate your export row — you’ll see:

   1. **Operation:** *Export*
   2. **Status:** *Complete*
   3. **File name:** e.g., Export\_Contacts\_All\_Oct\_2025.csv
3. Click **Down Arrow(Download)**icon to save the file to your system.
4. After **30** days, the download link will be **disabled**.  
     
   ![](https://jumpshare.com/share/VzqB5D4os1qDi2UVAXBx+/Screen+Shot+2025-10-15+at+12.38.43+AM.png)

---

## **Frequently Asked Questions**

**Q: Where will the file be downloaded to?**

The file will be saved to your device’s local storage (local drive).

**Q: Can I export only specific data fields for each contact in the exported .csv file?**

You can customize the columns in the exported .csv file by selecting or deselecting specific data fields before initiating the export. This way, you can focus on the most relevant information.

**Q: What happens if a contact's latest note exceeds 255 characters?**

Only the latest note of up to 255 characters is included when exporting contacts. If a contact's latest note is longer than this limit, it will be truncated to fit within the 255-character constraint.

**Q: Can I export contacts from multiple accounts or locations simultaneously?**

You must export contacts separately for each sub-account or location. However, you can combine the resulting .csv files in a spreadsheet application to consolidate contact data from multiple sources.

**Q: Is it possible to schedule automatic exports of contact data?**

This feature is not available at this time.

**Q: Who can download exported files?**  
Only **Agency Admins** and **Location Admins** can download completed exports from Bulk Actions.

**Q: How long are exported files available?**  
Export files are available for 30 days. After that, the download option is disabled.

**Q: How do I import the exported .csv file into another contact management platform?**

Most contact management platforms provide an import feature that supports .csv files. You will need to follow the specific import instructions for the target platform, which typically involves mapping the columns in the .csv file to the appropriate fields in the new system.

---

## **Related Articles**

- [Getting Started - Create New Contact](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000005055)
- [Bulk Importing Contacts Via CSV Walkthrough](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/48000982206-bulk-importing-contacts-via-csv-walkthrough)
- [Getting Started with Smart Lists](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/48001062094-getting-started-with-smart-lists)
- [Contacts - Manage and Merge Duplicates](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000006647)

title_en: Agent Studio - Setting Up Triggers for Flow Agents
source_md:
Use Agent Studio Triggers to start an AI agent automatically when a contact action or system event happens in HighLevel. Real-time starts help you respond faster, reduce manual work, and launch the right automation at the moment a trigger occurs. This article explains how to configure real-time Start triggers for existing Flow Agents in HighLevel.

```
Important: Agent Studio now includes Managed Agents and Flow Agents. New agent creation should be done using Managed Agents. Existing Flow Agents continue to run normally and can still be opened, edited, and managed from the Flow Agents page.
```

[동영상](https://www.youtube.com/embed/UZis06CQ\_AQ?&wmode=opaque)

---

# **What are Triggers for Flow Agents?**

Flow Agent Triggers are event listeners attached to an agent’s Start node that automatically launch the agent when a supported platform event occurs. By reacting to real user actions like submitting a form or sending a chat, agents can engage contacts immediately without external API calls or manual steps.

---

## **Key Benefits of Flow Agent Triggers**

- **Real‑time engagement**: Respond to leads the moment they act—submit a form, message your business, or get tagged.

- **Hands‑free scalability**: Remove polling scripts and custom web-hooks and configure an in‑product trigger and publish.

- **Consistent entry point**: Standardize how agents start so testing and troubleshooting are easier.

- **Non‑breaking adoption**: Triggers are optional and additive; existing API‑based agents continue to work.

- **Foundation for growth**: Event‑driven design sets the stage for additional event types over time.

---

## **How to Set Up Flow Agent Triggers**

Follow these steps to create a reliable, testable, and production‑ready trigger configuration from start to finish.

```
Prerequisites & Access: 

Confirm access and environment so your trigger setup goes smoothly and matches your deployment process.

Access AI Agents → Agent Studio inside the correct sub‑account/location.

See How to Setup Flow Agents in Agent Studio for canvas navigation, testing, and publish lifecycle.
```

1. From the left sidebar, click **AI Agents**, then select the **Agent Studio** tab at the top.
2. Click on the **Flow Agents** button.  
      
   ![](https://jumpshare.com/share/GHcBJsQLzhbMZnJ8U7Nd+/Screen+Shot+2026-07-08+at+18.27.14.png)
3. **Click** an **existing** **agent's** **name** to edit it.
4. Inside the agent, you’ll see the builder canvas with nodes and a plus control. Use **Add New Node** to begin building or locate the starting area of your existing flow.
5. From the node picker, choose **Start trigger** under **Flow Control**. This places a trigger tile that listens for events to start your agent.
6. In the **Select trigger** panel, pick **Form submitted**, **Lead tag**, **Chat message** or **Workflows** to define what starts the agent. Your choice determines which configuration options appear next.  
     
   1. **Form Submitted Trigger:**Use this when you want an agent to engage immediately after a contact completes a HighLevel‑tracked form, ideal for instant nurture, qualification, or routing. It:  
        
      - Starts the agent when any selected form is submitted.
      - Exposes submitted form fields as variables your agent can reference in later steps.
   2. **Lead Tag Trigger (Added / Removed):**Fire targeted automations when a tag is applied to or removed from a contact. Common uses include VIP onboarding, re‑engagement, or churn‑prevention.  
        
      - Starts the agent when a selected tag is **added** or **removed** from a contact.
      - Provides the contact context (including existing tags and custom fields) to your flow.
   3. **Chat Message Trigger:**Start your agent the instant a new inbound message arrives through supported chat widgets/providers, this trigger is ideal for instant replies, smart routing, or FAQ deflection.  
        
      - Requires no additional configuration, add the trigger and publish.
      - Provides message text, sender details, and conversation context for your flow logic.
   4. **Workflows Trigger:**Check out this article for better understanding - [Workflow Action - Invoke Agent Studio Agent](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000007402)  
        
      ![](https://jumpshare.com/share/VOcHRyGZDNtg9Rs7gUEg+/GIF+Recording+2026-07-08+at+18.48.55.gif)
7. **Setup the Triggers:**  
   **Select Forms**  
     
   For **Form submitted**trigger, use the dropdown to choose one or more forms, or click **Add new** if the form isn’t created yet. The agent will start whenever any selected form is submitted.       
             
   **Choose Tag Action**          
             
   For **Lead tag**, set **Tag action** to **Tag added** or **Tag removed**. This decides whether the agent starts when a tag is applied to a contact or when it’s removed.       
             
   **Select** the **specific** **tag**from the list, or create one with **Add new**. The agent listens only for changes to the tags you select here.       
             
   When bulk‑adding tags for testing, consider using a small test segment first to avoid triggering many agent runs at once.          
             
   **Enable Chat Trigger**          
             
   For **Chat message**, no additional configuration is required. The agent will start automatically whenever a new inbound message arrives through connected chat channels.       
             
   ![](https://jumpshare.com/share/uDIC7Gt97CHnFzAx8Odr+/GIF+Recording+2026-07-08+at+19.25.55.gif)
8. **Validate & Go Live**

- **Test:**Run a safe simulation of the selected trigger to see exactly which variables and payload the agent receives, no live contacts are affected. Use this to iterate quickly on prompts/nodes and verify the flow before publishing.

- **Save:**Store your current changes as a Staging version so you don’t lose work and can return later; nothing goes live yet. Saving is ideal after each configuration step (e.g., choosing forms or tags) to keep a clean working version.

- **Publish:**Push the current agent and its Start trigger live for this sub-account so real events immediately start the agent. Publish after successful Tests, ensuring the Start trigger is connected to the first node; if the agent is mapped to other features (e.g., Ask AI), it typically must be in Production to be selectable.  
    
  ![](https://jumpshare.com/share/wId879x6RlnN0bG3qxtc+/Screen+Shot+2026-07-08+at+19.29.51.png)

---

## **Frequently Asked Questions**

**Q: Can I create a new Flow Agent for real-time Start triggers?**  
No. New agent creation should now be done using Managed Agents. Existing Flow Agents can still be opened, edited, and managed from the Flow Agents page.

**Q: Will my existing Flow Agent triggers continue to work?**  
Yes. Existing Flow Agents and their configured triggers continue to run normally.

**Q: Do triggers change how my existing API‑invoked agents run?**

No. Triggers are additive. Your existing API flows continue to work; triggers only run for agents where you’ve added a Start trigger.

**Q: Can I test before going live?**

Yes. Use the canvas **Test** option to simulate the event and validate variables and responses before publishing.

**Q: Which chat sources are supported?**

Triggers work with HighLevel’s existing chat widgets/providers connected to your sub‑account. No extra configuration is required to start.

**Q: What data is available to my agent when a trigger fires?**

Form submissions include mapped form fields; Lead tag events include contact context; Chat message events include message text and conversation metadata.

**Q: What if I don’t see my form or tag in the dropdown?**

Confirm you’re in the correct sub‑account/location and that the asset exists there. Refresh the builder after creating new forms/tags.

---

### **Related Articles**

- [How to Setup Flow Agents in Agent Studio](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000007393)
- [Ask AI + Agent Studio Integration](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000006677)
- [Agent Studio - Router Tool (AI & Conditional Router)](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000007404)
- [Workflow Action - Invoke Agent Studio Agent](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000007402)

title_en: Global Custom Colors in Color Picker
source_md:
Global Custom Colors let you save brand‑safe colors once and reuse them across HighLevel. Add your palette in Brand Boards and it appears in color pickers across emails, funnels, and forms. Colors are two‑way synced—update a saved color and designs using that global color update automatically.

[동영상](https://www.youtube.com/embed/wy42TQRUn80?&wmode=opaque)

---

**TABLE OF CONTENTS**

- [What are Global Custom Colors?](#What-are-Global-Custom-Colors?)
- [Key Benefits of Global Custom Colors](#Key-Benefits-of-Global-Custom-Colors)
- [Sync Behavior & Best Practices](#Sync-Behavior-&-Best-Practices)
- [Using Global Settings to Add, Edit & Delete Global Colors](#Using-Global-Settings-to-Add,-Edit-&-Delete-Global-Colors)
- [Import Global Custom Colors from Custom Values](#Import-Global-Custom-Colors-from-Custom-Values)
- [Using Global Custom Colors in Builders (Color Picker)](#Using-Global-Custom-Colors-in-Builders-(Color-Picker))
- [Frequently Asked Questions](#Frequently-Asked-Questions)
- [Related Articles](#Related-Articles)

---

# **What are Global Custom Colors?**

Global Custom Colors are reusable color swatches you define under **Brand Boards → Global Settings.** They surface in the Color Picker throughout builders so teams can apply the exact same brand colors, keep assets consistent, and update them centrally when colors change.

**How it differs from Design Kit colors (Brand Boards):**Design Kit colors live inside a Brand Board and also appear in pickers. Global Custom Colors are an additional, centrally managed palette designed for fast reuse and two‑way syncing on applied instances. Both can appear in the picker; Global Custom Colors only show after you add at least one color.

---

## **Sync Behavior & Best Practices**

- **Two‑way sync on applied instances:** Updating a saved global color updates designs that used that specific global swatch.
- **Add at least one color:** The Global Custom Colors section appears in the picker only after you create at least one color, helping distinguish it from Design Kit colors.
- **Name clearly:** Use functional names (Primary, Secondary, Accent) so teams know which swatch to use.
- **Plan rebrands:** For large changes, duplicate designs if needed, then adjust global colors to propagate updates consistently.

---

## **Using Global Settings to Add, Edit & Delete Global Colors**

Use Global Settings to add, name, organize, and manage the colors your team will reuse across builders. Creating at least one color enables the Global Custom Colors section to appear inside the Color Picker.

### **Add a New Global Color**

1. Go to **Marketing → Brand Boards** **→****Global Settings**.  
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155055025570/original/ZqO6b_vTELt36zUV3riYrSNJyxDzEDsn7w.png?1759335619)
2. Click**+ Add**then**Add New.**  
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155055025622/original/ljAkjeA_CznVSIP8CCRWd0Eih8UqpNQCsA.png?1759335661)
3. Enter a **Name** (e.g., Primary, Accent, Background) and a **HEX/RGB value** (for example: `#1A73E8`) or select a color from the color picker.  
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155055025696/original/Qwq4yLXAk7k9YXbgD-mVfihglAHWQy-8rQ.png?1759335736)
4. Click **Save**.  
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155055025720/original/BvuBURcJZypMtOWvbFQx7FLmuOkajIEbNw.png?1759335765)

### **Edit, Rename, or Delete a Global Color**

You are able to edit, rename and delete existing Global Colors from within Global Settings in Brand Boards.

```
Caution: Deleting removes the color from pickers; designs that used that color may update to reflect the removal depending on how the builder stores swatches.
```

- To delete a Global Color, click the **t****rash can icon.****![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155055025839/original/i6jhTZ6JpItE7uYcazq_eSQ4ygDiLW4CqQ.png?1759335938)**

- To edit or rename a Global Color, click the **Edit (Pencil) icon.**This opens the color picker where you can make the required edits.  
    
  ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155055025927/original/__NFp1Xhgh5mNBbfNk5piCMMN-scZ7PdsQ.png?1759336024)

---

## **Import Global Custom Colors from Custom Values**

If you already store brand colors as Custom Values, import them to quickly populate your Global Custom Colors palette. Import copies eligible values into Global Settings for central management.

**Before You Start**

- Confirm your Custom Values contain valid color entries (commonly HEX codes like `#000000`).
- Use clear names (e.g., `Primary_Color`, `Button_BG`) to make mapping easier when importing.

**Import Steps**

1. Go to **Marketing → Brand Boards → Global Settings**.  
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155055026094/original/GlDDTugnVQsfCsd2OUR-J3isPueA_G8TEw.jpeg?1759336218)
2. Click **+ Add** then **Import**.  
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155055026139/original/Hfe6C7a42US4Dt-a9vQclDI3CdaV7w4VdQ.png?1759336291)
3. Select the Custom Values that represent colors and click **Import**. If any selected value isn’t a valid color (e.g., not a HEX code), skip or correct it before importing.  
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155055026205/original/oBHz1P0lH9irGCccU6Qn_3cJk7Bz3kQP3w.png?1759336350)

---

## **Using Global Custom Colors in Builders (Color Picker)**

Once at least one Global Custom Color is saved, a “Global Custom Colors” group appears in the Color Picker inside supported builders. This makes it easy to apply the exact, approved swatches everywhere.

### **Where you’ll see it**

- Emails (drag‑and‑drop builder)
- Funnels & Websites (page builder)
- Forms & Surveys
- Countdown Timers

### **Apply a Global Color within an Editor**

1. Open the builder (e.g., Email, Funnel Page, Countdown Timeror Form) and select any element with a color setting (text, button, background, border).
2. Open the **Color Picker**.
3. Click a swatch under **Global Custom Colors** to apply it.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155055027781/original/vP4OO7Vv4okDp9mvz9Wsl3GiiJuocBAy1g.png?1759338087)

### **Manage from the Color Picker**

Click **Manage** in the Color Picker to jump directly to Global Settings (when available), where you can add or adjust colors.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155055027806/original/ll37T6ttin2ZOxIq-AUbNMEfMnkev8rTuw.png?1759338117)

---

## **Frequently Asked Questions**

**Q: Will changing a Global Color update my existing assets?**  
Yes. Global Custom Colors are two-way synced. Any change reflects instantly across all designs where that color is applied.

**Q: Why don’t I see Global Colors in the color picker?**  
The section only appears if you’ve added at least one color in Global Settings.

**Q: Can I import my existing custom value based colors?**  
Yes. You can import them from the Custom Values section into Global Settings. This only creates a copy and does not lift and shift the custom value based colors.

**Q: How is this different from Design Kit colors?**  
Design Kit colors are for quick access only and do not sync. Global Custom Colors sync across all assets.

**Q: Can agencies use this for client onboarding?**  
Absolutely! Agencies can clone funnels/emails and simply update the Global Colors to instantly rebrand for new clients.

---

### **Related Articles**

- [Use Brand Boards in Funnels & Websites](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000003231)
- [Use Brand Boards in Emails](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000003137)

title_en: How to Use Git Sync in AI Studio
source_md:
[동영상](https://jumpshare.com/embed/zzBLvqEUL2SjTTMy27fM?disableDownload=true)

Git Sync in HighLevel AI Studio connects your projects to Git repositories, allowing code changes to synchronize between AI Studio and external development tools. You can work with tools such as Cursor, Claude Code, Codex, GitHub Copilot, and Gemini CLI while keeping your project versions up to date. Automatic synchronization, version tracking, and branch management make it easier to develop projects without manually transferring code.

---

**TABLE OF CONTENTS**

- [What is Git Sync in AI Studio?](#What-is-Git-Sync-in-AI-Studio?)
- [How to Set Up Git Sync with GitHub in AI Studio](#How-to-Set-Up-Git-Sync-with-GitHub-in-AI-Studio)
- [Automatic Push and Pull Synchronization](#Automatic-Push-and-Pull-Synchronization)
- [Managing Git Sync in AI Studio](#Managing-Git-Sync-in-AI-Studio)
  - [Switch or Create a Branch](#Switch-or-Create-a-Branch)
  - [View Sync History](#View-Sync-History)
  - [Disconnect or Reconnect GitHub](#Disconnect-or-Reconnect-GitHub)
- [Related Articles](#Related-Articles)

---

# **What is Git Sync in AI Studio?**

Git Sync is a two-way integration that keeps code changes synchronized between AI Studio and a connected Git repository. When you connect a GitHub account, AI Studio automatically creates a private repository for your project and pushes its initial version to GitHub.

Git Sync allows you to:

- **Sync changes automatically:** Push saved AI Studio versions to GitHub and pull external commits back into AI Studio.
- **Work with external development tools:** Edit project code outside AI Studio without manually transferring files.
- **Track changes:** Maintain project versions and Git commit history.
- **Review updates:** Generate new preview builds after pulling external changes.
- **Manage development:** Switch branches, monitor synchronization activity, and resolve conflicts.

Git Sync supports React (Vite) and TanStack Start projects, including dependency and lockfile changes. Images, fonts, and other binary files are preserved during synchronization, although the AI Studio Code Editor cannot preview binary files.

Git Sync is optional. Projects without a Git connection continue working normally.

```
Note: Git Sync uses Git, which is supported by GitHub and other repository providers. While this article covers GitHub, support for additional Git-based providers, including privately hosted repositories, may vary.
```

---

## **How to Set Up Git Sync with GitHub in AI Studio**

Connecting GitHub creates a private repository for your project and enables automatic synchronization. You can connect a personal account or organization and choose who can use the connection.

```
Before you begin: Make sure your user has the Manage Git & download code permission under Settings → Team → Permissions → AI Studio. This permission is enabled by default for agency and sub-account roles.
```

1. Open your HighLevel sub-account, navigate to **AI Studio**, and select your project.
2. Click **More → Git**, then select **GitHub**.
3. Click + Add connection to connect a new GitHub account. If your account is already listed, click Connect.
4. Choose **My GitHub account** or **Organization**, then select who can use the connection:

   - **Only me:** Available only to you.
   - **Sub-account:** Available to other users within the sub-account, subject to their permissions.
5. Click **Continue on GitHub**.
6. Install and authorize **Lead Connector** on GitHub. Complete any required verification. Organization members may need administrator approval.
7. Return to AI Studio and allow the connection to finish. AI Studio creates a private repository, pushes the initial version, and connects to the *main* branch.
8. Confirm that **Automatic Push** and **Automatic Pull** are enabled. Both are on by default.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155083694185/original/74yAQJnJwZj4huZDAIWGfYGAcyz-ZpohMw.gif?1792431237)

---

## **Automatic Push and Pull Synchronization**

Git Sync automatically keeps your AI Studio project and GitHub repository synchronized. Both Automatic Push and Automatic Pull are enabled by default and can be turned off independently.

- **Automatic Push:** Every saved AI Studio version is pushed to GitHub, including AI-generated changes, code edits, visual edits, and restored versions. Commits retain their original history and are attributed to LeadConnector ([noreply@leadconnectorhq.com](mailto:noreply@gohighlevel.com)) rather than your personal GitHub identity.
- **Automatic Pull:** New commits on the connected GitHub branch are automatically pulled into AI Studio. Each commit creates a new project version, displays the changed files in a chat card, and generates an updated preview.

When the preview is ready, click **Refresh preview** to see the latest changes. You can also use **Push now** or **Pull now** in **More → Git** to synchronize manually, even when automatic synchronization is disabled.

**Sync Conflicts:**If both GitHub and AI Studio have new commits, the branch is marked as diverged in Git settings. Select Review and resolve to choose between Force push (keeps the AI Studio version and can overwrite divergent GitHub commits) or New branch (pushes AI Studio changes to a new branch, preserving both versions).

```
Note: Git Sync scans outgoing changes for sensitive credentials. Recognized secrets block the push, while potentially hardcoded credentials generate warnings.
```

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155083693214/original/w-Hsut6rFeEvn8ZtUr0aw5_n2RzAxELbgw.png?1792430572)

---

## **Managing Git Sync in AI Studio**

Once Git Sync is connected, you can switch branches, review synchronization history, and manage your GitHub connection directly from your project's Git settings.

### **Switch or Create a Branch**

Git Sync uses the `main` branch by default, but you can work with other branches when needed.

1. Open your AI Studio project and go to **More → Git**.
2. Locate the branch selector and choose an existing branch or enter a new branch name.
3. Confirm your selection. If the branch does not exist, AI Studio creates it during the next push.

Only the selected branch receives incoming commits from GitHub. Changes on other branches are not pulled until you switch to them.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155083693454/original/2ZLmSfniO4Ls1hFIoYiOoQ5YI7QWMKsA6g.png?1792430740)

### **View Sync History**

Sync History helps you confirm whether changes were successfully transferred between AI Studio and GitHub.

1. Open **More → Git** in your AI Studio project.
2. Select **Sync History** to view recent activity, including pushes, pulls, commit records, and synchronization errors.

You can also view total syncs, success rate, and links to individual commits on GitHub. Failed operations include details explaining what went wrong.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155083695377/original/IHfszLZ9Kjf1BQLj384hclM2Eofxs55KDw.png?1792432382)

### **Disconnect or Reconnect GitHub**

You can manage your GitHub connection from **More → Git**.

Use **Disconnect** to disconnect the project from GitHub, or reconnect an account when its authorization needs to be renewed. When reconnecting a previously connected project, AI Studio can reuse its existing repository rather than creating a new one, without automatically force-pushing changes.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155083693835/original/XGudGCDAlAqLVrunpahYD-pJ0XmCbEq1Rw.png?1792430979)

---

#### **Overview**

Welcome to **Rentals**, our new scheduling and booking system designed for businesses that manage rentals — whether it’s cars, equipment, properties, or other bookable assets. With Rentals, you can efficiently manage availability, inventory, pricing, and multi-day bookings in one seamless platform.

---

## **What's New in Rentals**

Rentals is built to handle the unique complexities of rental-based scheduling. Here’s what’s Rentals can do:

- #### **Multi-Day Booking Support:**Book assets across multiple hours, days, weeks, or months, with flexible duration and booking controls.
- #### **Listings and Categories: [(Help Guide)](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000006573)**Create listings for your rentals with detailed information, organized categories, and status management.
- #### **Inventory & Variants: [(Help Guide)](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000006579)**Enable quantity tracking for multiple units and define variants for different versions of the same listing.
- #### **Advanced Pricing & Discounts: [(Help Guide)](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000006611)**Use pricing rules for seasons, days of the week, hour of day, durations, or quantities. Automatically apply discounts for long-term or bulk bookings.
- #### **Calendar View: [(Help Guide)](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000006641)**View all bookings visually using a modern, filterable calendar that supports day, week, and month views. Identify overlaps, blocked slots, and real-time availability.
- #### **External Calendar Sync:**Connect and sync bookings with third party platforms using Calendar Sync to ensure your availability is consistent across platforms.
- #### **Centralized Global Settings: [(Help Guide)](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000006640)**Control business operating hours, booking defaults, payment preferences, and communication templates from one location.
- #### **Built-in Payments and Invoicing:**Collect payments directly from the booking flow and generate invoices automatically for each confirmed booking. Setup security deposits per your business needs.
- #### **Customer Booking Page:**Offer customers a streamlined booking experience with a dedicated public-facing booking page that displays your listings, categories, pricing and availability in real-time.

---

## **How to Enable/Disable Rentals for a Single Sub-Account****?**

Rentals will be enabled by default for all your new locations. However, to enable/disable it for locations, you can follow the below steps.

You can enable/disable Rentals for sub-accounts directly from **Agency Settings**. Follow these steps to activate/deactivate Rentals in a single sub-account!

- From the Agency dashboard, select the **Sub-Accounts**tab on the left-side navigation bar

####

- Click the **Three Dots (⋮)**icon in the bottom right of the sub-account panel

#### 

#### **Step 3:**Turn on Rentals (Single Sub-Account)

- Select **Calendar Settings**from the top navigation bar
- Use the toggle to Turn On **Rentals**
- Click the blue **Save** button to save your changes

## **How to Manage Rentals for Multiple Sub-Accounts****?**

You can enable/disable Rentals for sub-accounts directly from **Agency Settings**. Follow these steps to activate Rentals for multiple sub-accounts at once!

- From the Agency dashboard, select the **Sub-Accounts**tab on the left-side navigation bar

---

## **Next: [Rentals Calendars - Overview & How to Get Started](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000006649)**

---

## **Upcoming Features**

We're constantly working to enhance **Rentals**. Here’s a sneak peek of what's coming up in the future:

- **Conversation AI** and **Voice AI**support

4. #### **Connect With Us on Facebook**Prefer chatting on social? Reach out via our Facebook profiles:

   - [Mayank Jain](https://www.facebook.com/mayank2511)– PM, Calendars
   - [Swadha Bhoj](https://www.facebook.com/swadha.highlevel) – PM, Calendars

**Q: How can I check if Rentals is activated for any location?**  
A: Go to **Calendars → Calendar Settings** to see if the **Rentals** tab is visible.

**Q: I was a part of the beta, will my data transfer to the general release?**
