title_en: Meeting Room in HighLevel: Overview
source_md:
Meeting Room is HighLevel's built-in video conferencing solution for client calls, team meetings, training sessions, and more. You can create reusable meeting links, start video calls instantly, collaborate with participants, and access recordings, transcripts, and AI-powered meeting summaries in one place.

```
Important: The Meeting Room feature is exclusive to Agencies subscribed to the Founder Plan ($497). It is not available to users on the $97 or $297 plans.
```

---

**TABLE OF CONTENTS**

- [What Is Meeting Room?](#What-Is-Meeting-Room?)
- [Key Features of Meeting Room](#Key-Features-of-Meeting-Room)
- [Video Meetings and Collaboration](#Video-Meetings-and-Collaboration)
- [Meeting Management and Security](#Meeting-Management-and-Security)
- [Recordings, Transcripts, and AI](#Recordings,-Transcripts,-and-AI)
- [Multilingual Live Transcription](#Multilingual-Live-Transcription)
- [Meeting Room Integrations](#Meeting-Room-Integrations)
- [How to Set Up Your Personal Meeting Room](#How-to-Set-Up-Your-Personal-Meeting-Room)
- [How to Start an Instant Meeting](#How-to-Start-an-Instant-Meeting)
- [Related Articles](#Related-Articles)

---

# **What Is Meeting Room?**

Meeting Room lets you host video meetings directly in HighLevel without using a separate video conferencing platform. The **Meeting Room** section in your sub-account includes three main areas:

- **My room:** Create and manage your personal Meeting Room with a permanent, reusable link.
- **Team rooms:** Find and access team members' Meeting Rooms.
- **Integrations:** Connect Meeting Room with other HighLevel products.

You can also generate unique Meeting Room links for individual calendar appointments.

---

## **Key Features of Meeting Room**

### 

### **Video Meetings and Collaboration**

- **Instant meetings:** Start video calls without scheduling an appointment.
- **Guest access:** Invite participants using a meeting link without requiring a HighLevel account when guest access is enabled.
- **Screen sharing and chat:** Share content and communicate during meetings.
- **Interactive tools:** Use reactions, hand raising, and different meeting layouts.
- **Picture-in-Picture:** Keep your meeting visible while switching browser tabs.

### 

### **Meeting Management and Security**

- **Host and co-host controls:** Manage participants, meeting permissions, and host responsibilities.
- **Waiting rooms and passcodes:** Control who can access your meetings.
- **Video and audio settings:** Configure cameras, microphones, backgrounds, lighting, and noise cancellation.

### 

### **Recordings, Transcripts, and AI**

- **Meeting recordings:** Record meetings and access available recordings afterward.
- **Speaker-labeled transcripts:** Review conversations with speaker names and timestamps.
- **AI meeting assistance:** Ask questions during meetings and generate summaries, key decisions, and action items from transcripts.

#### 

### **Multilingual Live Transcription**

Meeting Room supports multilingual live transcription, allowing participants to communicate in different languages during a meeting. Live transcription uses Deepgram Nova-3 and includes nine individual transcription language options and a **Mixed Languages** mode.

**Mixed Languages Mode**

Mixed Languages mode automatically detects supported languages during live transcription, including when participants switch between languages during a conversation. Mixed Languages supports 10 languages, including the following newly added languages:

- Dutch
- Hindi
- Russian
- Japanese

**How to Enable Mixed Languages**

1. Start a meeting in Meeting Room.
2. When starting live transcription, select **Mixed Languages** as the transcription language.
3. Start transcription.

Meeting Room automatically recognizes supported languages during the conversation.

```
Note: The existing live transcription workflow remains unchanged. Users can continue selecting their preferred transcription language when starting transcription.
```

---

## **Meeting Room Integrations**

Meeting Room works with several HighLevel products:

| Integration | What You Can Do |
| --- | --- |
| **Calendars** | Use your permanent Meeting Room link or generate a unique link for each appointment. |
| **Communities** | Host live discussions and Community Events. |
| **Courses** | Add live meeting sessions to courses. |
| **Events** | Use Meeting Room as an online event location. |
| **Webinars** | Connect live webinars to a Meeting Room. |

You can explore these options under **Meeting Room > Integrations**.

---

## **How to Set Up Your Personal Meeting Room**

Create a personal room with a permanent link that you can reuse for meetings.

1. Open your HighLevel sub-account and go to **Meeting Room > My room**.
2. Click **Create room**.  
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155084883287/original/vGTzE3d8CI6Twhu0a9_iHpnNdx5_C_FtxA.png?1793737540)
3. Under **Room details**, enter your **Name** and **Room link**.
4. Under **Security**, configure your passcode, waiting room, guest access, and room availability as needed.  
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155084883288/original/yVYvBKELc9Earli4Va7C-6457dNZFroEbg.png?1793737540)
5. Optionally, add a co-host under **Co-hosts**.
6. Click **Save changes**. Your personal Meeting Room is now ready to use!

   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155083276195/original/4cwBPTKGlRSyKPK5B1ghFlyfPGmQ6WYq4g.png?1791968635)

---

## **How to Start an Instant Meeting**

You can start a meeting anytime without scheduling an appointment.

1. Go to **Meeting Room > My room**.
2. Click **Start room**.
3. Review your microphone, speaker, and camera settings.
4. Click **Start now** to begin your meeting.

To invite participants, copy your **Room link** from **My room** and share it with them.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155083275729/original/heMEMnRXs81PDdXSP2Khay843PmyJcLDMA.png?1791968421)

---

## **Important Notes**

- Guests can join without a HighLevel account when **Allow guest users** is enabled.
- Custom background uploads are available to logged-in users.
- Recording a meeting does not automatically generate a transcript. Transcription must be enabled during the meeting for transcript-based AI features.

---

## **Related Articles**

- [Screen Sharing Enhancements in HighLevel Meeting Rooms](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000008510-screen-sharing-enhancements-in-highlevel-meeting-rooms)
- [Communities – Use Go Live to Host Meetings & Broadcasts](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000006673)
- [Live Rooms in Communities Events](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000007834-live-rooms-in-communities-events)

title_en: Communities - Private Channels and Channel Emojis
source_md:
Private Channels in HighLevel Communities let you host members‑only discussions, while channel emojis make channels easy to recognize. This guide covers what they are, key benefits, and concise steps to create, convert, manage members, and set emojis—including how to convert a private channel back to public.

[동영상](https://www.youtube.com/embed/u94QVLF\_iAA?&wmode=opaque)

---

**TABLE OF CONTENTS**

- [What is Private Channels and Channel Emojis?](#What-is-Private-Channels-and-Channel-Emojis?)
- [Key Benefits of Private Channels and Channel Emojis](#Key-Benefits-of-Private-Channels-and-Channel-Emojis)
- [How to Create a Private Channel](#How-to-Create-a-Private-Channel)
- [How to Convert a Public Channel to Private](#How-to-Convert-a-Public-Channel-to-Private)
- [How to Convert a Private Channel Back to Public](#How-to-Convert-a-Private-Channel-Back-to-Public)
- [How to Add or Remove Members in a Private Channel](#How-to-Add-or-Remove-Members-in-a-Private-Channel)
- [How to Set or Change a Channel Emoji or Icon](#How-to-Set-or-Change-a-Channel-Emoji%C2%A0or%C2%A0Icon-%C2%A0)
- [Frequently Asked Questions](#Frequently-Asked-Questions)
- [Related Articles](#Related-Articles)

---

# **What is Private Channels and Channel Emojis?**

Private Channels restrict visibility and participation to approved members, helping you run gated cohorts or premium groups. Channel emojis add a small visual identifier that appears beside the channel name in lists and headers to improve recognition. These features are available on both mobile and Web version, enhances privacy and customization options for your community.

---

## **Key Benefits of Private Channels and Channel Emojis**

- **Member control:** Approve exactly who can view and post in a channel.
- **Focused conversations:** Keep sensitive or paid content separated from public chatter.
- **Flexible privacy:** Convert channels between public and private as needs change.
- **Faster scanning:** Emoji (bold): improves channel recognition in lists and notifications.

---

## **How to Create a Private Channel**

Start a new channel as private when you need restricted access from the outset.

```
Important Note:

1. The group owner and channel creator are automatically added as channel managers.
2. A channel manager acts as an admin for that specific channel. Group roles like owner and group admin do not have significance within a private channel.
3. The group owner cannot leave a private channel.
4. Private channels will not be visible in the channel list to users who are not part of them.
```

1. Click on **Memberships** from your sub-account.
2. Go to **Communities**.
3. Click on **Groups**from the dropdown.  
     
   ![](https://jumpshare.com/share/F7VQklFSnqf9q7s8Sp8l+/Screenshot+2026-02-10+at+12.45.46%E2%80%AFAM.png)
4. **Open/Login**to your Group**.**  
     
   **![](https://jumpshare.com/share/E57Y9g9gMoqiDrCtMJPT+/Screen+Shot+2026-02-10+at+12.49.05+AM.png)**
5. Click **+ Add Channel**button.  
     
   ![](https://jumpshare.com/share/RIZ3PJO6Iq7pfIxh0C76+/Screen+Shot+2026-02-10+at+12.50.33+AM.png)
6. Enter the **Channel Name**. Optionally add channel description and choose channel icon.
7. Toggle **Make this Channel****Private** option to **ON**.
8. Click **Create Channel**.  
     
   ![](https://jumpshare.com/share/Gz1C38rPmRLipKWmbhcM+/Screen+Shot+2026-02-10+at+12.52.30+AM.png)

---

## **How to Convert a Public Channel to Private**

Switch an existing public channel to private to limit future visibility and participation.

```
Note: Non‑members will no longer see the channel in the list after conversion.
```

1. Click on the channel to open it.
2. Click the **Settings** (gear) icon.
3. Open the **Settings** tab.
4. Click **Make Channel Private**.
5. Read the **acknowledgement** popup and click on **Confirm**.

![](https://jumpshare.com/share/h4pdDItaYmSjrMlkLRnE+/GIF+Recording+2026-02-10+at+1.00.09+AM.gif)

---

## **How to Convert a Private Channel Back to Public**

Re‑open access if you want anyone in the group to discover and join the channel.

```
Important: After conversion, the channel is visible to all group members. Existing post history remains in the channel.
```

1. Open the channel.
2. Click the **Settings** (gear) icon.
3. Open the **Settings** tab.
4. Click **Make Channel Public**.
5. Read the **acknowledgement** popup and click on **Confirm**.

![](https://jumpshare.com/share/vAh4ZgRnGFIqzcihVJqg+/GIF+Recording+2026-02-10+at+12.56.14+AM.gif)

---

## **How to Add or Remove Members in a Private Channel**

Control who can access a private channel by adding or removing members at any time.

1. Open the channel.
2. Click the **Settings** (gear) icon.
3. Open **Members** tab.
4. **Add Members:** search and add users.
5. **Remove Members:** locate the user > click the **three dots** beside the name > **Remove from Channel**.

![](https://jumpshare.com/share/y6BNiMxVpDZtAhfkrbFg+/GIF+Recording+2026-02-10+at+1.04.42+AM.gif)

---

## **How to Set or Change a Channel Emoji****or****Icon**

Assign an emoji so members can quickly identify the channel in lists and notifications.

1. Open the channel.
2. Click the **Settings** (gear) icon.
3. Click on the **Edit** button beside **Channel** **Name**.
4. Click on the **Channel Icon option** and **choose** between an **Emoji** or **Icon** of your **choice**.
5. Click **Save**.

![](https://jumpshare.com/share/DUt50fbROAdD8x0OTBkW+/GIF+Recording+2026-02-10+at+1.11.40+AM.gif)

---

## **Frequently Asked Questions**

**Q: Who can see a private channel exists?**Only approved members and users with sufficient permissions for that channel.

**Q: What happens to past posts if I make a private channel public?**  
The channel becomes discoverable and its existing content is visible to all group members.

**Q: Should I revoke access via workflow or make the channel public?**  
Use workflows to manage member‑level access. Make the channel public when the entire channel should be open to the group.

**Q: Who can change a channel’s emoji?**  
The channel owner or a user with channel‑level manage permissions.

---

### **Related Articles**

- [How to Setup, Customize, and Manage Your Communities](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000000280)
- [Communities: Announcement Channel and Notification](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000005145)
- [Workflow Trigger & Action – Grant/Revoke Private Channel Access](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000003681)
- [Communities: Private Channel‑Based Course Access](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000005507)
- [Communities – How to Manage Members Inside Groups](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000000289)
- [Content Management in Communities](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000000297)

title_en: Footer Element in Email Builder
source_md:
The Footer element in Email Builder makes it easy to add professional, branded footers to your email templates. You can customize the footer with business details, important links, and styling that matches your brand. You can also control its visibility and preview how it appears across devices before sending your emails.

---

**TABLE OF CONTENTS**

- [What is the Footer Element in Email Builder?](#What-is-the-Footer-Element-in-Email-Builder?)
- [Footer Customization and Visibility Options](#Footer-Customization-and-Visibility-Options)
- [How to Use the Footer Element in Email Templates](#How-to-Use-the-Footer-Element-in-Email-Templates)
- [Frequently Asked Questions](#Frequently-Asked-Questions)
- [Related Articles](#Related-Articles)

---

# **What is the Footer Element in Email Builder?**

The Footer element is a prebuilt, customizable content block that you can add to the bottom of your emails. It provides a convenient place to display essential business information, such as your company name, contact details, copyright notices, and unsubscribe links.

Instead of building a footer from scratch, you can drag and drop the element into your email template and customize its content and appearance using the Email Builder.

---

## **Footer Customization and Visibility Options**

The Footer element includes design and visibility controls that help you tailor its appearance and behavior. Understanding these options makes it easier to create a footer that matches your email design and displays appropriately for recipients.

```
Note: Available customization settings and their placement may vary slightly between the Standard, AI, and Design editors.
```

- **Content and Typography:** Edit text, add hyperlinks, and customize fonts, sizes, colors, and alignment.
- **Colors and Spacing:** Adjust background colors, text colors, padding, and spacing to create a balanced design.
- **Borders and Dimensions:** Customize borders, height, width, and other supported styling options.
- **Device-Based Visibility:** Choose whether the footer appears on desktop, mobile, or both.
- **Conditional Sending:** Display or hide the footer based on contact field values, such as the contact's country.

```
Important: The Footer element is a design component and does not independently configure unsubscribe functionality. If you use LC Email, an unsubscribe link can be added automatically through your Business Profile settings. If you prefer to place the link manually, use the {{unsubscribe}} tag and configure the default setting appropriately to avoid duplicate links. Keep essential sender information and required unsubscribe options available to all applicable recipients.  
  
For more information, refer to Managing Default Unsubscribe Links in LC Email.
```

![](https://jumpshare.com/share/GoqQPd4YIXsKmLl5UyM8+/GIF+Recording+2026-10-21+at+18.28.20.gif)

---

## **How to Use the Footer Element in Email Templates**

Adding the Footer element provides a consistent location for business information and important links. Customizing its content, appearance, and visibility helps ensure your footer fits your email design and remains accessible across devices.

1. Log in to your HighLevel sub-account and navigate to **Marketing → Emails → Templates**.
2. Open an existing email template or click **+ New** to create a new one. Depending on the available options, you can start with a blank template, use a template from the library, create one from an existing campaign, import an email, or use **Create with AI**.
3. Once the template opens in the Email Builder, click the **+ Add Elements** button.
4. Locate the **Footer** element in the Elements panel, then drag and drop it into your email template, preferably at the bottom.
5. Click the **Footer** element to customize its overall appearance. Adjust the available settings, such as background color, padding, spacing, borders, height, and width.
6. Click the text or individual components within the footer to edit their content and styling. Update business details, hyperlinks, typography, and colors as needed.
7. **Optional:** Open the **Visibility** settings to configure Desktop/Mobile visibility or enable **Conditional Sending**, where supported. For example, to display optional content only for contacts in the United States, select **Country**, choose the condition **Is**, and enter **United States** as the value.

   **Note:** Applying Conditional Sending to the entire Footer element can hide it from contacts who do not meet the condition. Avoid applying conditions that would hide required business information or the only available unsubscribe option.

![](https://jumpshare.com/share/wn1ZmaO5bdy19DeyvBJL+/GIF+Recording+2026-10-21+at+18.35.18.gif)

---

## **Frequently Asked Questions**

#### **Q: Can I use the Footer element in different email editors?**

Yes. The Standard, AI, and Design editors demonstrated in the video support adding the Footer element through the Elements panel. However, the interface and available customization settings may differ.

#### **Q: Why is my footer not appearing for certain contacts or devices?**

Check the footer's Device-Based Visibility and Conditional Sending settings. If the footer is inside a hidden parent layout, it may also be hidden even when the footer's individual visibility settings are enabled.

#### **Q: Can I save a customized footer for use in other email templates?**

Yes. The Design Editor supports Saved Items, allowing you to save supported elements or layouts and reuse them in other email templates within the same HighLevel location. Saved Items are not currently supported in the AI Editor.

#### **Q: Can I remove or replace an existing Footer element?**

Yes. Select the Footer element and use the available delete control to remove it. You can then drag a new Footer element into the template and customize it as needed.

---

### **Related Articles**

- [Different Elements in Email Builder](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000006657)
- [How to Personalize Your Campaigns with Conditional Elements](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000003903-how-to-personalize-your-campaigns-with-conditional-elements)
- [Visibility Section for Layouts in Email Builder](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000005575/create_ticket)
- [Managing Default Unsubscribe Links in LC Email](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/48001225534-managing-default-unsubscribe-links-in-lc-email)
- [Preview and Test Your Email Campaigns/Templates](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/48001215382-preview-and-test-your-email-campaigns-templates)
- [Save and Reuse Items in the Email Builder](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000002467-save-and-reuse-items-in-the-email-builder)

title_en: Documents & Contracts: Public APIs
source_md:
Documents & Contracts: Public APIs empower you to automate document workflows directly within HighLevel. With these APIs, you can seamlessly list, send, and manage documents and templates, eliminating manual processes and streamlining integrations with external systems.

---

**TABLE OF CONTENTS**

- [What is Documents & Contracts: Public APIs?](#What-is-Documents-&-Contracts%3A-Public-APIs?)
- [Key Benefits of Documents & Contracts: Public APIs](#Key-Benefits-of-Documents-&-Contracts%3A-Public-APIs)
- [List Documents](#List-Documents)
- [Send Document](#Send-Document)
- [List Templates](#List-Templates)
- [Send Template](#Send-Template)
- [How To Set Up Documents & Contracts: Public APIs](#How-To-Set-Up-Documents-&-Contracts%3A-Public-APIs)
- [Frequently Asked Questions](#Frequently-Asked-Questions)

---

## **What is Documents & Contracts: Public APIs?**

Documents & Contracts: Public APIs provide developers with programmatic access to core document and contract features in HighLevel. They allow you to fetch documents, send them to contacts, access templates, and even generate and send documents in one step. By integrating these APIs, you can automate workflows, ensure consistency, and scale document management across your business applications.

---

## **Key Benefits of Documents & Contracts: Public APIs**

Harnessing these APIs delivers efficiency and automation that improve how you manage document workflows.

- **Document listings**: Retrieve a complete list of documents for accurate tracking.
- **Automated sending**: Send documents directly to contacts without manual intervention.
- **Template access**: Quickly fetch available templates to generate documents faster.
- **One-step creation & sending**: Create and send documents from templates with a single API call.
- **Seamless integration**: Connect document workflows with other apps and systems to reduce friction.

---

## **List Documents**

The List Documents endpoint lets you retrieve all documents within a specific HighLevel location. This is useful for syncing document records across your CRM, dashboards, or custom apps. For more, refer to [List Documents.](https://highlevel.stoplight.io/docs/integrations/60ec57df068f6-list-documents)

- Pull a full list of documents tied to your account.
- Keep document records updated in real time.
- Enable integrations that rely on document metadata.

---

## **Send Document**

With the Send Document endpoint, you can automatically dispatch an existing document to one or multiple contacts. This reduces time spent manually sending documents and ensures a consistent process. For more, refer to [Send Document.](https://highlevel.stoplight.io/docs/integrations/f7326427fcf70-send-document)

- Select an existing document for sending.
- Choose one or more contact recipients.
- Automate document delivery to improve response times.

---

## **List Templates**

The List Templates endpoint provides access to all available templates in your HighLevel location. This enables developers to fetch templates dynamically when building automated workflows or integrations. For more, refer to [List Templates](https://highlevel.stoplight.io/docs/integrations/da393f098cd9e-list-templates).

- Fetch a central list of templates.
- Identify the right template for any use case.
- Power integrations with up-to-date template availability.

---

## **Send Template**

The Send Template endpoint combines template-based document creation and sending into a single API call. This reduces the workflow to one action, making it easier to build automation at scale. For more, refer to [Send Template.](https://highlevel.stoplight.io/docs/integrations/c2be6fd51f42c-send-template)

- Generate a new document from a template.
- Immediately send it to designated contacts.
- Simplify your process with fewer steps.

---

## **How To Set Up Documents & Contracts: Public APIs**

Correctly setting up API access ensures your integrations run smoothly, securely, and at scale. Follow the steps below to configure your HighLevel account for API usage:

### **Step 1:** Obtain API Credentials

Go to **Agency** **Settings > Private Integrations** in your HighLevel account and create a **Private Integration token** (recommended over API keys for enhanced security and access control).

```
IMPORTANT: Scopes determine the permissions that the third-party app has to access your account data or perform actions. It's recommended to grant as few scopes as necessary for better account security.
```

  

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155053781481/original/4c1yU4D8Qr94ycqumFEQMR0ig3l8TO6SgQ.gif?1757939075)

### **Step 2:** Review API Documentation

Visit the [Public API documentation portal.](https://highlevel.stoplight.io/docs/integrations/7d92ac20e1355-documents-and-contracts-api) Identify which endpoints your workflow requires (List Documents, Send Document, List Templates, Send Template).

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155053781579/original/PW18r5Ci6TL3FisjacnDXoBp7fCWwHi-UA.png?1757939149)

### **Step 3:** Test API Calls

Use a tool like Postman to make sample requests. Set your authentication header as `Authorization: Bearer <your-token>`. Enter required parameters (document ID, template ID, contact IDs).

### **Step 4:** Validate Responses

Review the JSON output from each call. Confirm that documents or templates are returned and sent successfully.

### **Step 5:** Integrate with Your Workflow

Embed API calls into your CRM, automation scripts, or backend processes. Optionally connect with HighLevel workflows that trigger based on document actions (e.g., “Document Sent” or “Document Signed”).

### **Step 6:** Deploy Securely

Store your API tokens securely, rotate them periodically, and monitor API usage to avoid hitting rate limits.

---

## **Frequently Asked Questions**

**Q: What endpoints are included in Documents & Contracts: Public APIs?**  
You can use endpoints for listing documents, sending documents, listing templates, and sending templates.

**Q: Where do I find the official API documentation?**  
Full documentation is available at the [HighLevel Public API portal](https://highlevel.stoplight.io/docs/integrations/7d92ac20e1355-documents-and-contracts-api).

**Q: Do I need specific permissions to access these APIs?**  
Yes, valid API credentials (preferably Private Integration tokens) are required for access.

**Q: How can I test the APIs safely?**  
Use Postman or a similar API client with sample data before moving to production.

**Q: Is there a difference between using a document and using a template?**  
Yes. A document refers to an existing file in your account, while a template is a predefined structure that can be used to generate and send new documents.

title_en: Drag and Drop with Auto-Hierarchical Layout in Funnel & Website Builder
source_md:
Build pages faster with true drag and drop freedom. HighLevel’s auto-hierarchical logic lets you drop any element on the canvas while the builder creates Sections, Rows, and Columns for you.”

---

**TABLE OF CONTENTS**

- [What is Enhanced Drag and Drop with Auto-Hierarchical Layout?](#What-is-Enhanced-Drag-and-Drop-with-Auto-Hierarchical-Layout?)
- [Key Benefits of Enhanced Drag and Drop](#Key-Benefits-of-Enhanced-Drag-and-Drop)
- [How To Use the Enhanced Drag and Drop Feature](#How-To-Use-the-Enhanced-Drag-and-Drop-Feature)
- [Quick Examples of the Enhanced Drag and Drop Experience](#Quick-Examples-of-the-Enhanced-Drag-and-Drop-Experience)
- [Frequently Asked Questions](#Frequently-Asked-Questions)
- [Related Articles](#Related-Articles)

---

## **What is Enhanced Drag and Drop with Auto-Hierarchical Layout?**

Enhanced drag-and-drop functionality in the builder allows users to add elements to the canvas without needing to manually configure layout structures in advance. Now you can drop any element directly onto the canvas without worrying about setting up the correct structure first. The builder automatically creates the right layout hierarchy behind the scenes. This means fewer clicks, less confusion, and much faster page and funnel building. 

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155050739839/original/Mk3DK-Q-Wc9V_EXyYJKOgFef2fL24wgrMg.png?1753969518)

The system automatically wraps each element within the appropriate layout containers, such as Sections, Rows, and Columns. This reduces setup time and helps maintain a clean, consistent structure. Auto-hierarchy logic and visual drop cues support a smoother and more intuitive building experience. Now you can drop any element directly onto the canvas without worrying about setting up the correct structure first. The builder automatically creates the right layout hierarchy behind the scenes. This means fewer clicks, less confusion, and much faster page and funnel building.

---

## **Key Benefits of Enhanced Drag and Drop**

This functionality significantly improves the speed and usability of page building in HighLevel:

- **True Drag-and-Drop Freedom**: Place any element directly on the canvas—no need to prep the layout.
- **Auto-Wrap Logic**: Builder auto-generates the correct structure (Section > Row > Column) behind the scenes.
- **Smart Placement Detection**: Automatically detects valid drop targets and fits elements accordingly.
- **Inline Column Controls**: Add new columns to existing rows directly from the canvas.
- **Improved Visual Feedback**: Clear ghost outlines and drop zones help you preview where items will go.

---

## **How To Use the Enhanced Drag and Drop Feature**

This experience is available when **Enhanced Drag & Drop** is enabled (via **Labs**). Once enabled, you can drag new elements onto the canvas and also reposition existing elements by grabbing anywhere on the element.

Enable this feature in **Agency View** → **Labs** so sub-accounts can use it.

#### **Steps to Try It Out:**

1. Open any funnel or website page in the builder/editor.
2. Drag an element (for example, Text, Button, Image) from the sidebar onto an empty area of the canvas.
3. Watch as the builder automatically wraps the element with the correct layout containers.
4. Grab anywhere on the element and drag it to a new location (no move handle required).
5. Add new columns by hovering over a Row and clicking **+ Add Column**.
6. Use visual cues like ghost outlines to align your elements with precision.

*![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155050330879/original/M94lI-0H2eEViSy7mkixQ5WskCHSUysw3A.gif?1753294004)*

## 

## **Reorder Columns Within a Row**

You can reorder columns within the **same row** to adjust layout and content flow without rebuilding the section.

1. Hover over the row to reveal column boundaries and drop zones.
2. Grab the column and drag it left or right within the same row.
3. Use the drop indicator to place it in the new position, then release to drop.

```
Note: Column reordering is currently scoped to the same row. Reordering columns can change responsive stacking. Re-check tablet and mobile views after reordering.
```

### Tips for precision placement

- Use **zoom** to make small placement changes easier.
- Use **rulers/guides** (when available) to align elements consistently.
- Use **Undo/Redo** to experiment safely and back out of misdrops quickly.

## **Quick Examples of the Enhanced Drag and Drop Experience**

These examples show how the builder handles layout creation dynamically:

- **Dragging a Text Element onto a Blank Canvas:**Builder auto-creates: Section > Row > Column > Text
- **Dragging a Row onto a Blank Canvas:**Builder auto-creates: Section > Row (with default columns)
- **Adding Columns to an Existing Row:**Simply click the **“+ Add Column”** button inline on the canvas to expand the layout

---

## **Frequently Asked Questions**

**Q: Do I still need to manually add Sections or Rows?**

No, the builder creates them automatically based on what you drag and where you drop it.

**Q: Can I disable the auto-wrap behavior?**

Currently, this behavior is automatic and cannot be disabled.

**Q: What if I want to customize the layout structure manually?**

You can still add Sections, Rows, and Columns the traditional way if you prefer full control.

**Q: Does this feature work in both Funnels and Websites?**

Yes, the drag-and-drop enhancements apply to both Funnels and Websites.

**Q: Will this affect my existing pages?**

No, this only impacts the experience when creating or editing new elements going forward.

**Q: Do I still need the move handle?**No. You can grab any part of the element to move it.

**Q: Does this work in mobile view?**Yes. Re-check responsive order after reordering columns to confirm tablet/mobile layout.

---

## **Related Articles**

- [Sites Overview](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000001633-sites-overview)
- [Nested URL Paths Support for Websites, Funnels, Ecomm & Webinars](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000005779-nested-url-paths-support-for-websites-funnels-ecomm-webinars)
- [Saved Sections - Funnels, Websites, Webinars and E-Commerce Store](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000005513-saved-sections-funnels-websites-webinars-and-e-commerce-store)
- [Nested Layouts in Funnel and Website Builder](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000005794-nested-layouts-in-funnel-and-website-builder)
- [Funnels & Websites | Creating Categories in the Navigation Menu](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/48001155961-funnels-websites-creating-categories-in-the-navigation-menu)

title_en: Selling Snapshots on the App Marketplace
source_md:
[동영상](https://www.youtube.com/embed/jOPz7hAByMU?&wmode=opaque)

We are thrilled to announce a game-changing feature: the ability to sell Snapshots in the App Marketplace! This exciting release empowers agencies to monetize their expertise by offering Snapshots to other agencies, while also simplifying app creation for Snapshot creators.

---

**TABLE OF CONTENTS**

- [What is the App Marketplace for Snapshots?](#What-is-the-App-Marketplace-for-Snapshots?)
- [Why Sell Snapshots on HighLevel?](#Why-Sell-Snapshots-on-HighLevel?)
- [How to Sell Snapshots in the App Marketplace](#How-to-Sell-Snapshots-in-the-App-Marketplace)
- [Protecting Your Intellectual Property (IP)](#Protecting-Your-Intellectual-Property-(IP))
- [Frequently Asked Questions](#Frequently-Asked-Questions)

---

# **What is the App Marketplace for Snapshots?**

The App Marketplace allows agency admins to to monetize their CRM expertise and package their configurations into a scalable product!

1. Sell their Snapshots to other HighLevel agencies.
2. Use a variety of pricing models, including one-time, monthly, or yearly subscriptions.
3. Protect their Snapshot assets from unauthorized reselling with IP Protection.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155036369989/original/jqoDZmocTlUmapJynuPEo-rOlQAgZ4D2BQ.jpeg?1731353995)

---

# **Why Sell Snapshots on HighLevel?**

1. **Monetize Your Expertise:** Transform your CRM configurations into a product that other agencies can buy.
2. **Broaden Your Reach:** HighLevel’s App Marketplace provides a platform to showcase your Snapshot to a wide customer base.
3. **Secure Your Assets:** IP Protection ensures your intellectual property is safeguarded from unauthorized use.

---

# **How to Sell Snapshots in the App Marketplace**

[동영상](https://www.loom.com/embed/f6f296b24e83446799bb1b189bc7267d?sid=db39e95c-fd44-4234-88e8-082af4e70bff)

```
Streamlined Snapshot Listing Flow (Sell on Marketplace)
 
When you select “Sell on Marketplace” from Agency View → Account Snapshots, HighLevel starts the Snapshot listing journey immediately and routes you directly into the Snapshot listing module in the Developer Portal.
 
In this module, you can review the assets included in the Snapshot early in the flow before you continue. HighLevel also uses a Snapshot-only listing path to reduce unnecessary steps and screens.
```

### **Step 1:**Sign Up for the Developer Portal

- Visit [**https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com**](https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com)
- Sign up and complete the registration form.
- Verify your email to gain access to the Developer Portal.

```
If you are new to the Developer Portal, complete the setup steps above when prompted during listing. Returning sellers may be routed directly into the Snapshot listing module after selecting “Sell on Marketplace.”
```

### **Step 2:** Create Your App

- Log in to the Developer Portal and navigate to **My Apps**.
- Click on **Create an App**.
- Configure your app:  
    
  - **Name:** Provide a clear and descriptive name for your app.
  - **App Type:** Set the type to Public.
  - **Distribution Type:** Choose between:
  - **Agency:** Charge agencies directly.
  - **Sub-Account:** Charge sub-accounts each time the Snapshot is pushed.
  - **Listing Type:** Select either Standard or White-Label (recommended for broader reach).

### **Step 3:** Provide App Details

- Add a logo, tagline, and description for your app.
- Specify your company name and website to build trust with potential buyers.
- Upload preview images or a demo video to enhance your app’s value proposition.
- Include customer support details to ensure buyers can reach you if needed.

### **Step 4:** Configure Pricing

- Decide whether your app will be a free or paid app:  
    
  - **Free**: No cost to the buyer.
  - **Freemium**: Free with premium features available for a fee.
  - **Paid**: Charge a one-time fee, monthly, or yearly subscription.
- Define the pricing plan, name, and what’s included.

### **Step 5:**Add Your Snapshot

- In your HighLevel Agency account, select the Snapshot you want to sell.
- In the guided modal, enter your **App Name**.
- Review the pre-filled Snapshot listing settings (auto-configured for Snapshots).
- Copy the Marketplace link shown in the modal and use it to share your listing right away.
- If you select “Sell on Marketplace,” you will land in the Snapshot listing module in the Developer Portal.
- Review the assets packaged in the Snapshot early in the flow so you can confirm what buyers will receive.
- Continue through the Snapshot-only listing steps to publish with fewer screens and less navigation.

  ---

  ##

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155064695562/original/9z0vqjGO0IlvA3K7wQutrK1TE4ljU_ty_w.gif?1770819611)

### **Step 6:** Submit for Review

- Return to the **Basic Info** page in the Developer Portal.
- Ensure all necessary configurations are complete.
- Click **Submit for Review**. The HighLevel team will review your app for white-label compatibility within 7-10 days.

---

# **Protecting Your Intellectual Property (IP)**

When you enable **Get Marketplace Share Link**, IP Protection is automatically applied. This ensures:

1. Buyers **CANNOT** repackage or resell your Snapshot assets.
2. Your Snapshot remains exclusive to its original creator.

---

# **Frequently Asked Questions**

**Q: Can I list multiple Snapshots in one app?**

Currently, you can only include one Snapshot in an app. Ensure that the Snapshot's assets align with your app’s value proposition.

**Q: What is the difference between white-label and standard listing types?**

- **White-Label:** Removes branding, increasing the app’s appeal across various HighLevel customers.
- **Standard:** Retains visible branding, which may limit its reach.

**Q: What happens if my app submission is rejected?**

If your app is not approved, you’ll receive feedback from the HighLevel team detailing necessary changes. Update your app accordingly and resubmit.

**Q: Can I update my app after it’s been published?**

No, currently, you cannot modify your Snapshot link once your app. The update app feature is coming soon in Q1'25.

**Q: Is there a limit to how many apps I can create?**

No, there is no limit to the number of apps you can create and sell in the App Marketplace.

**Q: How do buyers use my Snapshot after purchasing it?**

Once purchased, buyers can push the Snapshot directly to their locations through their HighLevel dashboard.

**Q: Can I set different pricing models for different Snapshots?**

Currently, pricing models are configured per app. To offer different pricing for individual Snapshots, you’ll need to create separate apps.

title_en: Enable Tap to Pay on your Whitelabelled Mobile App
source_md:
## **Overview**

This guide provides a comprehensive step-by-step walkthrough for enabling **Tap to Pay on iPhone** or on your **Android** **whitelabelled mobile app**.

Tap to Pay allows merchants to accept **contactless payments directly through their iPhone**, eliminating the need for additional payment hardware and creating a seamless checkout experience for both businesses and customers

---

## **Please Note**

- You **must have an organization-level Apple Developer account** with Account Holder access.
- Tap to Pay on iPhone is available only for **supported payment service providers (PSPs)**. HighLevel’s whitelabelled apps use **Stripe**or**Square** as the PSP.
- Apple individually reviews entitlement & distribution requests before granting approval.
- Tap to Pay on Android follows a **different, simpler process** — no prior approval is required.

---

## **Covered in this Article**

- What is Tap to Pay on iPhone?
- Enabling Tap to Pay: Process Overview
- Step by Step process for Tap to pay on iPhone approval
- Enabling Tap to Pay on Android
- Support and Timeline
- FAQs

---

## **What is Tap to Pay on iPhone?**

**Tap to Pay on iPhone** enables merchants to **accept contactless debit and credit cards, Apple Pay, and other digital wallets** using just their iPhone. This feature integrates directly with your HighLevel whitelabelled app, letting sub-accounts receive payments through their **connected Stripe**or**Square account**.

Apple requires each app to have an **entitlement** & **distribution** to use this feature, which is granted upon approval through the **Tap to Pay on iPhone Entitlement Request Form**.

---

## **Quick** **Note**:

Please enable the **POS module** in the app drawer before starting the Tap to Pay steps. We can proceed only after the POS module is enabled in the Mobile App Customizer.

## **Enabling Tap to Pay: Process Overview**

The setup process consists of **three main steps**:

**1. Request Tap to Pay on iPhone Entitlemen**

**2. Await Apple’s Review and Entitlement Addition**  
**3.** **Submitting requirements for Tap to pay distribution approval**  
**4. Await Apple’s Review and Distribution Addition**

**5. Pushing update with Tap to pay distribution permission**

Once approved, you can **request an update** for your white labelled app through Mobile app customiser to enable Tap to Pay functionality.

---

## **Step 1: Request Tap to Pay Entitlement**

### **Prerequisite**

- You must be logged in as the **Account Holder** of your **organization-level Apple Developer account**.
- Go to Apple’s official request page - [Tap to Pay on iPhone Entitlement Request Form](https://developer.apple.com/contact/request/tap-to-pay-on-iphone/)

### **Action**

- Complete and submit the request form.
- Select your PSP as **Stripe**or**Square**.

Refer to the **sample document table** for a guide on how to accurately complete each field.

Below are key entries based on the sample form:

| **Field** | **Response Example** |
| --- | --- |
| PSP | Stripe |
| Organization | Your organization name |
| Name | Organization's owner name |
| Email | Your organization's primary email |
| Distribution | App Store and Apple Business Manager |
| Onboarding Description | Merchants are onboarded via the web app as sub-accounts. Once connected to Stripe, they can sign in on mobile to process payments. |
| Countries/Regions | List all the countries or regions where your clients will use Tap to Pay, in order of release. |

Ensure that all responses **match the provided sample document** for a successful approval process .

---

## **Merchant Onboarding Process**

Merchant onboarding primarily occurs through the **HighLevel web app**:

1. The main account owner adds merchants as **sub-accounts**.
2. Each merchant connects their **Stripe**or**Square account** via the web interface.
3. Merchants then sign in to the **mobile app using sub-account credentials** to start accepting payments directly into their Stripe accounts.

This structure ensures a smooth and independent onboarding process for each merchant.

### **Review Process**

Apple reviews each request based on the provided details and eligibility.

Once approved, the **Tap to Pay entitlement** will appear under your account’s **Managed Capabilities**.

## **Step 2: Entitlement Addition by Apple**

Once Apple approves your application:

- The **Tap to Pay entitlement** will be added to your developer account.
- Notify your HighLevel account representative to proceed with next step.

## **Step 3: Submitting requirements for Tap to pay distribution approval**

**Once the entitlement addition by Apple was granted need to proceed with requirements shared by Apple team which includes Demo video and requirement checklist.**

## **Step 4: Await Apple’s Review and Distribution Addition**

Will wait to get approval on the Distribution addition upon submitted assets.

## **Step 5: Pushing update with Tap to pay distribution permission**

Once the distribution access was granted, need to push app update to get the feature Tap to Pay on iPhone live for all the apps.

## **Enabling Tap to Pay on Android**

Unlike iOS, **Tap to Pay on Android** does **not require Google's approval** or entitlement requests.

To enable Tap to Pay on Android:

- Request a **whitelabel app update** following the standard HighLevel update request process.
- Once updated, your Android app will automatically support Tap to Pay payments.

---

## **Support and Timeline**

### **Support Channels**

- **Apple Developer Support:** For issues related to the entitlement process.
- **HighLevel Support Team:** For app updates or integration-related concerns.

### **Expected Timeline**

Apple’s review time can vary — typically ranging from **a few days to several weeks**.

Plan your app release timelines accordingly to account for review delays.

---

## **FAQs**

**Q1: Do I need to pay extra for the Tap to Pay entitlement?**

No. The entitlement itself is free, but Apple must approve it before it becomes active.

**Q2: Can I use Tap to Pay without Stripe integration?**

No. HighLevel’s Tap to Pay implementation currently supports **Stripe**and**Square only** as the payment service provider.

**Q3: How long does the approval process take?**

While Apple doesn’t specify an exact timeframe, approvals typically take **1–6 weeks** depending on account eligibility.

**Q4: What happens if my entitlement request is rejected?**

You can resubmit with corrected information or contact Apple Developer Support for clarification.

**Q5: Is Tap to Pay available globally?**

Availability depends on **Apple’s regional rollout** and **Stripe’s country support**. Ensure you list all intended countries in your request form.

title_en: Analytics and Form Tracking in AI Studio
source_md:
AI Studio includes built-in analytics and form submission tracking, making it easier to monitor your published projects without installing tracking code. You can track page views, visitor engagement, opt-ins, and conversion rates directly within your AI Studio project. This article explains how to access these features, understand your project performance, and manage submissions from within AI Studio.

[동영상](https://jumpshare.com/embed/ZpZgXrDnbN2P7N4GIFJg?disableDownload=true)

---

**TABLE OF CONTENTS**

- [Analytics and Form Submission Tracking in AI Studio](#Analytics-and-Form-Submission-Tracking-in-AI-Studio)
  - [How To Access AI Studio Analytics](#How-To-Access-AI-Studio-Analytics)
  - [How To View and Manage Form Submissions](#How-To-View-and-Manage-Form-Submissions)
  - [View AI Studio Analytics Across Multiple Websites](#View-AI-Studio-Analytics-Across-Multiple-Websites)
  - [Related Articles](#Related-Articles)

---

# **Analytics and Form Submission Tracking in AI Studio**

AI Studio Analytics provides built-in reporting for published AI Studio projects, allowing you to monitor website traffic, visitor engagement, and lead conversions without manually configuring analytics tracking code.

Within each project, you can access an Analytics dashboard that includes page views, unique page views, opt-ins, opt-in rate, average time, and visitor trends. Additional reporting helps you understand your most visited pages, traffic sources, devices, browsers, and visitor locations.

Form Submissions provides a centralized view of leads captured through connected forms on your AI Studio website. You can review submission details, filter records by form or date, and access related HighLevel contacts.

You can also view AI Studio performance alongside other site assets through **Sites → Analytics → AI Studio**. When a visitor submits a connected form, supported page visits and submission events can appear in the contact's Activity timeline, helping you understand the visitor's journey.

```
Important: Forms connected before this feature was released continue counting opt-ins. To associate new submissions with the pages visitors viewed beforehand, ask AI Studio to reconnect form tracking and publish the website again.
```

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155082982180/original/58YqlzRASNN5O1EUoKkkECrA_IZprazXcA.png?1791566813)

---

## **How To Access AI Studio Analytics**

AI Studio Analytics gives you access to website performance metrics directly within your project. You can review traffic trends, conversion activity, page engagement, and visitor information to better understand how your published website performs.

To access Analytics in AI Studio:

1. Navigate to **AI Studio** in the left navigation menu.
2. Open the published project you want to analyze.
3. Click **More** in the top navigation bar.
4. Select **Analytics** from the menu.
5. Click **Overview** to open the analytics dashboard.

The Analytics Overview displays key performance metrics, including page views, unique page views, opt-ins, opt-in rate, and changes from the previous reporting period.

You can also explore average time on site, early exits, top-performing pages, and visitor breakdowns by traffic source, device, browser, and location to better understand how visitors interact with your website.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155082981971/original/wSuqiD7iy4ahhE0NQFobwjfd5ZFDXB8KzA.png?1791566606)

---

## **How To View and Manage Form Submissions**

The Form Submissions view in AI Studio provides a centralized location to review leads captured through connected website forms. You can inspect submission records, filter results, locate associated contacts, and access workflow creation from the same interface.

To view form submissions:

1. From your HighLevel **Sub-Account** view, click **AI Studio** in the left navigation menu.
2. Open the AI Studio project containing your connected website forms.
3. Click **More** in the top navigation bar.
4. Select **Analytics**.
5. Click **Form Submissions**.
6. Review the **All submissions** table to see captured form submissions.

The Form Submissions dashboard displays your total submissions and a list of captured leads, including submission dates, contact names, and available contact information.

You can also select **Create workflow** to begin setting up an automation.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155082982003/original/2rvwOuJXM9zt3Ss9LE6-ukL9fat5vjP6Pw.png?1791566629)

### **View Lead Attribution in Contact Activity**

When a visitor submits a connected form on your AI Studio website, HighLevel can associate their page visits, traffic source, and form submission with their contact record. This helps you understand where the lead came from and which pages they visited before submitting the form.

To view this activity:

1. Navigate to **Contacts**.
2. Select the contact you want to review.
3. Open the **Activity** panel in the contact details.
4. Review the recorded **Page visited** and **Form submitted** events, along with the available attribution information.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155082982407/original/sj7gIXlF0kU31ERx6zn2O1urrefjo2SR9A.png?1791567172)

---

## **View AI Studio Analytics Across Multiple Sites**

You can also access AI Studio reporting through the main Sites Analytics dashboard, which supports reporting across different website asset types.

1. Navigate to **Sites** → **Analytics**.
2. Open the asset-type dropdown at the top of the dashboard and select **AI Studio** from the available options.
3. Use the adjacent project filter to select **All** or choose a specific AI Studio project.
4. Adjust the date range to review performance for the selected period.

This consolidated view makes it easier to review the performance of multiple AI Studio projects alongside other supported assets, including Funnels and Websites.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155082981970/original/rQXVvi3XBHhCS_jQ0RqBiS64Qm71aGno0w.png?1791566606)

---

title_en: Listings – Duplicate Suppression Management
source_md:
Duplicate Suppression in HighLevel Listings helps you find and eliminate duplicate online listings across directories like Google, Bing, Apple Maps, and more. This guide explains how detection works, what each status means, and how to suppress or dismiss duplicates from your Listings dashboard. 

```
Note: This feature is only supported for Yext entities. Uberall entities are not supported.
```

---

**TABLE OF CONTENTS**

- [What is Duplicate Suppression Management in Listings?](#What-is-Duplicate-Suppression-Management-in-Listings?)
- [Key Benefits of Duplicate Suppression](#Key-Benefits-of-Duplicate-Suppression%C2%A0)
- [Duplicate Detection Logic](#Duplicate-Detection-Logic)
- [Statuses & Review Lifecycle](#Statuses-&-Review-Lifecycle)
- [How To Use Duplicate Suppression in Listings](#How-To-Use-Duplicate-Suppression-in-Listings)
- [Frequently Asked Questions](#Frequently-Asked-Questions%C2%A0)
- [Related Articles](#Related-Articles)

---

# **What is Duplicate Suppression Management in Listings?**

Duplicate Suppression identifies online listings that appear to represent the same business as your authoritative listing and routes them through a directory‑review workflow to hide/remove the duplicates. Suppressing duplicates concentrates ranking signals on your primary listing and ensures customers see accurate, consistent information. Removing duplicates protects brand consistency, improves local SEO, and prevents customers from seeing conflicting information.

---

## **Key Benefits of Duplicate Suppression**

- **Stronger local SEO**: consolidates authority to your primary, correct listing.
- **Cleaner customer journey**: removes confusing, outdated, or conflicting listings.
- **Brand consistency**: keeps name, address, phone, and hours consistent across sites.
- **Operational efficiency**: centralizes detection and actions in one dashboard—no more manual outreach to publishers.
- **Status transparency**: track submissions through Possible Duplicate → Processing Suppression → Suppressed → Unable to Suppress.

---

## **Duplicate Detection Logic**

Knowing how duplicates are identified helps you confidently decide whether to suppress or keep a listing marked as “Not a Duplicate.”

- HighLevel runs **automated monthly scans** against major directories to flag **potential duplicates** of your authoritative listing.
- Flags are based on similarity of **business name, address, phone (NAP),** and other identifiers on publisher pages.
- Multi‑location brands should confirm a candidate isn’t a **separate location** (e.g., another franchise nearby or a previous address) before suppressing.
- If a listing is misidentified, you can **Mark as Not a Duplicate** to keep it off the list.

---

## **Statuses & Review Lifecycle**

Statuses indicate where each candidate listing is in the suppression workflow and what to do next.

- **Possible Duplicate**: The item is flagged by detection and awaiting your action.
- **Processing Suppression**: You requested suppression. The directory publisher is reviewing your request (many complete within ~24 hours; some may take a week or longer).
- **Suppressed**: The listing has been removed from publisher search results. In many cases the old URL redirects to your correct listing; some publishers may show updated content or return an error instead.
- **Unable to Suppress**: The publisher declined the request or doesn’t support suppression for this case.

---

## **How To Use Duplicate Suppression in Listings**

Accurate setup and careful review ensure you remove only true duplicates while preserving legitimate listings.

1. **Open the Sub‑Account** and navigate to **Reputation → Listings**.  
     
   ![](https://jumpshare.com/share/VjCRHvpPqWBGscsZ0EEL+/Screen+Shot+2026-02-20+at+16.21.36.png)
2. Click the **Duplicate Suppression** tab.  
     
   **Note:** This tab is only visible if the sub-account has any Yext entity present and active.

   ![](https://jumpshare.com/share/f51Rr3vKQZ6rPEFBcT79+/Screen+Shot+2026-02-20+at+16.45.52.png)
3. Review the grid: **Site**, **Your Listing**, **Duplicate Listing**, **Status**and**Action**.  
     
   ![](https://jumpshare.com/share/OCEQInLucm4dosNPss2d+/Screen+Shot+2026-02-20+at+16.49.33.png)
4. To remove a confirmed duplicate, click **Suppress** and then **Confirm**.  
     
   ![](https://jumpshare.com/share/W0edKg3j2JFXS5hZbUvQ+/GIF+Recording+2026-02-20+at+16.52.53.gif)
5. To dismiss a false positive, click **Not a Duplicate** and then **Confirm**.  
     
   ![](https://jumpshare.com/share/2ujJpdPGUrNAeuXXRIIc+/GIF+Recording+2026-02-20+at+16.54.35.gif)
6. Monitor the **Status** chips to track progress: **Processing Suppression, Suppressed, or Unable to Suppress**.
7. Revisit monthly after scans refresh to address any new candidates.  
     
   ![](https://jumpshare.com/share/g8sdvDUh2gRfKueKBM4u+/Screen+Shot+2026-02-20+at+16.55.32.png)

---

## **Frequently Asked Questions**

**Q: Why is this tab not available in my account?**

If the sub-account has any Yext entity present and active, then only this tab would be shown.

**Q: What counts as a duplicate listing?**  
A listing that appears to represent the same business as your authoritative listing based on NAP and other matching signals on the publisher site.

**Q: How long does suppression take?**  
Many publishers complete review within ~24 hours; some may take a week or longer depending on policies and evidence needs.

**Q: Will the duplicate URL always redirect?**  
No. Many publishers redirect; others remove the page or display updated content or an error.

**Q: What if the publisher declines my request (Unable to Suppress)?**  
Verify the candidate, gather evidence, and contact support. Some publishers require additional proof or do not support suppression for certain cases.

**Q: Does suppression affect my Google Business Profile?**  
Yes—reducing duplicates can help concentrate ranking signals, but changes are subject to Google’s policies and review timelines.

**Q: How often are duplicates refreshed?**  
Automated scans run monthly. Check the tab regularly to address new findings.

---

### **Related Articles**

- [HighLevel Listings](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/48000984066)
- [Online Listing Overview & Setup](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/48001196389)
- [Create & Edit Listings](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000006579)
- [Online Listings: Supported Countries & Coverage](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000004145)
- [How to Use the Listings Suggestions Feature](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000005425)

title_en: Email Signatures
source_md:
Email signatures help keep outbound emails consistent and professional by adding your saved name, title, contact information, links, images, and other signature content to supported emails. Each user can manage their own signature from My Profile, automatically apply it to outgoing messages, or insert it manually using the user signature custom value.

---

**TABLE OF CONTENTS**

- [What Is an Email Signature?](#what-is-email-signature)
- [Set Up or Edit Your Email Signature](#setup-email-signature)
- [Configure Signature Settings](#signature-settings)
- [Insert a User Signature Using Custom Values](#custom-value)
- [Use an Email Signature in a Campaign](#campaign-signature)
- [Frequently Asked Questions](#faq)
- [Related Articles](#related-articles)

---

## **What Is an Email Signature?**

An email signature is saved per user within a Sub-Account. It can include information such as your name, title, phone number, links, images, and other formatted content.

Your saved signature can be applied automatically to supported outgoing emails or inserted manually where needed using the user email-signature custom value.

---

## **Set Up or Edit Your Email Signature**

Use the steps below to create or update your email signature from **My Profile**.

### **Step 1:**Open My Profile

From the **Sub-Account view**, go to **Settings → My Profile → General**.  
  
![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155082693611/original/NaV2xRAvQ-j4Wpqe-aQLNqaR5GUc_7lfgg.png?1791340575)

### **Step 2:**Open the Email Signature Section

In the **General** tab, locate the email signature editor.  
  
![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155082693610/original/1atc1aFDxhTACn2a_UgSNYQvlaLfDH_Djg.png?1791340567)

### **Step 3:**Create or Update Your Signature

Enter or update your signature content using the available editor controls. The rebuilt editor includes options such as:

- Fonts and font sizes
- Line height
- Text colors
- Text alignment
- Links
- Images
- Custom values
- HTML/source editing
- Clear All

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155082693626/original/pyzCaTLkFeFUHn3_RNUKG5Iow4Six7I4dA.png?1791340614)

Use **Insert HTML** or the available source view when you need to paste or edit HTML directly.

Use **Clear All** to remove the current signature content and start over.

The rebuilt editor also improves HTML and table rendering so pasted or imported signatures display more consistently in the editor and in sent emails.

### **Step 4:**Configure Optional Settings

Configure the available signature options based on how you want the signature to appear in outgoing messages.

- Turn on **Enable Signature in All Outgoing Messages** to automatically apply your saved signature to supported outgoing emails.
- Enable **Include This Signature Before Quoted Text in Replies** if you want your signature to appear above the quoted email thread when replying.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155082693629/original/OdzJLsn7vij0EaUg_RKEnvIKDF06VPHo3A.png?1791340660)

### **Step 5:**Save Your Changes

After reviewing your signature and settings, use the available save control in **My Profile** to apply your changes.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155082693639/original/DUhs3ScPHM64OfHE3CnPvUE5wPZkHE-TGg.png?1791340699)

---

## **How Automatic Signature Settings Work**

If **Enable Signature in All Outgoing Messages** is enabled, the saved signature can be added automatically to supported outgoing emails.

The quoted-text setting controls where your signature appears when replying to an existing email thread.

---

## **Insert a User Signature Using Custom Values**

Using the email-signature custom value gives you more control over where the signature appears. This is useful when you want to place the signature at a specific location in a campaign, template, or supported email editor.

1. Open the email editor where you want the signature to appear.
2. Click **Custom Values**.
3. Go to **User**, then select **Signature**.

The email-signature custom value is:

`{{user.email_signature}}`  
  
`![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155082693577/original/iLcY1HCTIQV6pc9fXbfkrXq5vcWInN825w.png?1791340475)`

---

## **Use an Email Signature in a Campaign**

The `{{user.email_signature}}` merge field dynamically inserts the saved signature associated with the available user context when the email is generated.

Add the merge field where you want the signature to appear in the campaign:

`{{user.email_signature}}`

For example, place it below your closing message so the appropriate saved user signature is inserted when the email is generated.

**Important:** If the signature appears blank or shows the wrong user's information, verify the user context associated with the email, such as the assigned user or sender. For additional troubleshooting, see [Troubleshooting Merge Fields](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000008467-how-to-use-merge-fields-and-email-fallback-values#Troubleshooting-Merge-Fields).

---

## **Frequently Asked Questions**

**Q: Is the email signature set per user or per Sub-Account?**

Email signatures are saved per user within a Sub-Account. Each user can have a different signature.

**Q: I updated my signature, but I do not see it when sending emails. What should I check?**

Confirm that you updated the correct user profile and verify whether **Enable Signature in All Outgoing Messages** is enabled. If you are using `{{user.email_signature}}`, also verify the user context associated with the email.

**Q: What formatting options can I use in my signature?**

The signature editor supports formatting options such as fonts, font sizes, line height, text colors, alignment, links, images, custom values, and HTML/source editing.

**Q: Can I paste or edit HTML in my email signature?**

Yes. Use **Insert HTML** or the available source view in the signature editor to add or edit HTML directly.

**Q: Can I place my signature before quoted text in replies?**

Yes. Enable **Include This Signature Before Quoted Text in Replies**.

---

## **Related Articles**

- [How to Use Custom Values](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/48001161575)
- [User Access](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/48000982600)
- [How to Batch Schedule Email Campaigns](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/48001215379)
